Ancient_Ruins.name: Ancient Ruins
intro:
Ancient Ruins is a combat relic site only found in the [https://evemaps.dotlan.net/map/Catch Catch] nullsec region, especially in the 9HXQ-G constellation. Up to T2 Battleships can enter this site. This site appears to probes as a combat site. The site is very rare and hard, and should only be attempted by skilled players. Sansha's Nation and Rogue Drone rats are present in this site. Omni tanks are highly preferable, especially EM and Thermal damage. Damage in the site can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing triggers.

Extra:
*Bounties: approx. 60-70M isk + bounty adjustment payout
*Loot: approx. 50M isk
*Salvage: approx. 20M isk

rows.name: Pirate Grave Robber (Centus Dread Lord/Dark Lord)
Gate to Portal

rows.name: Gate to Hall
rows.note: 0km from warp-in, locked until everything is destroyed

pockets.title: Third Pocket(Hall)
pockets.prose: Rogue drones are present in this room. There is no limit to how many times the hacking of Floating Debris can be failed but it decreases the chance of getting valuable loot at each fail.

rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed, 0km from warp-in

pockets.title: Fourth Pocket(Sanctum)
pockets.prose: The Hive Mother does very little damage and has a moderate tank. It will trigger new waves as it is destroyed so be sure to kill a new wave before continuing shooting the Hive Mother or you'll be quickly overwhelmed.

rows.name: Hive mother 2_Complex
rows.trigger: Triggers subsequent waves at armor damage, hull damage, 50% and 25% hull

rows.name: Ancient Ruins
rows.trigger: Triggers smartbomb wave when approached or when hacking failed
rows.cargo: Possible salvage, T1 and meta gas scoop

messages: Pirate Grave Robber: The ancient ruins in here are taken buddy. Leave now and maybe we'll let you go in one piece.

DED deep space scouts briefly explored this strange site and left behind a rather cryptic note. As far as you can tell some ancient ruins lie within, but who built them or what treasures might lie buried there are anyone's guess.
As you come out of acceleration you notice the resemblance of a spatial rift in the distance.
Centus Relay Commander: They've found the portal! Destroy them before they escape!
Upon attacking the Centus Relay Commander
As the Relay Commander is attacked, he calls for backup! More hostile ships are incoming!
Upon attacking the Centus Relay Commander
As the Relay Commander is attacked, he calls for backup! More hostile ships are incoming!

A large force of drones has taken up residence in this area. They obviously benefit greatly from salvaging the remnants of the former inhabitants, which still litters this patch of space. A drone presence this large could not be formed without an abundance of raw materials.
Upon destroying one of the missile batteries
Drones have been deployed from the Drone Bunkers in response to the attack on the sentry guns!
In local when a floating debris is approached
Ektar Ssrath: Minions, now is our chance! It looks like the fools have approached the debris and started the excavation process, whatever they are about to discover in there will be OURS!
Someone has triggered an ancient land mine! All ships inside the blast radius take damage.

The source of the drone infestation seems to lie in this deadspace pocket, located inside a fiery nebula. The extreme and hostile environment, accompanied by a very heavy drone presence, seems to have kept most of the looters away, as two fully intact ancient ruins would indicate.
The Drone Hive Mother has deployed Drone Cruise Missile Batteries along with more drone ships!
Drones have emerged from the nearby bunkers to defend the Hive Mother!
Drones have emerged from the nearby bunkers to defend the Hive Mother!
Drones have emerged from the nearby bunkers to defend the Hive Mother!
In local (upon destroying the Hive Mother)

The Hive Mother has been eliminated, and the buzz of drone communications slowly calms down. Some drones machines may still be active, but at least their numbers will no longer be replenished by the frenzied replication process inside the Drone Mother.
Someone has gone too close to one of the ruins and triggered an ancient hidden explosive. Energy and material spurts in all directions, and all ships caught in the blast radius take damage!

Angel's_Red_Light_District.name: Angel's Red Light District
intro:
Angel's Red Light District is a DED Complex (rated 5/10), occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems, or as an escalation from Angel Refuge or Angel Den. It's the only DED 5/10 that also comes from a Refuge. Dens and Refuges are extra easy to run quickly and it's therefore easy to farm this escalation.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site.

This site's acceleration gate allows all subcapitals to enter.

Videos: 
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMMsFNYc3mA Gila],
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=037lt6g4coo Golem],
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Naue9hNhqJY Vargur],
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6xXnt4iMz2k Widow]

pockets.prose: The acceleration gate is roughly 35 km from the warp-in point.

rows.name: Captain Rouge
rows.cargo: May rarely contain Domination modules, No Overseers effects

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: unlocks when all defenders are dead.

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose: The acceleration gate is about 45 km from the warp-in point.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Requires Garan's Private Key, and all defenders to be destroyed.

rows.name: Gardan's Fantasy Complex
rows.cargo: Contains Gardan's Private Key, Can also contain a Domination Adaptive faction module.

pockets.title: Room 3
pockets.prose:
Warning: Initial incoming damage will be very high. Clear the triple Stasis Towers as fast as possible; they will web you to a standstill. Stasis towers spawn up to 50km from the beacon. Recommend over 85% resists to Explosive damage.

Angel's Retirement Home (the structure with your loot) has 93k shield HP buffer. Unless you can permatank the rats, do not attempt to go after it first.

rows.name: Angel Retirement Home
rows.cargo: Contains 18th tier Overseers Personal effects, and may contain Gistum B-type modules and/or a Cynabal BPC.

messages:
This is a den for the ones that value instant worldly pleasure above other things. It is a popular stopover for overworked Angel pirates and members of secret guilds or groups. 
Captain Rogue or the "Pleasure Officer" maintains a firm control of who is let further into the complex and who is not. 
 DED Threat Assessment: Dangerous (5 of 10)"

Trafficking of drugs, hallucogenics, exotic art pieces and valuables is rampant in this den of carnal pleasures. Attempts to crack down on this operation have all failed as the entertainment facilities here are frequented by prominent political individuals and celebrities. Operatives should restrict themselves to monitoring only.

A prominent figure in the art world, Mandat Gardan, has established a fairly exotic entertainment facility here. It has gained some renown as it is the only pleasure spa so far to combine hot streams of air and cool water fountains with zero gravity and imaginative architectural solutions. It is reportedly very cheap to build and a surge in this kind of entertainment is expected to happen soon.
The wheels of your imagination start turning as your ship's weapon systems warm up.

The Angel Cartel's original advertisement for this place that it had established an "old folks home" for retired Angels. What that really meant was that wealthy pirates that wanted out of the business could buy into this resort and stay in it indefinitely by signing their investments over to the cartel. By all standards, this place is extremely well guarded.

Angel_Annex.name: Angel Annex
intro:
The Angel Annex is a Cosmic Signature of the Unrated Complex type, occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Lowsec systems.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

pockets.title: First room

Attacking Smuggler's Gate trigger's second wave.

Acceleration gate unlocks on kill of Smuggler Commander or by using Angel Platinum Tag

rows.name: Crokan

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: Destroying Crokan, the Domination Commander, in this signature may cause an escalation to an expedition known as the Angel Powergrid.

Angel_Base.name: Angel Base
intro: The Angel Base is an unrated cosmic signature combat site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Null Sec space. Estimated payout 14-18.7 mil. The site is easy with Prop mod fitted Faction, T2 or T3 Cruiser; MJD sniper Battleship.

pockets.title: First room
pockets.prose: Clear all the NPC's to access the gate.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Clear all rats to access the gate

rows.separator: Time Delayed Spawn once Front Squad is dispatched

pockets.title: Second pocket
pockets.prose: Go straight for the Drug Lab, destroy it and the command ship if it spawns.

rows.name: Drug Lab
rows.trigger: On attack trigger Battleship and/or Commander spawn - Escalation trigger on destruction

rows.name: Domination Warlord
rows.cargo: Possible Domination modules and or T2 Halo Implants

notes.title: Warp-In
notes.text: No Hostiles at warpin. Activate the Acceleration Gate

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: Destroying the Drug Lab or the command spawn for a small chance to escalate to Toxic Waste Scandal!

messages: As your instruments power down from combat mode, you notice a scanner report on one of your panels indicating a strange reading few systems away. Comparing the location with external logs you learn that this is the site of an old mining outpost that was abandoned a few years back.

Angel_Cartel_Naval_Shipyard.name: Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard
intro:
The Angel Cartel Naval Shipyard is the Angel DED 10/10. It can be scanned in Nullsec where Angel are the local rats. Alternatively you can gain it as an escalation from the Angel Haven, Angel Sanctum, or Angel Forsaken Sanctum. When it's an escalation, you can skip the first room.

The boss named "The Antimatter Channeler" has a high volley that deals 37.5k damage for wrecking shots. That makes people die to it on a regular basis. In order to have enough buffer, it is recommended to use a battleship even though some cruisers can run it if fitted with extra buffer.

Overseer’s turrets reach out to 100 km but are subject to the same tracking limits as regular battleships so speed tanking will be helpful to avoid its extreme alpha strike. Its tank is also nothing special, 500 DPS Explosive is enough to crack its shield reps.

rows.note: This ship can deal extreme damage (EM:2,500 EXP:5,000 KIN:2,500 THERM: 2,500) every 60sec at ranges over 100 KM with pinpoint tracking). Has strong shield tank

notes.title: Warp-in

messages: The Angel Cartel has established a firm presence in this Deadspace Complex. They use it as a naval construction base but reports claim that they perform some testing of shield Compact inside. These rumors remain largely unconfirmed. The area is extremely dangerous and the inner pockets are off limits to everyone but the key players in the Angel Cartel. DED Threat Assessment: Critical (10 of 10).

This pocket serves as a scanning and identification post for the gatekeepers, habitation for the workers in the complex and a place of commerce for businessmen who mainly deal in technology, energy or mineral resources

Previous reports have indicated this first deadspace pocket is nowhere near as dangerous to enter as the rest of them. It serves as a scanning and identification post for the gatekeepers, habitation for the workers in the complex and a place of commerce for businessmen who mainly deal in technology, energy or mineral resources.

Earlier reports have indicated huge arrays of armor fittings guarded by automatic sentries and patrolling pilots. This deadspace pocket is equipped and staffed to service an entire fleet of ships in record time, whether it be armoring, hull modifications or other types of structural upgrades. The service is expensive, but extremely fast and reliable.

This surprisingly small drydock dispatches ships with great efficiency. Incredibly talented and exacting, the Angel ship builders charge exorbitant prices and thus most of their customers come from the wealthier end of the pilot spectrum.

A pilot who entered this pocket previously managed to give out only a brief distress signal before his ship was destroyed. The revived clone remembered nothing from the incident, which indicates the destruction happened almost instantly and most likely caused too much terror for the experience to register in his mind before it was coded and transmitted.

Angel_Cartel_Occupied_Mining_Colony.name: Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony
intro:
The Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony is a Cosmic Signature of the DED Complex (rated 4/10) type, occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

(Note - Tech 3 cruisers are not supported by the entrance gate)

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose: The entire pocket will auto-aggro in a few seconds, and the combined DPS is quite high. Well-tanked battlecruiser or pirate faction/heavy assault cruiser is advised. The Domination Excavator is marked with a battlecruiser icon but is an Overseer Cruiser. It has a fairly strong active tank which requires at least 250-300 Explosive DPS to safely break. Medium and heavy drones have no fun in this pocket as the rats tend to switch to attacking them in swarms and killing them quickly with high burst DPS.

rows.name: Domination Excavator
rows.note: Shield tank requires about 200-300 DPS to break
rows.cargo: Contains 8th Tier Overseers effects, May also contain Gistum C-Type Modules or Domination Modules. May also contain a Cynabal BPC.

notes.title: Music ('cause why not)
notes.text:
[https://soundcloud.com/ticondrius/minmatar001?in=ticondrius/sets/eve-online-gallente-deadspace First room]

[https://soundcloud.com/ticondrius/minmatar002?in=ticondrius/sets/eve-online-gallente-deadspace Second room]

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text:
Other Loot + Salvage 1.7M (16-March-2024)

~3.4M ISK in bounties

messages:
Despite numerous laws across the empires bolstering security regulations after the outbreak of Sansha incursions in YC 113, mining colonies still provide a weak, target-rich environment for pirate factions.
The Angel Cartel takes an unorthodox approach to these colonies, imprisoning the miners and replacing them with their own excavation teams, led by a Domination Excavator. The CDIA has yet to determine what the Cartel is after, though no significant amount of traditionally valuable ore has been taken. 
 DED Threat Assessment: Risky (4 of 10)

Excavator Detected:
I'm reading the presence of a Domination Excavator. Prepare yourself for a fight. Scientists or not, the Cartel only fields warships.
The Excavator has been eliminated. Whatever the Cartel was looking for, they won't get it now. Don't forget to rob the wreckage of delicious prizes.

Angel_Chemical_Lab.name: Angel Chemical Lab
intro: Angel Chemical Lab is a hacking site that can be scanned using Core Probes in the Heimatar region in Low Sec space. This site appears to Probes as a Gas Site rather than the typical hacking site. It is also defended by hostile NPC ships.

rows.name: Angel Chemical Laboratory
rows.cargo: Synth Sooth Sayer BPCs, Neurotoxin Control and Recovery skillbooks, Eifyr and Co. implants

messages: Masking the entrance of this facility by placing it within a large space wreck the Angels have successfully managed to establish a small chemical laboratory close to the gas cloud harvest they seek. Such facilities are used to refine and improve upon their booster formulas and are well protected.

Angel_Creo-Corp_Mining.name: Angel Creo-Corp Mining
intro:
Angel Creo-Corp Mining is a DED Complex (rated 2/10), occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec systems.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Cruiser class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only destroyer class ships including tech 2 and tech 3 destroyers.

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose: The acceleration gate is locked and requires key for operating it. The key is found in the wreck of Deadspace Synchronization HQ.

rows.name: Deadspace Synchronization HQ
rows.cargo: Key for the acceleration gate. 3th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. May contain Domination Items.

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose: The acceleration gate to next room is locked and requires key. The key is found in the wreck of CreoCorp Main Factory.

rows.name: CreoCorp Main Factory
rows.cargo: Key for the acceleration gate. 4th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. May contain Domination items.

rows.name: Tools and Parts (1)
rows.note: Has Fast regenerating shield, but armor and structure are very weak
rows.cargo: T1 Ammo.

rows.name: Tools and Parts (2)
rows.note: Has Fast regenerating shield, but armor and structure are very weak
rows.cargo: T1 Ammo.

rows.name: Asteroid Colony Tower
rows.note: Drops no loot. Very high (10K) armor and obscene (50k) structure HP

rows.name: Deadspace Control Station
rows.cargo: 5th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. May contain Gistii B-type Modules and/or a rare Dramiel BPC.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: This site is doable in a beam-laser-fit Punisher with good piloting, but destroyers are recommended due to high number of ships. Pirate Frigates will have no problems with this site, and a Tactical Destroyer will make this site laughably easy. Avoid using Amarr ships as they deal EM and Thermal damage, the strongest resists of the Angel rats.

messages: Creo-Corp purchases materials and know-how from the Minmatar to be able to build the most recently developed mining facilities. They routinely build automatic sentry guns for defense purposes.

In this deadspace pocket, Creo-Corp collects and stores spare parts and tools for use in the entire complex. The mining facilities in there are impressive, given the short time it has taken Creo-Corp to plan and build them.

This deadspace pocket contains plentiful resources of valuable ore as well as large asteroids that have already been mined to the core. The pocket is well guarded with stationary sentry guns, and a number of frigates patrol key locations.

Angel_Den.name: Angel Den
intro: The Angel Den is a combat anomaly found in Angel infested regions. Easily done with a Faction Cruiser such as a Gila.

Single open normal space pocket.

There are initially 2 x Sentry Angel Heavy Missile Battery. Another 2 will spawn in their place when they are destroyed. These deal 100% Explosive and have low resist to EM & Thermal

Angel_Domination_Fleet_Staging_Point.name: Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point
intro:
The Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point is an unrated cosmic signature site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Angel infested regions of Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from an Angel Forsaken Hub and 
Angel Forlorn Hub anomaly. The site is of medium difficulty, it can be done with a small fleet of Faction, T2 or T3 Cruisers or Battleships, but e.g. a single Ishtar can also do it.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: No hostiles on warpin.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to Angel Domination Fleet Staging Point 2

messages: The massive amount of signatures you are getting on your short range scan can only indicate one thing: a full combat fleet stationed around the deadspace pocket. The Angel Cartel would seem to be planning a large-scale military operation in the area and you should expect nothing but the heaviest resistance should you try to oppose them here.
The last Angel Cartel Battleship sends out a distress signal before it goes down. Luckily your coms system has managed to decrypt the message and track it to it's final destination.

Angel_Forlorn_Den.name: Angel Forlorn Den
intro: The Angel Forlorn Den is a combat anomaly found in Angel infested regions. It is a level 4 variant of the Angel Den. Easily done with sniper Dominix T2 fit.

pockets.title: Walkthrough
pockets.prose: Warping to beacon for close range would require a very good tank to handle the swarm’s incoming damage. Using a propulsion module or a Micro Jump Drive is recommended. Single ungated normal space pocket.

messages: Operating from the heart of the Curse region, the Angel Cartel is today the largest and best organized of the space-based criminal factions. The Angels are divided into several groups, each with a very special function; it is commanded by the Dominations. In the century they've been lurking in deep space, they have stolen, plundered, or sabotaged countless number of ships and kidnapped, assaulted, or murdered thousands of people. The Angels recruit members from all the races, and are thus not bound to any one zone of operation; instead, their reach spans almost the entire known universe. Many believe that the Angels got their power by uncovering Jovian technologies hidden in their ancient homeworlds, now infested by the Angel Cartel.

messages: Heuristic analysis of this location indicates that destroying the Angel Battlestation would greatly improve your odds of uncovering further illicit activity.

In the ruins of this Angel structure you come across some logs containing a report from a ship identified as "Angel of Death". The ship is reporting the progress of operation "Spring Cleaning", where a squadron of Angels roam around the region and wipe out anyone the they view as a threat to their domination in the area. This gang has obviously been busy the last days, the log contains long lists of "confiscated" materials, destroyed structures and recycled biomass, the last item presumably being a measure of how many people they have murdered in the process. The list is a bit vague when it comes to identifying exactly who is being killed, which target is yet to be taken out and where these places are, but you try to extract the specifics and feed it into your databanks, which then relay the info to various search engines and registers in the region in the hope of being able to pinpoint some of the locations. Soon you get feedback indicating where to find one of these places: a small research station where scientists from the Caille University have a field laboratory. Or at least had one.. if the Angels have not him them already, there is only one way to find out.

Angel Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Minmatar Republic or occupied by the Angel Cartel. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Angel Repurposed Outpost complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Angel Hidden Hideaway, Angel Forsaken Hideaway and Angel Forlorn Hideaway.

Not much here, except this empty warehouse. Perhaps the next location will reveal something more...

Nothing much here, except these empty warehouses. While flying here, your navigational systems have mulled over the other locations included in the report and reached the conclusion they are actually not coordinates, but encrypted dates. Who knows what purpose this document really had? In any case, you have no more steps to follow and no clue as to how to find them.

Again, a similar setup and this time you caught some bad guys in the act. Not that stealing from the Serpentis is necessarily "bad". Now if you only would find one of these hideouts where the Angels still store some booty. Perhaps the next location will lead you to something more interesting.

It's another hidden warehouse and this time a stiffer resistance. There is one location left and it should get interesting. Your computer grabs your attention, indicating that the route to the last location has been calculated.

The ethics involved in robbing this hapless band of Angels are are interesting. Robbing from thieves who stole from drug dealers who sold their drugs to people who robbed someone to afford them...You wonder how long it has been since the valuables in your cargo hold were in honest hands.

messages: This military complex belongs to the Angel Cartel, which sent a crew of their finest engineers and military personnel here to establish a mining complex. Unconfirmed DED reports state that the Cartel plans to use this complex to develop new weapons, as well as practice combat maneuvers and strategies away from prying eyes.

The rumour is that the building of this complex was only half-completed before the Angel Cartel's military operations started. Blasted asteroids and debris from reckless dogfighting litter these deadspace pockets. Caution is advised. Your transmission decoded flickers, a locator signal seemingly emanating from a typical container inside this deadspace pocket. Other transmissions indicate that some kind of a disaster has struck and a massive explosion knocked communications offline a while ago.
Available data indicates that this deadspace complex pocket was supposed to contain the first deadspace Stargate. Reports indicate that the Angel Cartel was not successful.

The Angel Cartel has established a well fortified supply depot with a lot of troops stationed in military bunkers. A scout mission revealed that the battlestation in the center is not fully operational and supposedly serves as supply management HQ and storage facilities.
Tactical operations in the entire deadspace complex are coordinated and handled from here. The batlestation is reported to be well defended.

The Outer Perimeter Watchpost is on the outskirts of the deadspace area. Despite the protection the warp-free space offers, the Angel Cartel nonetheless monitors the area closely. A CONCORD diplomatic committee is negotiating an information-sharing deal to relieve tension.
A scouting mission spotted the so-called "underground Overseer" before warping out under heavy fire.

The innermost deadspace pocket in the Angel military complex has received a lot of expensive high quality minerals. Ready-made building blocks are steadily freighted in, but there have been no reports of what they are actually building.

Full room aggro on warp-in. You can blitz this pocket by shooting the triggers, but expect high incoming damage. Highest bounty battleship will trigger the next spawn. All waves will spawn on the Rent-a-Dream Pleasure Garden structure that is roughly 40 km from warp-in.

Hashi Keptzh has active shield tank which needs 450+ DPS Explosive damage to crack. He does 495 DPS Kin/EM with 21 km range turrets, and 450 DPS Explosive damage with 34 km range torpedoes, though they have poor application to non-battleships. He uses MWD to close in on you at 1000m/s and will apply -90% web within 15 km, making kiting outside of his web range extremely important. Shooting from ~30km away seems to be the safest option as he will rarely use MWD at 30km range and under.

messages: This hidden outpost seems to have played a vital role in the Angel Cartel's expansion in the area. The fact that this operation is now history surely slows down whatever plans the Cartel had. Among one of the wreckages you locate co-ordinates for an energy harvesting facility nearby. Whether you explore it or not is your decision.

The amount of energy harvested and stored here is phenomenal. Exploiting these facilities for your own use might sound tempting, if it weren't for the fact that the entire place is in complete lockdown and only the highest-level Angel security codes will grant access.
You did however manage to gain access to one an open channel in the Angel communication network, and two energy storage locations were revealed to you.

This facility was not just used for energy storage. Ships, modules and other supplies were stored in those containers, and sadly every single one was destroyed when the Angel commanders gave the order. The Angels knew you were coming, and there was little they could do about it on such short notice. The slaughter continues as you prepare to visit the second energy storage facility.

You arrive at the second energy storage facility to find it completely deserted. It looks like the party ended before you even arrived. Luckily for you, your computers pick up several signals in the nearby area, one of which seems to have unusually high amounts of combat ships.

You have destroyed four strategically vital locations for the Angel Cartel. Their expansion in the area has been halted severely, and it would surprise you a lot if you saw even a single one of them in the near future. Whether to continue this journey is up to you, though you have no more clues which could lead you further.

Angel_Vigil.name: Angel Vigil
intro: Angel Vigil is a unrated combat site that can be found via exploration by scanning down signatures with scanner probes in high-security systems. Its gate allows Battlecruisers or smaller to enter, and a (well equipped) Battlecruiser or HAC is suggested to bring into the site. (Addition: after completing in a Hurricane Dooobles notes that resists over 60% exp/kinetic, robust T2 tank with substantial buffer, exp/kinetic dmg dealing, web, and tracking gear are ESSENTIAL; the incoming damage is very high and the mobs kite.) The largest ship allowed to enter is a Command Ship (T2 Battlecruiser).

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose: The gate in the first room can be unlocked either by using an Angel Gold Tag or by killing the Gistatis Smuggler Commander in the Gate Spawn. It is possible to trigger the Gate Spawn preemptively by shooting the smuggler gate.

rows.name: Pat Wead (Domination Depredator)
rows.cargo: Faction modules and T2 salvage, possible implants

notes.title: Strategy
notes.text:
Before shooting any tower, focus on lowering the number of enemies in the pocket. The incoming damage is quite substantial so something with a decent tank, or warp-outs are necessary. You will be webbed down to ~10% velocity or less (14.0 m/s in a BC), so speed tanking isn't possible. After the area is cleared of most of the enemies, shoot one of the stasis towers. This pocket can easily become tank-melting if you target the turrets before clearing the initial ships. After all the turrets are gone and everything's dead, shoot 'Pat's Shipyard' for the final spawn and kill him off. There are multiple cargo containers in the pocket (containing a small amount of ammo, one had faction ammo). A large number of Veldspar asteroids are in this pocket. 

Pat Wead dropped a Low-Grade Halo Beta when I ran this. (*Pat Wead drop for Dooobles Sept 22, 2010 - Domination 220mm autocannon, Domination Copper tag, 1000 Angel faction ammo)

-Update 15 Feb 23 - Pat Wead dropped Mid-grade Halo Omega (valued at 329M isk, 220M isk Jita).

Blitzing this pocket is possible but fairly impractical. Shoot Pat's Shipyard and kill Pat. You will probably want to kill all initial ships as you will be moving at the snail's pace of 14 m/s and the damage will be significant. Then kill stasis towers and Wave B. Ignoring missile turrets and Wave A will still allow you to complete the site and qualify for a potential escalation.

Blitz info edit:
As stated above you only need to shoot the smugglers gate in the first pocket once to spawn gate keeper (smuggler commander) and the gate is open once he is destroyed. Do it quickly as his DPS is quite high.

In second room I suggest heading towards Pat's shipyard (obviously slowly due to webs) and take out the dessies and cruisers first (remove the dps). Once they are gone, shoot the shipyard to spawn Pat's wave as the bc's and Pat's wave don't have enough DPS to break a decent tank. Destroy the weed frigates and bc's while you wait for Pat to get closer. Once Pat is close, take him out and scoop wreck, and hopefully receive escalation. While slow boating to wreck (which is usually only 5000m away if done correctly) shoot other ships at your discretion - but never the towers. I find this easy to do in a Loki with a DC2, Anti-Explosive Shield Hardener 2, shield boost amp 2 and med shield booster running. Even though it seems a slow way to do the mission, it is still faster than shooting everything.

Besieged_Covert_Research_Facility.name: Besieged Covert Research Facility
intro:
﻿

The Besieged Covert Research Facility is a Mordu's Legion combat anomaly. It can be found in any region of empire space, but only in Low Security systems. They are the only normal combat anomaly that can spawn in Faction warfare systems.

You will need:
* a ship that can sustain fire from up to five Battleships, a passive buffer Gila with Vespa and Kin/Therm resists can do this site in approx. 10-12 mins.
* a Stealth Bomber with an oversized afterburner and missile precision enhancers. This method relies completely on speed tanking and cannot absorb more than one or two lucky hits from the battleships, and necessitates Tech II torpedo fits and high navigation skills to reliably complete the sites. Requires at least 500 DPS (Kinetic) to complete.

Tips:
* No faction standing penalty for killing Mordu's ships.
* All ships fly up to 380m/s
* All ships have active shield tank
* Kinetic is the best damage to both deal and resist.
* The Cruiser's missiles deal Kinetic damage
* The Battleship's high accuracy and infinite range Thermal/Kinetic/EM turrets deal 350 damage per shot, while their cruise missiles deal 900 Kinetic damage per shot.
* The Commander's turrets deal all damage types, but have poor tracking; and their 54 km range torpedoes deal Kinetic damage
* On paper, the highest possible incoming DPS is 1040 (170 EM, 250 Thermal, 620 Kinetic) with 5 Battleships, before taking into account resists and relative signature radius.

You should deal Kinetic damage because:
* The Cruiser is weak to EM, but has low HP so high Kinetic volley damage can still kill it quickly
* The Battleship's shields are weak to EM and armor is weak to Explosive, but the lowest average resistance is Thermal with Kinetic at close second
* The Commander has the highest EHP of the three ships but its weakest average resistance is Kinetic

You should also put emphasis on primarily resisting Kinetic damage (while maintaining omni tank) since the cruiser lacks turrets and its missiles deal purely Kinetic damage, while the battleships output more DPS in Kinetic than all other damage types combined.

pockets.title: Warp in
pockets.prose:
Single deadspaced pocket. You cannot warp around.

The site is empty at first and remains that way until a player enters within 50 km of the Guristas Research and Trade Hub, even if they are cloaked. Wave 1 spawns within a few seconds after the proximity trigger, indicated by a message in local.

None of the NPCs drop any loot, though the Mordu’s Legion Commander has a bounty of 900k ISK.

There is no trigger ship. The Second Wave will warp in seconds after you destroy the last ship in the wave.

Tracking value of turrets is 7, in line with long-ranged cruiser turrets. Missile attacks have damage application of one size class lower (heavy missiles) 

The main value of the site comes from the Guristas Research and Trade Hub. The Thukker Component Assembly Facility only drops one or two Covert Research Tools, some minerals and possibly a rare Thukker Component Technical Data Chip that can contain Thukker Upwell structure rig blueprints.

If the site isn't cleared within 20 minutes after Wave 1 spawns, the structures, along with any loot inside them, will explode (though the explosions don't deal damage to your ship), and the site is considered failed. Any remaining rats on grid will instantly despawn.

* Low and Mid-Grade implant drops of the following sets: Virtue, Nomad, Centurion, Talisman, Halo, Amulet, Harvest, Hydra, Crystal, Savior, Edge, Asklepian, Snake, Wedge
* Blueprint copies for Hyperspatial Accelerators, Jump Drive Economizers and any of the implants listed above
* Minerals, in stacks of 10 (from the Thukker Component Assembly Facility) excluding Morphite
* Thukker Capital Component Manufacturing Technical Data Chip, which can be opened to receive Thukker manufacturing rig blueprints for Upwell structures 

Loot will usually average between 15-40M ISK per site with some variance through implant and BPC drops, which can jack up the loot value to well over 300M. Lowest loot drop seen was around 6M, so it may be a good idea to warp in at long range to the site and cargo scan the Guristas Research and Trade Hub to see if the site is worth running, since the rewards are highly variable.

As you come out of acceleration you notice the resemblance of a spatial rift in the distance.
Gist Relay Commander: They've found the portal! Destroy them before they escape!
Upon attacking the Gist Relay Commander
As the Relay Commander is attacked, he calls for backup! More hostile ships are incoming!
Upon attacking the Gist Relay Commander
As the Relay Commander is attacked, he calls for backup! More hostile ships are incoming!

A large force of drones has taken up residence in this area. They obviously benefit greatly from salvaging the remnants of the former inhabitants, which still litters this patch of space. A drone presence this large could not be formed without an abundance of raw materials.
Upon destroying one of the missile batteries
Drones have been deployed from the Drone Bunkers in response to the attack on the sentry guns!
Someone has triggered an ancient land mine! All ships inside the blast radius take damage.

The source of the drone infestation seems to lie in this deadspace pocket, located inside a fiery nebula. The extreme and hostile environment, accompanied by a very heavy drone presence, seems to have kept most of the looters away, as two fully intact ancient ruins would indicate.
The Drone Hive Mother has deployed Drone Cruise Missile Batteries along with more drone ships!
Drones have emerged from the nearby bunkers to defend the Hive Mother!
Drones have emerged from the nearby bunkers to defend the Hive Mother!
Drones have emerged from the nearby bunkers to defend the Hive Mother!
In local (upon destroying the Hive Mother)

The Hive Mother has been eliminated, and the buzz of drone communications slowly calms down. Some drones machines may still be active, but at least their numbers will no longer be replenished by the frenzied replication process inside the Drone Mother.
Someone has gone too close to one of the ruins and triggered an ancient hidden explosive. Energy and material spurts in all directions, and all ships caught in the blast radius take damage!

messages: To your surprise, the Overseer seems to have spent the last moments of his life sending some message to your ship on a private channel, a fact you learn from a blinking entry on your communication panel a few seconds after his innards slid across your windshield, bounced along your fuselage and were sucked into your thrusters. It appears he wanted to save his life by telling you the whereabouts of some place you could load your cargohold with riches, but before he could get very far with his offer, his journey ended. All you have is some hysteric babble about a hidden mining station at a certain location.
Among the things you find are a few drones. Running a scan on their control units reveals they have been used not long ago, at another place not far away from here.

All these moon mining stations suggest there must be a station or outpost somewhere in the region servicing them and refining the raw materials they produce. Again you look for clues from the drones and again the data you extract suggest a new location not too far away.

Going through data scanned during the destruction of the station itself, you notice reports from a place called "R&D division Red", containing information on blueprint research and booster production and even the location of this base "Red".

Now, you kind of regret killing the Overseer back there, it is always useful to know corrupt leaders who are ready to sell out things like this outpost in exchange for something as cheap as their own petty lives.

Blood_Provincial_HQ.name: Blood Provincial HQ
intro: Blood Provincial HQ is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Null security systems with Blood Raider presence.

pockets.prose: The acceleration gate deeper into the complex is locked until the Gate Security Outpost is destroyed. Alternatively, a Blood Crystal Tag can be used to skip the room (the tag is consumed on use).

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose:
The Siege Beam Laser Sentries deal a total of about 200 DPS of omni damage with a slant towards EM and Thermal damage. They fire every 15-16 seconds.

The Arena Sentinel has a very strong -75% web that reaches out to 50 km. It fires Citadel EM torpedoes that deal approximately 1500 EM damage every 18 seconds. It also has a very strong active shield and armor tank that requires at least 1000 DPS to break.

rows.name: Arena Sentinel
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements at different damage intervals

rows.name: Elder Corpum Priest/Sage/Revenant
rows.note: Elder Corpum Revenant neuts and tracking disrupts

rows.name: Dark Blood Cardinal/Patriarch
rows.cargo: May contain Dark Blood faction modules or a Bhaalgorn BPC

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
The first room is largely straightforward; a well-tanked T3 Cruiser or Battleship can do it fairly easily. The second room is much harder to solo due to strong webbing, neuting and fairly high DPS. If your ship does not have the ~1000 DPS required to destroy the Arena Sentinel structure in the second room, recommend bringing a friend for this site.

Warping to the site lands you on an acceleration gate that permits up to T2 Battleships.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to Fountain of Youth.

messages:
More Corpus ships appear when the security outpost is attacked!
Blood Gate Guardian: Not again! I just finished repairing that damn security outpost. I want a raise!
More Corpus ships have arrived to defend the Arena Sentinel!
More Corpus ships have arrived to defend the Arena Sentinel!
More Corpus ships have arrived to defend the Arena Sentinel!
Streams of electric particles spew out of the Arena Sentinel's hull as it nears the final moment of its existence.

As the dust settles from the battle, you receive a transmission from someone claiming to be a local vigilante who congratulates you on a job well done. Your computers run a check on his ship ID's and other info they can gather on him in such a short period of time, but come up with nothing. He appears to represent neither a pirate faction nor one of the empires. This person continues to welcome you to the area and offers to point you to some other Blood bases he knows about and have been a menace for the local population. If you want to come and meet him, he will lead the way.

Single ungated pocket.

The cans can be hacked and looted without killing any of the defenders.

Reinforcements arrive once the ships from initial defenders are destroyed.

Notable structures

Blood_Raider_Coordination_Center.name: Blood Raider Coordination Center
intro: Blood Raider Coordination Center is a null security DED 7/10 site found through exploration.

rows.name: Dark Blood Sage
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules

rows.name: Dark Blood Cardinal
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules

pockets.title: 5th pocket
pockets.prose: You land ~60km from the tower and it webs you at that range. It has low health, but when you're webbed you're going to be taking a lot of damage. In an armour ratting Ishtar, I used warrior drones to kill the tower, due to their speed, and overheated tank and prop during this time, as well as aligning out. I had a DCU2 fitted rather than an ADC, though. I believe that the site despawns a certain amount of time after you kill the Dark Blood Hunter, but you may not have enough time to kill that guy if you leave the tower up.

rows.name: Dark Blood Hunter
rows.cargo: 20th tier OPE. Can drop Corpus C-type Modules and Bhaalgorn BPC.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: Upon warping to the site you will arrive at an acceleration gate. It's possible to do this site in a ratting Ishtar but may take 3 hours to do in that manner.

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: Bounty for this site is about 65-70 million isk.

messages:
The Blood Raider Covenant is infamous for its organized strike capabilities. It is no surprise, then, that Blood Raider coordination centers are a common encounter for capsuleer and DED forces in nullsec. Numerous battle reports support the theory that each complex serves as a primary base for a Dark Blood Hunter, a specialist in tracking, subduing, and harvesting the biomass of capsuleers.

Because of the Blood Hunter's influence, the threat to civilian and Imperial assets posed by such coordination centers has been on the decline. The DED is more than willing to leave the Blood Hunters as a capsuleers' problem.

DED Threat Assessment: 7 of 10

Blood_Raider_Fortress.name: Blood Raider Fortress
intro: Blood Raider Fortress is an Unrated Complex found in null security systems with Blood Raider presence. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site through the initial acceleration gate.

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose:
All three groups of NPCs are initially passive until attacked.

The acceleration gate to the next pocket is 25 km from warp-in. All defenders must be destroyed to use it.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all defenders are destroyed

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose:
Large number of ships. Close proximity of spawns means that incoming damage can be quite high.
 
Destroy Dark Blood commander battleship to trigger escalation. Alternatively destroy the Blood Raider Battlestation to trigger escalation. Note that it has around 200k EHP and may take a long time to destroy.

rows.name: Blood Raider Battlestation
rows.cargo: T1 ammo, meta modules

rows.name: Dark Blood Apostle/Oracle

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: Destroying either the Dark Blood commander or the Blood Raider Battlestation can escalate the site to Dubious Assignment.

messages: As the bits and pieces from the disintegrated station charge into space, carrying the news of heightened entropy in the universe, your instruments receive an unusual message. It obviously is being transmitted from a Blood Raider ship and even though the person on the other end does not introduce himself as such, there is no doubt that this voice originates in a throat honed for the chilly, whispering and emotionless manner of speaking which is so typical for old timers within the Blood Raider Covenant. He demands talking in a closed channel and after you have established one, he continues with some congratulations on your brave victory and then he gives you an offer; If you go to three different locations he provides, assassinate the Blood leaders operating there and gather all loot you find for him, he will pay you one billion ISK. He then gives you coordinates to a location in a "take it or leave it" manner, before saying farewell and adds that he will contact you after this first target is destroyed.

Blood_Raider_Human_Farm.name: Blood Raider Human Farm
intro: Blood Raider Human Farm is a DED rated complex that can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in high and low security space.

rows.name: Dark Blood Keeper
rows.cargo: 6th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and possibly Corpii B-Type modules, faction modules

messages: For many people, the so-named "human farm" is the single most terrifying aspect of the Covenant's legend: an extensive facility, often spanning several pockets of deadspace, where captured human beings are harvested for their blood, sustained in a weakened state on endless treadmills of excruciating torment. While some choose to disbelieve that such places exist, the facts of the matter unfortunately speak for themselves.

Blood_Raider_Intelligence_Collection_Poi.name: Blood Raider Intelligence Collection Point

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: Update 06 Feb 2023 - Site Dark Blood Alpha dropped 450M isk (Rare) in Corpii A-Type and Dark Blood modules.

messages: On warp in: Information - DED Database Expert

Between their extreme religious views and their fixation on capsuleer blood, it can be easy to forget the "raider" part of the Blood Raider Covenant. Blood Raider wolf packs are a deadly reminder of this. 
Should any CONCORD or otherwise friendly vessel encounter a raiding party, it is recommended that any Dark Blood Alpha encountered be eliminated on sight. 
DED Threat Assessment: Unsafe (3 of 10)
Those big ships were brought down by a well-organized group of small frigates. Wolf pack tactics. Expect more fighting.
On warp in: Information - Alpha Detected
The Dark Blood Alpha is based in the next pocket. Removing its influence will prevent these raids from reaching further.
Upon Dark Blood Alpha death: Information - Alpha Eliminated

The Dark Blood Alpha has been destroyed. 
The Covenant really should learn not to mess with capsuleers. 
Don't forget to search the wreckage for modules.

Blood_Raider_Naval_Shipyard.name: Blood Raider Naval Shipyard

The final room deals incredible amounts of EM and Thermal damage and should not be taken lightly.

Destroy the Blood Raider Fleet Stronghold for the loot, other NPCs can be ignored if you can tank them for long enough and then escape.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
The Complex consists of three rooms. All these rooms have serious numbers of battleships, cruisers and frigates inside them. The third room contains an overseer structure, which when destroyed has a chance of dropping Corpus X-Type or Dark Blood modules and a Bhaalgorn BPC. The structure also always drops 23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects.

The complex contains many normal battleship NPCs Renamed as "Dark Corpus", however they are not faction and drop nothing of value.

messages: Incoming Transmission You are entering the Blood Raider Covenant's Naval Shipyard. Despite its relatively small size, many consider it to be the single most heavily guarded illegal military outpost in existence, and definitely the largest ever built by the Blood Raiders.

messages:
The amount of energy harvested and stored here is phenomenal. Exploiting these facilities for your own use might sound tempting if it weren't for the fact that the entire place is in complete lock-down; only the highest-level Blood Raider security codes will grant access.

You did, however, manage to gain access to one an open channel in an unsecure communication network, and two energy storage locations were revealed to you.

This facility was not just used for energy storage. Ships, modules and other supplies were stored in those containers, and sdly every single one was destroyed when the Blood commanders gave the order. They knew you were coming, and there was little they could do about on such short notice. The slaughter continues as you prepare to visit the second energy storage facility.

Blood_Raider_Psychotropics_Depot.name: Blood Raider Psychotropics Depot
intro: This site is usually found in low security space with Blood Raider presence, but it can be received as an escalation from the Blood Den.

rows.name: Exsanguinator

messages:
The Blood Raider Covenant, although not traditionally associated with drug running, maintains deep ties with the psychotropics trade. Unfortunate test subjects, harvested from the Covenant's pirate activities, are subjected to a variety of tests using these drugs. The exact purpose of these tests is still unknown. Any Covenant psychotropic depots found should be eliminated. 
 DED Threat Assessment: Dangerous (5 of 10)"
The Blood Raiders are taking no chances. Instead of just setting up a defense fleet, they've erected a massive defense platform and appointed an Exsanguinator to run it.
Not just any cultist can become one of the Blood Raiders' elite Exsanguinators. There has to be something of extraordinary value somewhere in that wreck.

They have high armor and structure hitpoints, though, so your ship should be able to deal enough DPS to break them quickly. There are a lot of elite frigates in this room which like to target drones, so watch them and recall them if necessary.

The first section is ungated, so capitals can be brought in. Past the acceleration gate, though, only T2 Battleships and below are allowed to enter.

Motoh himself has a very powerful MWD, making it possible to separate him from the group. Just overheat your guns to destroy Moka (the building) and warp out. messages: The station databanks contain information on the local Blood Covenant security network and among it; a location of yet another station similar to this one. That is your best clue as to where the ships that fled as you entered have gone.

To your dismay, the main computers of this station took a direct hit during your assault and any information that might have been there is gone up in smoke. However, your instruments ran through the data from the fleeing ships and have come up with this location as a suggestion to where they might have warped.

It looks like the most interesting of these Blood ships got away during the fight. Luckily for you though, one of its communication devices seems to be malfunctioning and is for no apparent reason sending out a constant stream of thumping sounds. Your instruments have no problems tracing where it is coming from. It is an extremely irritating sound. Aggrivating too. The thumping of doom.

messages: Previous explorers have commented that one of the gates requires a passkey. Alternatively, it can be bypassed by convincing the commander to unlock it. The overseer guards the Cathedral vigorously.
Cathedral Priest: The infidels are here! Defend the cathedral with your lives, brethren.
Corpior Militant Commander: Who dares interrupt the Blood Games? I'll have your head on a platter and personally deliver it to the Overlord for your impudence.
The destruction of the Militant Commander has activated a mechanism inside the nearby acceleration gate. It now appears to be unlocked.
Heuristic analysis of this location indicates that attacking the Blood Raider Cathedral would greatly improve your odds of uncovering further illicit activity.
The Corpus Militant Overseer and his cohorts have undocked from the Cathedral.
Corpus Militant Overseer: You dare attack our place of reverence! You shall be punished for this blasphemous act, infidels!

The slaves you liberated from this Blood facility report that this was a holding place where slaves were gathered, before being sent off to a blood replenishing "medical" station. You have heard about those places; where the Blood members go to get their blood exchanged with the blood of a slave who has been put on a special "blood cleansing" diet for a period of time. Needless to say, this leaves the poor slave empty of the vital fluid in question. Understandably your newfound slaves are quite thrilled with these recent turn of events. None of them knows where this so called "medical" station is, but a couple can tell you that they were in another holding station like this one, before they came here and coincidentally it is not all that far away ...

On warp in launch your light scout drones to clear the ships close to you. While clearing the first enemies, make sure to burn away from the other groups to gain time. Be careful not to kill the "Elder Corpii Spy Drone" as it triggers the next wave. As it webs you careful watch on your drones is required. Once you have moved far enough away, kill the "Elder Corpii Spy Drone". As the next wave spawns, retrieve your light scout drones and launch sentry drones. You should now be able to pick off the remaining waves using your sentry drones without problems.

Since you will likely be armor tanked, you can stay close to the enemies and pick them off. Avoid destroying the "Elder Corpii Spy Drones" until all other enemies are cleared, then destroy them to trigger the next wave. Make sure not to trigger several waves at once, as DPS output will become very high. When the Militant Commander spawns, only kill the Corpatis Militant Commander then take the acceleration gate.
For the second room, clear the room of rats before engaging the Blood Raider Cathedral. Make sure to stay as far away from it as possible to evade incoming damage. After aggressing the Cathedral, only kill the Corpus Militant Supervisor to trigger the commander wave. Then kill the Dark Blood commander that spawns, bookmark his wreck, and warp out and back in later to collect the loot.

messages: While fighting the last defenders of this hideout, you noticed three of their ships warp out and disappear from radar. Your navigational computer has had a few minutes now to mull over the data they left and has come up with a probable destination in case you want to chase them.

It seems like the weird sound once in a while coming from your left dashboard is not from the navigation computer after all, at least it seems to have calculated the whereabouts of these Angel frigates pretty accurately. Not accurately enough though as they warp out as soon as you enter space and your instruments come up with a best approximation for their next destination.
Again you warp in to far and the Angels slip away into space. Luckily they leave a predictable path.

While fighting the two ships you managed to catch up with, the third one got away. Your instruments give no clue as to where it was headed, but just before it vanished, you picked up a distress signal from it, containing this location...

messages: Going through the items found in the Serpentis outpost, you notice some unused boosters still in their original packs complete with documentation and bear the seal of the Serpentis Corporation. The documentation notes further that these boosters as "Field Test" material and not for common consumption and at the bottom there is ordering info, stating item number and the makers electronic address. Feeling it is worth a shot, you set your communication instruments to emulate those of the Serpentis facility you just laid to waste, feed in the booster factory addy and hit send. And lo and behold, you get an instant reply, a sleepy sounding female voice says "SC medical research 504, good day. How may I help you? Oh! It is Vigil 15? I have a message for you from the supply office, they say you are late. Get to G5, pick up the materials and get here as soon as possible" She adds information on the location and tells you to talk to Nadir, also at G5 if there is anything. And with that she is off the air.

Suddenly the channel comes alive with the Serpentis lady from the medical station again. "SCmr504 to Vigil 15, divert to a new location, we have news of pirate activity at G5, confirm please!" You broadcast a reply with the identification from the one of the ships you destroyed back at the Serpentis Vigil station, which seems to be sufficient for her; she says that you should stay off the air for security reasons and that she will contact you soon again with further instructions.

Suddenly the channel comes alive with the Serpentis lady from the medical station again. "SCmr504 to Vigil 15, divert to a new location, we have news of pirate activity at G5, confirm please!" You broadcast a reply with the identification from the one of the ships you destroyed back at the Serpentis Vigil station, but it must have been invalid or outdated, because she spits some curses at you and vanishes.
Message on attacking Core Lord Admiral
Mayday! Mayday G6 industrial group being attacked by pirates!

Again your radio comes alive with the voice of this femme serpentia "This is an important security announcement, all ships in G5, G6, G8 and G9: evacuate immediately to a new location and wait for security forces to escort you back to base." It seems like your little enterprise has made the local division of the Serpentis organization a bit confused, perhaps they are not used to be the hunted. This message was a bit troubling though... you can expect two whole gas mining teams and a security team of an undisclosed size. You need to be more careful here...
Again your radio comes alive with the voice of this femme serpentia "This is an important security announcement, all ships in G5, G6, G8 and G9: evacuate immediately and return to base."

You follow the coming and going of the Serpentis who are seemingly unaware there is an enemy amongst them. When they start warping out again, you position your scanners, let your instruments run a tracking routine, sit back and hope for the best. And you win! The probability of loosing s simple destination track on a fleet like this is according to your instruments around 23100 to one, and you managed to do exactly that. You make a mental note to buy a ticket in The Forge Lottery the next time you are up in Jita.

You follow the coming and going of the Serpentis who are seemingly unaware there is an enemy amongst them. When they start warping out again, you position your scanners, let your instruments run a tracking routine, sit back and hope for the best. And yes, you do indeed get a feedback indicating a location not too far away as their destination. If they have stuck their plans, this should be the site of the Serpentis medical research facility!

messages: On warpin; Crimson Hand Advance Intelligence and Narcotics (CHAIN)

From the time they first appeared in this area, the Crimson Hand’s operatives have been tied to countless kidnappings, assaults and murders. These crimes usually involve low-life drug addicts and other social rejects whose absence few people notice or care about. In order to supplement funding for increased military expansion, the Crimson Hand is also rumored to have sanctioned low-security narcotics peddling. It seems the Hand is bolstering not only their wallets but also the number of people crewing their ships and slaving away deep in their null-sec strongholds.
High-value, no-nonsense customers know these stories all too well and don’t push things if they’re smart. In return for their patronage they receive top quality service and deals on Mindflood boosters that nobody can match.

messages:
This deadspace complex bestows a heavily guarded prison facility of the Angel Cartel. It is here that kidnapping victims and enemies of the cartel are held for ransom or brutal interrogation and torture.

DED Threat Assessment: Perilous (8 of 10)
This first pocket within the deadspace field contains the main gates to this Angel Cartel prison complex, defended by a pair of experienced frigate pilots.

This area of the complex handles the traffic of incoming (and sometimes outgoing) prisoners. The pocket is well defended by a small but powerful Angel fleet. The resident jailor holds control over who is allowed further inside the complex, through the traffic gate towards the prison battlements.

This heavily guarded pocket bestows the prison battlements and a massive fleet of Angel vessels that see to it that no one can escape from within the retention core. The acceleration gate that takes prison transport ships into the main Prisoner block is scrambled by a scramble wave generator to keep the gate closed at almost all times.

This deepest section of the complex houses the prisoner block. Fully outfitted with a bloodsport arena, the Angel Cartel Prison Guards pitch their unsuspecting captives into brutal Darwinian games where only the strongest and fittest survive to tell the tale. The block is guarded by an experienced combat fleet, not to be taken lightly.

As long as you immediately begin moving quickly upon landing in the pocket its damage is survivable. Theoretically it deals upwards of 500,000 EM damage with each shot but the torpedoes have capital-ship sized damage application (10,000m), and they are fired extremely slowly (every 120 seconds).

messages:
The Centus Assembly T.P. Co. deadspace complex is run by Sansha's True Power corporation. Mineral storage facilities and naval shipyards are hidden behind powerful defenses in the outer pockets.
Commander Chelm Soran is responsible for security in the Assembly, although he is rarely present himself.

DED Threat Assessment: 10 of 10

This is the first guarded deadspace pocket of a total of 5 reported in this complex.
Commander Chelm Soran's top enforcers organize deadspace security from the command HQ.

Centus Assembly's Reprocessing Station is located within the 2nd deadspace pocket.
The precious minerals are heavily guarded by elite units that ferry them to the assembly line when needed.

Sansha's Nation assembles its ships in the factories in this deadspace pocket. Operations are controlled from the Assembly Management HQ.
The most advanced modules and ship parts are not produced here, but within the fourth deadspace pocket.

In the Centus Manufacturing Plant, the True Power corporation manufactures Tech II-level components for its vessels.
Dedicated engineering squads are guarded by elite Centus Sansha pilots and experienced crews.
The most advanced modules and ship parts are not produced here, but within the fourth deadspace pocket.

Reports claim this deadspace pocket houses one of True Power's most prized possessions - The "Station Ultima" Research & Development Facilities.
What they are working on is still very much a secret, but in any case it is rumored that True Power's CEO, Vizan Ankonin, himself occasionally visits the facilities to oversee production.

messages: Here the pirates have ditched one of their damaged frigates, you manage to enter its navigation systems and retrieve the last entered coordinates.

You made a short story of this feeble ambush, but now it is obvious the pirates know you are on their trail! While you are fighting, your scanners analyze and compare the information you receive from the enemy ships to your onboard databanks. It is clear that some of these ships are carrying prisoners.
This distraction maneuver seems to have succeeded. While you were busy expediting this ambush the pirates disappeared, their main force seems to have vanished into thin air.

Enemy analysis report indicates that you are close to a drug distributor conditioning unit, where Angels are known to bring kidnapped persons from neighboring systems, make them addicted to various drugs, brainwash and train them as drug dealers, before sending them back to their home. Your best chance to beat these pirates is to get to the remaining ships before they reach their destination.

Surprisingly the Angels chose to stay and defend this vile place to their last ship. Even though you didn't manage to rescue any of their captives, this installation will not be of any use to the pirates for a long time and looking at it in a clinical way, this end is probably for the best for everyone as the human wrecks this place produced will not be spreading the pleasures of doom to untold thousands of people throughout this region.

messages: Serpentis Altac Scout: Send me the secret password NOW. I'm warning you ...
Clues within the wreckage of the ship hint at where it's from: another Serpentis station. More an outpost than a station perhaps, but it is a pure military outfit, not a regular colony.

Again you let your scanner comb the remains of the station and the ships, looking for clues on this alleged raid, and before long you are holding a log listing the second rally spot and as far as you can see, the raiding parties have already departed form here and two other stations and are supposed to convene within the hour. If one of the raiding parties was supposed to come from the Serpentis station you destroyed originally, you have already managed to diminish their forces somewhat.

A fixed guidance beacon sitting here all alone.. you examine the thing and discover its guidance system points to a place not too far away. Perhaps that is the space trucker station? In any case, that is the only clue you have to follow, if the pirates have ever been here, they have gone already.
Black Ceasar has been torn to pieces, and the Serpentis have scattered back to the darkness from whence they came.

pockets.title: Contract Killers - Part 2
pockets.prose:
The room is ungated, meaning you can warp around in it, and people can warp directly to you.

Take care of the NPCs but ignore the factory, as although it may look like an overseer structure it doesn't actually drop any deadspace items other than random contraband. The factory reps shield and armor so you will need around 1500dps just to break the tank. It fires Citadel torpedos which are relatively weak and can be tanked easily. The factory webs you up to 50km out.

The next stage is to shoot the structure named "Serpentis Drug Lab". To clarify, this is not the structure that shoots you or repairs itself. This will trigger another wave of ships about 160-180k from the beacon.

One battleship is named "Quertah Bleu", and is the overseer for the site. He moves very quickly and hits for a fair amount of damage and has exceptional tracking and damage application against fast moving targets. His tank, however, is nothing special. He is extremely fast and can be kited away from the rest of the wave easily, allowing you to kill and loot him.

A message will be broadcast in local:

Take him out and you'll get a message:

Note: (The player who receives aggro from the Serpentis Drug Factory can keep it at range of at least 60km. In this instance the Drug Factory will still rep its shields but will cease to repair its armor and will be much easier to take down. All other players assisting can keep the Drug Factory at preferred range as long as the player who receives aggro from the factory keeps it at 60km. Factory does not switch targets.)

rows.name: Serpentis Drug Factory
rows.note: webs up to 50. Armor don't repairs when you are 60+. Drops nothing

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Rear Admiral
rows.cargo: Faction modules. Some sources says implants, deadspace and BPCs

blocks.title: Quertah Bleu Spawn - When drug lab receives damage

rows.name: Quertah Bleu
rows.cargo: Possible Core C-Type modules and a possible Vigilant/Vindicator BPC

rewards.title: Loot Table
rewards.text:
Quertah may drop Core C-types, and possibly a Vigilant BPC. Salvage from wreck is Tech 1.
Quertah can also drop a 1-run Vindicator BPC.

messages: During the fight, you picked up a transmission from one of the station houses: someone is ordering someone else not to warp in. The message is answered a couple of times with this "someone else" demanding a reason for the change of plans until he is told in no uncertain terms to shut up and stay off the air. By that time your instruments have managed to pinpoint where the transmission is coming from.

Someone once described a Mindflood trip like if you managed to blow your brains out shooting both barrels of a double-barreled shotgun at the same time. With this place gone, a lot of junkies in the region will have to resort to the latter, if they want a fix.

intro:
The Core Runner Drop Production Facility is a chemical lab found in the Cloud Ring region. It must be scanned down with scanner probes, and will appear as a gas site in the probe window. 
The site is not in deadspace nor behind a gate, so it is possible to warp around freely and for people to warp directly to you.

pockets.title: Warp-in pocket

All the ships will be named Core Runner .

It is possible to tank the initial defenders with a strong enough tank, while you hack the cans and skip the combat. But this will leave you without the possible commander drops. 
Another tactic is to clear the site in a PvE fitted combat ship, and then refit or reship to a hacking ship once the site is cleared. 

Destroy the energy neuting towers first, then the frigates and up in size.

Crimson_Hand_Supply_Depot.name: Crimson Hand Supply Depot
intro:
Crimson Hand Supply Depot is a DED Complex that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in low security space in the Amarr regions. 

The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate.

This site is rated DED 6/10. 3 Battlecruisers and a Battleship ran this site easily.

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose:
Rats in this room can be from Serpentis and Angel factions along with Blood Raiders. The acceleration gate to second room is 70 km away. Sentries do not need to be destroyed to proceed.

Acceleration Gate is 60km away. Blowing up the Gate Security structure gives you a key (Crimson Hand Level 1 Passcard) which is not needed for the gate.

rows.name: Gate Security
rows.cargo: Drops key that is not required to activate gate

pockets.title: Industrial Sector
pockets.prose: Acceleration gate 40 km from landing. Enemies spawn 25-60 km from landing. Red container may drop Blood Raider Cruiser Module, and contains an unnecessary key to the acceleration gate.

rows.name: Crimson Hand Container
rows.cargo: Possible Dark Blood module and an unnecessary key

pockets.title: Central Processing
pockets.prose:
Crimson Sentinel has strong active shield tank (240 HP/s), high structure hitpoints (100k), and webs to 50 km. Save it for last, even with massive DPS it takes a long time to kill. It shoots battleship-grade Mjolnir torpedoes that deal 250 DPS EM with 1500 alpha - low enough to be able to speed tank.

Rats spawn 50-60 km from landing. There are two acceleration gates 48 km from landing leading to the last two rooms of the complex. The Sentinel may drop Dark Blood faction modules as well as a key (Crimson Hand Level 3 Passcard) which is not required for both gates.
BSs are all tier 1 battleships (300-400k bounty , not such a threat) they have a little hp and deal relatively low damage.

pockets.title: Supply Sector
pockets.prose: This room is optional. Enemies spawn between 30 and 110 km from landing in multiple groups that can be engaged mostly individually. An acceleration gate at landing will return you to the Central Processing room.

pockets.title: Command Sector
pockets.prose:
Crimson Lord has 380 HP/sec active shield repair with 0 EM resist and additionally repairs 1500 armor HP every 25 seconds. You will need very high sustained damage output in excess of 700-800 DPS to volley through its shield and armor tank in a decent amount of time.

Ships and cruise missile batteries spawn between 40-50 km from landing. Sentry guns are split in three groups, 30, 50, 65 km away from landing.

rows.name: Crimson Lord
rows.cargo: may drop Corpum A-Type Cruiser Module, Dark Blood Faction Module, 19th Tier Overseers, 5m ISK bounty

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: Warping to the site lands on an acceleration gate at 0.

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text:
You can get about 24 million ISK in bounties and a similar amount of meta module loot. There are two opportunities to get Corpum Cruiser A-type Module drops, and you are guaranteed a 19th Tier Officer's Personal Effects (~51 million ISK).

According to reliable sources within the Amarr Navy, this deadspace complex is currently occupied by a large contingency of Crimson Hand cultists. Intelligence indicates that the Crimson Hand, a militant splinter group of the Bloodraider Covenant, is currently engaged in a massive military buildup. While their continued alliance with Omir Sarikusa is in question, they do seem to be planning something big.

Gate 1 
This is a waiting area for trusted black market traders that come here to trade goods (mostly slaves and weaponry) with the Crimson Hand. Security in the area is fairly light, since this is not really a part of the base proper. Caution is still advised, since the area is usually crawling with lowlife scum from every corner of the galaxy.

Registered visitors entering this sector should report to the outpost security office as soon as they arrive. Failure to do so will be considered an act of aggression and handled with lethal force.

The center point of the Crimson Hand depot, this area provides protection and access control to the more sensitive supply areas of the complex. Visitors are not allowed past this point unless they have been granted clearance by a senior officer. No exceptions will be tolerated.

This area is the primary supply sector for Crimson Hand battle groups in this system. Incoming personnel should report to their appropriate supply stations. Personnel assigned to the Command sector should go to the Administrative Offices on level 34 of the Supply Tower.
