messages: As you blow up the Blood raider chapel, a strong electromagnetic pulse erupts, threatening to knock out your instruments, but after a few milliseconds of quantum level queasiness, they reel back and start going around their business as usual. A short while later, one of your scanning modules reports readings of a similar electromagnetic anomaly in a system not so far away.

The cathedral erupts in a ball of flames, quickly subdued by the lack of oxygen. Then there is a second explosion, an enormously powerful nuclear thunder, accompanied by a huge electromagnetic pulse. Then a few milliseconds later, your instruments manage to pick up another pulse, much fainter, distant. You have no idea where it came from and the pulse seems to have confused your computer long enough that it has no record of the event.

The cathedral erupts in a ball of flames, quickly subdued by the lack of oxygen. Then there is a second explosion, an enormously powerful nuclear thunder, accompanied by a huge electromagnetic pulse. Despite this local electric storm, your instruments manage to pick up another pulse a few milliseconds later, in another system not far away. How this distant pulse got here in such a short time is a mystery, but there it is, no doubt about it.
Blood High Priest: It's them, the heathens! They destroyed our sacred church! Attack the non-believers, we shall burn them at the stake after they are captured!
The High Priest has started to send small repair drones in all directions, repairing nearby enemy vessels.
Blood High Priest: Intruders! I bet they've come to laugh at our misfortune. Grab them and bring them before me.
Dark Templar Uthius: What goes on here ?! I leave for only a few moments and all hell has broken loose. It seems I will need to ... restore order in this holy place once again.

Somehow the two cathedrals destruction must have been connected, just as when you destroyed the first one, it blew up the fourth cathedral by the huge arkonor stone back there. Nothing hints to why ones destruction marks doom for the other, you only hope it has nothing to do with divine intervention. If that were the case there would be a God out there somewhere to whom you owed a good many cathedrals ...

Rogue_Drone_Asteroid_Infestation.name: Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation
intro:
Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation is a DED rated combat site found in high and low security space. It is often regarded as a low value site as it contains no faction drones and has a very low chance to drop a single faction module.

Interestingly, the site can have low amounts of Rogue Drone alloys in the cans in the last two pockets that can be reprocessed for minerals.

There are minable asteroids of Omber and Veldspar, but the site will despawn shortly after the drones guarding the Scratched Cask in the last room are defeated, preventing them from being mined unless someone stays in the site, although you do have enough time to go to a nearby station to drop off.

While mining the ore in the site, pirate rats (based on which empire space you're in) can randomly appear, their strength relative to the system's security rating.

pockets.prose:
----
thumb|First Pocket

This pocket contains 1 Omber (about 18k units) and 11 Veldspar asteroids.

A harvester fleet can spawn in this pocket. Maximum size of the fleet is unknown, but can contain at least two with Serpentis Harvesters and a Serpentis defense ship. 

The Harvester wrecks can drop an Elara Restrained Mining Laser Upgrade module, as well as minerals.

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose:
----
This pocket contains 2 Omber (only containing about 500 units total) and 28 Veldspar asteroids.

The Black Drone Container is blocked from warp-in by a large, barren asteroid, requiring manual piloting to move around. The containers are locked until the rats by them are destroyed.

notes.title: Mining
notes.text:
The site's signature will vanish once the last few rogue drones in the last pocket are defeated. Afterwards, leaving the site will result in the site despawning after a minute or so unless someone is present in the site. The site can very well despawn as you're warping back to it.

The first pocket has a sizable amount of Omber in one asteroid, the second pocket has two asteroids with low amounts and the final pocket has a mixed amount of high and low amounts of Omber in each asteroid.

If the site is present in Caldari space, it is recommended to use the Endurance or Venture to be able to defeat ECM rats with drones that can sporadically appear. The Endurance also boasts a larger mining hold to minimize ore drop-offs. In other empires, ECM is not a problem and the Prospect may be used as it can tank the rats through signature tanking and active tanking modules. The gate appears to accommodate Cruiser-sized ships, but mining barges and porpoises will not fit.

messages: This complex was once the work field of a wealthy mining corporation. Funding got cut shortly after an architectural mishap, where the acceleration gates that were supposed to carry the massive industrial haulers got infected with a mysterious virus. The gates' power coils were severely drained and are to this day only capable of hurling smaller vessels between complex pockets. The ruins are now reputed to be infested with a strain of rogue drones.

This section of the complex was once a pocket of very valuable minerals. Most of the ore was mined away decades ago by the resident mining corporation, but the drifting hulks of rock are now kept company by another type of scavenger: rogue drones.

This complex pocket once housed a thriving center for miners operating in the deadspace field. The old station ruins that still remain within the sector are evidence enough that some decades back, this area was highly valued by whatever mining interest controlled it.
Multiple signals and reports of rogue drone activity have been detected around this central area. It appears these abandoned ruins have now become the home of a hostile strain of rogue drones who will stop at nothing to defend their harvesting operation.

messages:
This deadspace field appears to have been infested with a strain of Rogue Drones. Rogue Drones are a self-replicating "lifeform" controlled by artificial intelligence, often in the form of a lucid communication hivemind or centered inside one of their dreaded Rogue Drone Mothers. This particular complex is the construction site of a new hive, far away from its maternal headquarters.
DED Threat Assessment: Minor (2 of 10)
On gate activation: DED Database Information

This deadspace complex pocket is under Rogue Drone domination. According to information gathered by explorers, it appears they have begun construction of a small hive deep inside the warp disruption field.
The first sector contains an old acceleration gate leading towards the outskirts of the drone operation.
On gate activation: DED Database Information

The outskirt pocket of the complex seems to serve as a some kind of a defence perimeter. We have picked up multiple signals of drone activity from within the pocket, leading us to believe it is populated with weak and easily replaceable worker drones.

This central pocket of the complex is the construction site of a rogue drone hive. If left uninterrupted, the complex might soon become the home of a rogue drone mother which would seriously jeopardize security within the system.
The construction supply containers have been reported to be defended by heavier types of rogue drones, thought to serve as overseers of the construction process.

messages:
This drone operation was so small that it could hardly be called a "hive", there were no substantial assembly plants or other major factories here. It looked more like a maintenance station, something that does not rhyme with what you have heard about drones and how they operate, as they usually are confined to self sufficient hives and perhaps operating small resource gathering satellite ops. But a drone maintenance station, servicing several other hives or passersby is almost unheard of. After scanning through the remaining debris, your instruments gather some service logs, further supporting the idea this was an open maintenance station. 
Most of the serviced ships seem to have been standard drone vessels, but you can also see some entries naming ships used by humans, even though it does not say anything about who was flying them. Some of the log entries contain extra notes on these customers and among them you find something that looks like coordinates in a system not too far away.

Salvation_Angel's_Shipment.name: Salvation Angel's Shipment
intro: Salvation Angel's Shipment is an expedition found by completing Angel Outpost combat sites. It may contain up to four parts, each of which will be about 4 jumps from the previous system. The first three will be in high-sec space, while the fourth will be in low-sec.

notes.title: Part 1
notes.text:
As soon as you warped in to the last room, your instruments registered a large group of ships escaping the fight in the last second. Further analysis of the data indicates this was a convoy of six to eight transport ships from the Salvation Angels, accompanied by an unknown number of combat ships. Your navigational systems have already come up with a likely location for you to get to, in case you feel you have any business with them.
 

Taking out the Domination cruiser triggers the escalation. Assuming you always get a low bounty (and therefore short range) BS in the spawn, you can minimize DPS and fit for more gank by simply moving away from the BS after warpin. Even moving slowly you'll buy yourself enough time to take out all the BCs. The drake that had to warp in and out above had no trouble here.

notes.title: Part 2
notes.text: Even though most of the convoy left before you even got there, you still have a good indication of where to follow them.

notes.title: Part 3
notes.text: Despite their heavy ships, the Angels seem to be outmaneuvering you, getting away without a scratch. Your scanners have a new destination ready in few seconds...

notes.title: Part 4
notes.text:
After this fierce fight you are relieved to see your instruments still have track on the main convoy which seems to still contain all of the original transport ships. 

First Pocket:
*2x Frigates (Impaler/Hunter)
*3x Elite Frigates (Arch Impaler/Arch Ambusher) Web/Scram(?)
*3x Destoryers (Seizer)
*3x Battleships (Saint/Nephilim)

Second Pocket:
*1x Frigates (Impaler)
*4x Elite Frigates (Arch Impaler/Ambusher/Raider) Web/Scram(?)
*3x Battlecruiser (Legionnaire/Primus)
*1x Battleships (Saint)
*1x Cruiser (Gistum Domination Racer, doesn't appear to be actual Domination)

Upon clearing Gistum Domination Racer I got a completion message but no loot and Racer wreck yielded T1 salvage.

In a recent instance, the Gistum Domination Racer dropped a single Gistum A-Type 50mn MWD, with no other modules or tags in the wreck.

Sansha's_Command_Relay_Outpost.name: Sansha's Command Relay Outpost
intro:
Sansha's Command Relay Outpost is a deadspace combat site that is occupied by the Pirate Faction known as Sansha's Nation. It can be found by Probing for exploration sites in high-security systems within Amarr and Ammatar space. It can also be triggered as an escalation from the Sansha Hideaway and Sansha Refuge sites.

This combat site consists of 2 different areas accessed by an Acceleration gate. The gates will permit Frigates, Destroyers, Cruisers, and their Tech 2 counterparts.

Pirate ship classes encountered within this combat site are Frigate and Destroyer classes. The names and amount of ships appearing may vary slightly from what is listed here.

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose: The Squad Leader has much stronger resists and is immune to stasis webifiers, target painters, and possibly other EWAR. The Squad Leader drops a Command Relay Key which is needed to open the next gate and is reusable. All ships must be destroyed to unlock the next gate, in addition to the key. Note that the key is not used up by the gate.

rows.name: Sansha Black Ops Squad Leader
rows.cargo: Contains 5th tier Overseers personal effects and may contain *True Sansha modules* as well as producing Tech 2 Salvage

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose:
The damage in this room can exceed 600DPS if you are not careful; however, the room is mostly destroyers, and they only deal significant damage within 10km. The destroyers are also fairly squishy, so they die quickly, reducing room DPS. 
If you are in a well-fit (t2 or equivalent) cruiser, you can safely ignore everything except the Centus Black Ops Commander. Quickly kill him, burn to his wreck, loot, and warp off. Only one heavy missile battery will aggro on warp-in, so the sentries will not be a major concern as long as you keep your distance.
 
As a T1 cruiser, you can launch a single light drone, make it shoot once in an overseer frigate, and scoop it back. This will trigger his aggro and lure him out of the group.
 
The Centus Black Ops Commander has high omni resists in shield(90% to all damage types) but is weak in armor and structure.

rows.name: Centus Black Ops Commander
rows.cargo: Contains 6th Tier Overseers Personal Effects. May also contain Centii A-type Frigate modules or a Succubus BPC. As well as producing Tech 2 Salvage.

messages:
This small outpost acts as a monitoring and coordination hub for the Centus division of the Sansha armed forces in this sector. It also relays communications between neighboring battletowers. 
DED Threat Assessment: Unsafe (3 of 10)

Relay systems such as this one are the heart and soul of Sansha's Nation. Broadcasting a constant stream of strange and incomprehensible directives from a long-dead master. Even so, the Centus squadron guarding this base should not be dismissed as mere mindless drones.
Upon destroying the Centus Black Ops Commander, if the site was from an escalation
The Black Ops Commander has been destroyed, and with that, this space is safe from Sansha's mindless slaves once more.

Sansha's_Nation_Neural_Paralytic_Facilit.name: Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility
Sansha's_Nation_Neural_Paralytic_Facilit.signature: Escalation only in High, 5% in Low
intro:
Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility is a DED 5/10 combat site that can be scanned down in low or null-sec systems in Sansha rat territory. It can also be found as an escalation from Sansha Den anomalies.

The site's initial acceleration gate permits up to battleships T1/T2/Faction

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose: Full room aggro immediately after warp-in. You need to clear the entire pocket (minus the one sentry) to unlock the acceleration gate, which is ~45 km away.

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose:
The majority of the incoming DPS in this pocket comes from the battlecruisers and battleships, destroying them significantly reduces incoming damage, which can exceed 700 DPS.

Alternatively, you can keep the battleships at around 60-70 km and the battlecruisers at more than 40 km, the DPS is significantly reduced. Long-range weapons are recommended for this method. Smaller ships can simply destroy the cruiser and battlecruiser spawns, as the battleships' tracking is poor enough for a cruiser to speed-tank relatively easily.

Unlike other DED sites of this rating, the gate in this pocket is unlocked from the beginning. If your ship is fast and can field a strong tank of upwards of ~700 DPS EM/Thermal, you can simply cross the 40 km distance to the gate and skip the pocket entirely.

Note: rats info here is not exact. Only some battleships use EWAR.

pockets.title: Room 3
pockets.prose:
This pocket is the single most dangerous in the site. The triple stasis tower spawn will web you down to a standstill and make you an easy target for even the battleships to hit, even in fast moving cruisers. Additionally the weapons range of most of the battleships is very large and the smaller ships will close in quickly. Killing the stasis towers should be your highest priority, unless you can field at least 500 DPS/tank with over 80% EM/Thermal resists, in which then you can opt to immediately snipe the overseer. Once the towers die the rest of the fleet is significantly easier to speed-tank.

Slave Ation09 is located around 40-45 km from the warp-in.

Note: rats info here is not exact. Only some battleships use EWAR.

rows.name: Slave Ation09
rows.cargo: may drop 1-run Phantasm BPC, Centum B-type modules and always drops 18th Tier Overseers

messages:
...Sansha's Nation continues its raids against poorly defended civilian areas. Mining colonies, merchant waypoints, and research outposts are favorite targets. Once the structures are overrun by Sansha slaves and drones, surviving locals are turned into test subjects. Many of these areas are used to develop new neural paralytic agents used in abductions. A common thread in numerous reports is the presence of a Sansha known as Ation09....

DED Threat Assessment: 5 of 10
The Sansha have completely covered this abandoned mining outpost with sentry guns. They're quite serious about defending whatever is in the next area.
When you wake up in your next clone, remember it was the Master's will that you died here today.
Ation09 is dead again. Might as well gather his goodies before he has a chance to resurrect.

Sansha's_Nation_Occupied_Mining_Colony.name: Sansha's Nation Occupied Mining Colony
intro:
Sansha's Nation Occupied Mining Colony is a Rated DED Complex, occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when first room is cleared

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose:
Rats are split in two groups and auto-aggro very quickly. Combined pocket damage can well exceed 500 DPS, but it falls off very quickly past 40 km. The left group will primary medium and heavy drones en masse and can quickly kill them from the sheer burst damage. 

True Sansha Foreman requires 190 DPS EM to break its armor tank, but that will take time, so 200+dps EM is advised. 

Example times: A Jaguar with 180dps EM unheated will do the whole site (all opponents - loot Foreman) in about 25-27mn (11-12mn blitzing), whereas a Gila can do the whole site in less than 10mn (5-6 if blitzing).

rows.name: True Sansha Foreman
rows.cargo: Contains 8th Tier Overseers Personal Effects. May contain Centum C-type Modules, True Sansha Cruiser Modules, Or rarely a Phantasm BPC

messages:
DED Database Excerpt: Despite numerous laws across the empires bolstering security regulations after the outbreak of Sansha incursions in YC 113, mining colonies still provide a weak, target-rich environment for pirate factions... 
Sansha raiding fleets are wiping out the colonists and using their own Slaves to crew the mining equipment until it fails, leaving the colony as an empty husk. Eliminating the True Sansha Foreman is the most reliable way of shutting down the entire operation. 
 DED Threat Assessment: 4 of 10"
Enemy Detected: True Sansha Foreman detected in the next pocket. Eliminating this ship will cause the Sansha miners to lose their efficiency and eventually abandon the base.
Foreman Eliminated: The Foreman has been eliminated. All attached Slaves in the colony are now useless to the Sansha. Time to scoop up the loot.

Sansha_Acclimatization_Facility.name: Sansha Acclimatization Facility
intro: Sansha Acclimatization Facility is a DED Rated Complex found via exploration. The site consists of four different pockets accessed by an acceleration gate. The gates allow Frigate, Destroyer, and their tech 2 and tech 3 versions.

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose: Note: The Sentry guns can be ignored. The gate to the second pocket will unlock even if they are left alive.

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose: Note: the Sentry guns can be ignored. The gate to the third pocket will unlock even if they are left alive. (You still want to kill the stasis towers though.)

pockets.title: Room 4
pockets.prose: *Loot Blitz: Kill the Sansha Tenebrus, lure all NPCs about 40-50km away from the wreck, go sideways then if your 30-35km away from NPCs, approach then loot the Sansha Tenebrus wreck.

rows.name: Sansha Tenebrus
rows.cargo: Contains 6th tier overseers personal effects, may contain Centii B-type frigate modules and True Sansha modules.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
The pirate ship classes encountered within this combat site are Frigate and Cruiser class. The Acceleration Gates are unlocked after all pirate ships are destroyed. The names and amount of ships may slightly vary from what is listed here.

Note: Various NPCs in this site have tracking disruption modules.

messages: Sansha Kuvakei and the quasi-human denizens of his Nation have long been among the most feared groups in New Eden, and this fear has recently been multiplied in the wake of their concentrated spate of attacks against the inhabited worlds of the cluster. Places such as this one are where the Nation's conquests are taken screaming from their safe havens and homesteads to be modified and brought into the Nation's fold.

Sansha_Annex.name: Sansha Annex
intro: Sansha Annex is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in Low Security systems with Sansha presence.

rows.name: Sansha Security Tower
rows.trigger: Triggers tower waves when attacked. Unlocks acceleration gate

blocks.title: Tower wave 1 (when Security Tower is attacked)

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose: Kill tackling elite frigates (and the battlecruisers and battleships, if you can't tank the incoming damage) before attempting to shoot the sentries to avoid accidentally spawning the additional waves too early; the combined damage is extreme.

rows.name: Centus Excavation Supervisor
rows.cargo: True Sansha faction modules/implants

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
The site is very similar to Sansha Vigil.
Upon warping to the site you will land at an acceleration gate.

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JOPp_UNLNYg HAM Tengu]

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to Sansha Powergrid.

messages: Previous explorers have commented that one of the gates requires a passkey. Alternatively, it can be bypassed by interacting with the Security Tower.
In local when tower is attacked
The Sansha Security Outpost has started sending out distress signals.
In local when tower wave 1 spawns
Sansha reinforcements have arrived to defend the Security Outpost.
The destruction of the Security Outpost has activated a mechanism inside the nearby acceleration gate.
After destroying one of the sentries
More Centus ships have appeared as the sentry gun was destroyed!

Excavation Overseer: You dare destroy my prized Stasis Tower!? I can't believe it. Do you know how long it took my brainless minions to build that thing? And I just had it polished! You'll pay for that.

This hidden outpost seems to have played a vital role in Sansha expansion in the area. The fact that this operation is now history surely slows down whatever plans for regional domination they may have had. Among one of the wreckages you locate co-ordinates for an energy harvesting facility nearby. Whether you explore it or not is your decision.

Sansha_Base.name: Sansha Base
intro:
Sansha Base is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes in null security Sansha regions. The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate. Bring a MWD or long-range weapons, as the enemies all spawn very far away.

Completing the site chages your Sansha standing by -0.3

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose: Acceleration gate is 56 km from warp-in. It unlocks when all enemies are killed.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: 56km from warp-in. Unlocked by destroying all enemies.

rows.name: Centus Tyrant / Dread Lord / Dark Lord

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose:
Any last enemy in a wave can be a trigger for faction spawn. Goal in this room is to destroy Sansha Minor Refinery which spawns 160 km off warp-in. Sansha Minor Refinery drops tech 1 ammo.

01.08.2025: The last wave spawned when all of the battleships were killed, with some of the battlecruisers still alive

rows.name: Centii Loyal Manslayer / Butcher / Scavenger / Minion
Centii Loyal Manslayer / Butcher / Scavenger / Minion / Servant / Ravener
Centus Tyrant / Dread Lord / Savage Lord / Mutant Lord

blocks.title: Wave 3 (triggered by killing all ships in previous waves)

rows.name: Centus Tyrant / Lord / Slave Lord / Dread Lord
True Sansha Lord / Tyrant / Mutant Lord
rows.cargo: Shinies

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text:
01.08.2025:

The Overseer Battleship did not spawn.

The Overseer Battleship did spawn and dropped a True Sansha Crystal Tag, Sanshas Radio L and T2 salvage.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: Destroying the Sansha Minor Refinery structure or the Overseer Battleship in Room 2 may cause the site to escalate to True Power HQ.

Sansha_Burrow.name: Sansha Burrow
intro:
Sansha Burrow is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. 

This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships.

pockets.title: Walkthrough
pockets.prose: Single ungated pocket with multiple waves of rats. Killing the last ship of each wave triggers the next.

rows.name: True Sansha's Plague
rows.cargo: Drops faction ammo and tags. May drop faction modules.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site does not appear to escalate.

Sansha_Den.name: Sansha's Den
intro:

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. 

This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-, Destroyer- and Cruiser-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Sansha Hidden Den, Sansha Forsaken Den and Sansha Forlorn Den.

Two different site layouts can be encountered: The Light Missile Battery layout and the Heavy Missile Battery layout. Both layouts can spawn a True Sansha Cruiser and escalate.

pockets.prose:
Single pocket, the last ship kill triggers next spawn. Light missile batteries have limited aggro range, only about 30 km.

----

messages: Sansha's Nation was founded well over a century ago. Sansha was a Caldari tycoon who carved out a sizable piece of space for himself; there, he set out to create an Utopian State. His vision and charm attracted thousands of people, and for some time the Nation flourished. But Sansha became ever more warped as his success increased. He started experiments, combining capsule technology with the human mind, creating zombie-like creatures having the cold, calculating minds of computers, yet retaining the ingenuity of humans. When this terrifying truth became public knowledge, Sansha was condemned, and special forces from each of the great empires joined forces to bring him down. His "True Sansha" servitors were decimated, scattered to the furthest reaches of known space. Remnants still remain far in the outer regions, but the once glorious Nation has been reduced to small gangs of pirates and pillagers.

pockets.title: Walkthrough

rows.name: True Sansha's Beast/Juggernaut

intro: Sansha forsaken Den is a combat anomaly found in Sansha infested regions. It is level 4 variant of Sansha Den. Estimated bounty payout of 4.5 mil isk.

The site is an open Deadspace pocket, one may warp to preferred distance.

The anomaly contains a lot of elite frigates and cruisers, which will actively target drones.

The frigate EWAR is varied. Some ships will point, some will web, some will do both and some will do none.

messages: As the bits and pieces from the disintegrated station charge into space, carrying the news of heightened entropy in the universe, your instruments receive an unusual message. It obviously is being transmitted from a Sansha ship and even though the person on the other end does not introduce himself as such, there is no doubt that this is the voice of one of those facistic Sansha pricks who have "True Power" printed on their undies. He demands talking in a closed channel and after you have established one, he continues with some congratulations on your brave victory and then he gives you an offer; If you go to three different locations he provides, assassinate the Sansha leaders operating there and gather all loot you find for him, he will pay you one billion ISK. He then gives you coordinates to a location in a "take it or leave it" manner, before saying farewell and adds that he will contact you after this first target is destroyed.

Sansha_Gas_Processing_Site.name: Sansha Gas Processing Site
intro: Sansha Gas Processing Site is a hacking site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Sansha infested territory in Low Sec space. This site appears to Probes as a Gas Site rather than the typical hacking site. It is also defended by hostile NPC ships.

pockets.title: Walkthrough
pockets.prose: A well-tanked T1 battlecruiser can run this site without much problems.

messages: Sansha's Nation was founded well over a century ago. Sansha was a Caldari tycoon who carved out a sizable piece of space for himself; there, he set out to create an utopian state. His vision and charm attracted thousands of people, and for some time the Nation flourished. But Sansha became ever more warped as his success increased. He started experiments, combining capsule technology with the human mind, creating zombie-like creatures having the cold, calculating minds of computers, yet retaining the ingenuity of humans. When this terrifying truth became public knowledge, Sansha was condemned, and special forces from each of the great empires joined forces to bring him down. His "true Sansha" servitors were decimated, scattered to the furthest reaches of known space. Remnants still remain far in the outer regions, but the once-glorious Nation has been reduced to small gangs of pirates and pillagers.

messages: Your ship detects distress signals coming from inside this deadspace area. Perhaps the inhabitants are calling for reinforcements.
The destruction of the gate scrambler triggers an explosion that affects all hostile ships in the vicinity.
The Sansha Military Barracks area seems eerily quiet and empty. It seems the inhabitants did not expect any intruders to make it this far in.

The Sansha station has sent out a distress signal!
Sansha reinforcements have arrived.
Siege sentries and extra ships have been deployed from the Military Barracks, scraped together at the last minute.

Going through the logs from one of the command ships you blasted, you come across a recent memo containing a draft for a plan where forces from this Military Complex and another similar to this one were to gang up and raid a space trucker station somewhere in the region. Where this space trucker station is, is not included in the logs, but the location of the rally point is there. It is supposed to be by a small asteroid belt, not too far away.

messages:
Despite the resource drain of their recent incursions throughout traveled space, Sansha’s Nation has maintained a military presence in deadspace pockets. One favored Sansha strategy is to hide outposts behind isolated or abandoned Amarr stations. All Sansha communications are then encrypted with an adaptive security key and hidden in pre-recorded Amarr chatter.

The complex security is dependent upon the True Sansha Archduke, a vessel containing a physical network of True Slaves that serve as a living security key for their network. Eliminating the Archduke will render all Nation assets inoperable. 

DED Threat Assessment: 7 of 10

The next deadspace pocket contains a heavy concentration of outbound communication signals, making it easier to detect the Nation signal in the carrier wave. This Nation code, however, uses an adaptive 1024 kilobit lattice key: It will be quicker, and simpler, to eliminate the Archduke than to try decoding the signal.

The Archduke is eliminated. In approximately 18 seconds, the Nation security key will attempt to cycle and the Nation signal will be rendered into junk data.

Now let’s see if the Archduke dropped anything fun in its wreck.

messages:
This deadspace complex is occupied by the Centus soldiers of Sansha's Nation. The area serves as a military outpost, allowing their troops to rearm their weapon systems, repair personal cyberimplants and process surveillance data. The complex also stores the cryo-chambers for hundreds of Sansha reserves.
 DED Threat Assessment: Training (1 of 10)
This pocket within the deadspace complex contains the entrance acceleration gate, along with an array of mindcontrol units, used to broadcast commands to Centus Sansha troops within the solarsystem.

This sector of the complex serves as a defense perimeter for the outpost headquarters housed beyond the acceleration gate. The area has been reported to be well defended with numerous light fighter frigates. The security officer on duty is responsible for passing out securitycards necessary to be cleared through the gate towards the recuperation camp.

The innermost pocket of the complex is the central command post for this military outpost. High energy readings have been reported from this sector, believed to be caused by an artificial magnetic field managed by magnetic stabilizer units. The reason for this magnetic field remains unknown, as the area's function seems to be to store cryo-troopers and slumber chambers for inactive reserves.

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: Typical loot from the True Sansha commanders include criminal dog tags, faction ammunition and meta modules. They also have a chance to drop True Sansha faction modules. The Sansha Research Outpost can drop Centum A-Type cruiser modules, True Sansha modules and possibly a rare 1-run Phantasm BPC.

messages: To your surprise, the Overseer seems to have spent the last moments of his life sending some message to your ship on a private channel, a fact you learn from a blinking entry on your communication panel a few seconds after his innards slid across your windshield, bounced along your fuselage and were sucked into your thrusters. It appears he wanted to save his life by telling you the whereabouts of some place you could load your cargohold with riches, but before he could get very far with his offer, his journey ended. All you have is some hysteric babble about a hidden mining station at a certain location.
The destruction of the Stasis Tower has alerted a nearby patrol, more ships are incoming!
Among the things you find are a few drones. Running a scan on their control units reveals they have been used not long ago, at another place not far away from here.
The nearby Starbase Hangar doors open, and more drones are deployed.

All these moon mining stations suggest there must be a station or outpost somewhere in the region servicing them and refining the raw materials they produce. Again you look for clues from the drones, but the data you extract suggests no new locations, only the two you have been at already. If the Sansha have any more stations in the area, this is not where you will find them.

All these moon mining starbases suggest there must be a station or outpost somewhere in the region servicing them and refining the raw materials they produce. Again you look for clues from the drones and again the data you extract suggest a new location not too far away.
You see a large Starbase near the beacon you just warped to. It seems to be guarded by the Sansha's Nation. Perhaps you are closer to finding something of value ....
Sansha ships have undocked from nearby Starbase Hangars.

Going through data scanned during the destruction of the station itself, you notice reports from a place called "R&D division Gray", containing information on blueprint research and booster production and even the location of this base "Gray".
You see a large Starbase near the beacon you just warped to. It seems to be guarded by the Sansha's Nation. Perhaps you are closer to finding something of value ....

This Research Station has a built-in defense system. As soon as it is attacked, the inhabitants activate the system, causing a large blast-wave which affects all hostile ships in the vicinity. It is activated continuously until it needs a short delay to recharge power.

Now, you kind of regret killing the Overseer back there, it is always useful to know corrupt leaders who are ready to sell out things like this outpost in exchange for something as cheap as their own petty lives.

rows.name: True Sansha's Dread Lord

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: This site is practically impossible to solo, and is often called 'the secret 10/10'. HIGHLY RECOMMEND BRINGING FRIENDS FOR THIS SITE. For running this site, bringing a friend or two is recommended to help tank the DPS in the first pocket or break the Provisional HQ in the second room. T3 Cruisers and T2 Battleships can enter the site. Like with all unrated complexes, you land on an acceleration gate when warping to the complex.

escalation.title: Escalation

messages: Your ship detects distress signals coming from inside this deadspace area. Perhaps the inhabitants are calling for reinforcements.
The destruction of the gate scrambler triggers an explosion that affects all hostile ships in the vicinity.
The Sansha Provisional HQ Overseer has activated a powerful smartbomb, affecting all hostile ships caught inside the blast radius.

As the dust settles from the battle, you receive a transmission from someone claiming to be a local vigilante who congratulates you on a job well done. Your computers run a check on his ship ID´s and other info they can gather on him in such a short period of time, but come up with nothing. He is at least not a part of any pirate faction, nor seems he to represent any of the official states in the galaxy. This person continues to welcome you to the area and offers to point you to some other Sansha bases he knows about and have been a menace for the local population. If you want to come and meet him, he will lead the way.

Sansha_Sanctum.name: Sansha Sanctum
intro: Sansha Sanctum is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within null-security systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to Titans in null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Battleship-sized enemy ships.

rows.name: True Sansha's Tyrant
rows.cargo: Drops Sansha Diamond tag, Sansha ammunition crystal and possibly Sansha modules

rows.name: True Sansha's Tyrant
rows.cargo: Drops Sansha Diamond tag, Sansha ammunition crystal and possibly Sansha modules

Sansha_Surveillance_Squad.name: Sansha Surveillance Squad
intro: Sansha Surveillance Squad is an Expedition that can escalate from Provisional Sansha Outpost.

pockets.title: First Location
pockets.prose: If the True Sansha ship does not spawn, take the acceleration gate.

rows.name: True Sansha's Juggernaut
rows.cargo: Faction ammo/tags and possible True Sansha faction modules

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose: There are two large groups of rats at initial warp-in 50 km away. The larger right group will warp off after ~30 seconds. Destroy the Sansha Security Station to trigger escalation.

pockets.title: Second Location
pockets.prose: Once again, take the acceleration gate if commander cruiser does not spawn.

rows.name: True Sansha's Execrator/Slaughterer
rows.cargo: Possible True Sansha faction modules, implants, faction ammo/tags

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose: Two groups of rats are initially present 50 km away. One will warp away when you warp in.

pockets.title: Third Location
pockets.prose: Similar number of rats. Warp disrupting rats should be killed first so you can initiate a safe warp-out if the need arises.

rows.name: True Sansha's Execrator/Slaughterer
rows.cargo: Possible True Sansha faction modules, implants, faction ammo/tags

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose: Simple warp-in may trigger escalation. There are no notable structures in this room.

pockets.title: Fourth Location
pockets.prose:
Ungated pocket. You land on a colorful mixture of ruins, structures, and rocks. No rats initially present. 

The Jeroon structure itself triggers a smartbomb wave when initially attacked which reaches out to 30 km. The structure itself is fairly easy to destroy with only 16k HP.

The Sansha's Berserkers/Demons should be destroyed first, they deal high damage compared to normal rats and have more tank, though not as much as normal elite frigates. Kazah Durn hits hard also, out to 100 km.

rows.name: Jeroon
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements; destroy to trigger overseer wave
rows.note: Aggression on Jeroon structure triggers 6 smartbomb waves every 30 seconds

rows.name: Kazah Durn
rows.cargo: Centum C-Type modules and a possible Phantasm BPC

notes.title: See also
notes.text:
* [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=23663 Stats of the Jeroon structure]
* [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=26878 Stats of the overseer cruiser]

messages: It seemed for a while you would manage to get all of the Sansha ships, but evidently one of them has slipped away. Luckily your scanners seem to have gathered enough information to give you its approximate destination.

The station databanks contain information on the local True Power security network and among it; a location of yet another station similar to this one. That is your best clue as to where the ships that fled as you entered have gone.

To your dismay, the main computers of this station took a direct hit during your assault and any information that might have been there is gone up in smoke. However, your instruments ran through the data from the fleeing ships and have come up with this location as a suggestion to where they might have warped.

It looks like the most interesting of these True Power ships got away during the fight. Luckily for you though, one of its communication devices seems to be malfunctioning and is for no apparent reason sending out a constant stream of sleezy elevator muzak. Your instruments have no problems tracing where it is coming from. This wailing extremely irritating. Aggrivating too. The muzak of doom.
The pirate station has activated a smartbomb, damaging all hostile ships within its range!

The pirate station has called on reinforcements from a nearby deadspace pocket.
More pirate reinforcements have arrived.
The pirate station has called on reinforcements from a nearby deadspace pocket.
More pirate reinforcements have arrived.

More pirate reinforcements have arrived.
More pirate reinforcements have arrived.
Kazah Durn: Noooo! You've just ruined years of research. I can't believe it. You will PAY for that, mongrel!

For a while there, you almost wished you had brought more friends with you and you are relieved you managed to blow the station before more could scramble against you. You are also relieved you managed to kill off that blasted gurgle sound. Permanently.

Sansha_Vigil.name: Sansha Vigil

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
The gate is unlocked by destroying the security tower. No other thing needs to be destroyed to proceed.
Use caution when attacking or destroying towers to reduce dps- it's easy to unleash the large swarm of defenders.
The second gate drops you in to the middle of the initial defenders and towers. Destroying the webbing stasis tower releases the webbing spider drones and additional defenders. Tank on the order of strong T1 cruiser to survive the immediate initial dps in room 1.

Structures on site

blocks.title: Reinforcements after attacking the security tower. 70 km away

rows.name: Sansha Security Tower
rows.trigger: Attacking spawns reinforcements, destroying unlocks gate

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until Security Tower is destroyed

rows.name: Sansha Light Missile Battery
rows.trigger: First one destroyed triggers battery wave

blocks.title: Battery Wave. Triggers when first missile battery is destroyed
Tower Wave #1. Triggered when a tower (web?) is attacked
Tower Wave #2. Triggered when a web tower is destroyed

rows.name: Centus Excavation Supervisor
rows.cargo: faction modules, possible Nirvana implant BPC

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to True Power Shipyards.

messages: You are about to wrap up this little raid when all of a sudden you have an incoming transmission popping on one of your panels from someone asking where in flaming hell his ship components are. He continues to claim that he had ordered all sorts of stuff ages ago and nothing is getting delivered. This is all sent in Sansha code and comparison with the station logs from the place you just destroyed identify the person on the other end as a foreman from a local branch of the True Power corporation. When he hears some hesitation on your end, this guy gets all patronizing on you, raving back and forth about too many newbs being recruited to the production units, how your single digit IQ must be a shining light for every slug in the universe to follow and fabulates a bit about how he envisions the state your toilet training is in. He then shouts some instructions about how you are to get off your butt right this moment and haul it to a certain place, picking up his order for 300 10MN afterburners. He orders you to buzz him on this same frequency when you are there and that he will then give you further instructions.

Sansha_War_Supply_Complex.name: Sansha War Supply Complex
intro:
Sansha War Supply Complex is a DED Complex that can be scanned down with probes, and can be found in low security space in some Amarr regions or in null security regions with Sansha presence. It can also be received as an escalation from the Sansha Rally Point.

The site is behind an acceleration gate. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate.

This site is rated DED 6/10. 3 Battlecruisers and a Battleship ran this site easily. A well tanked T3 Cruiser is usually sufficient to clear the site in ~30-40 minutes.

pockets.title: Room 1
pockets.prose:
The overseer battleship does not contain any notable loot.

 
Note: Room 2a (down gate) is optional and contains no particular loot. Room 2b has an overseer battleship and must be cleared in order to take the gate forward (updated June 2021). Both gates are locked until the pocket is cleared.

rows.name: Main Supply Storage
rows.cargo: Contains the Product Park Passcard required to access the next room

rows.name: Cache Container
rows.cargo: Drones

rows.name: Charge Ammunition Storage
rows.cargo: T1 ammo

rows.name: Cruise Missile Storage
rows.cargo: 100 cruise missiles in each container

rows.name: Drone Sensor Storage
rows.cargo: Defunct Drone Sensor Modules

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Leads back to the first section

pockets.title: Room 2b (Product Park)
pockets.prose: The rats are spread out in 4 groups. Except for the group camping the warp-in, they will not auto-aggro on landing unless approached or attacked, and will shoot drones if they have not aggro'd any players already.

rows.name: True Creation's Park Overseer
rows.cargo: may drop True Sansha Battleship Module

pockets.title: Room 3
pockets.prose: Group 1 auto-aggros on landing. Group 2 will not aggro unless approached or attacked and will shoot drones if not aggressed first by a player.

rows.name: Effotber's Transit Overseer
rows.cargo: may drop True Sansha Battleship Module

pockets.title: Room 4
pockets.prose:
The two sentries and the group camping the warp-in will auto-aggro on landing. Attacking Skomener Effotber will aggro the entire pocket.

Skomener Effotber has strong armor tank that needs at least 600 DPS of pure EM damage (70% weakest resist) to break. He does ~450 dps EM/Thermal damage at 70km range. Combined with the full room aggro the total incoming damage in this pocket can well exceed 1000 dps. There are no webbing ships so speed tanking will reduce the room damage by a lot.

Blitz: Kill Skomener Effotber, bookmark wreck, warp out, wait 3 minutes, warp back to loot wreck.

rows.name: Overseer Skomener Effotber
rows.cargo: 19th Tier OPE, Centum A-Type Modules, True Sansha Battleship Modules, Phantasm BPC

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: Warping to the site lands on an acceleration gate at 0.

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: You can get about 24 million ISK in bounties and a similar amount of meta module loot. There is an opportunity to get Centum Cruiser A-type Module drop, and you are guaranteed a 19th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects (~51 million ISK).

messages:
Sansha's War Supply Complex was built as a direct countermeasure to CONCORD's increased emphasis on curbing the influence of Sansha's Nation. The compound contains a lot of basic armaments and supplies. It is sturdy and well defended.

DED Threat Assessment: Serious (6 of 10)
The Check-in Decks of Sansha's War Supply are guarded by a tight group of pirate vessels. Some firepower is required to bash through to the gates.

Here, Sansha's 'True Creations' store some of the products manufactured in the complex. A tightly built city called simply "The Pit" is heavily guarded by a number of small frigates and cruisers.

DED experts have described the area's patrol routines as flawed and their command as panicky and incompetent.

The so called "Product Park" is where the complex's most vigorous mining operations take place.

Structures built into asteroids house the pre-processing and manufacture of crude parts before being shipped further into the complex.
The Centus Creations station is built in the remnants of a massive asteroid. It is where the Centus Sansha mass-produce the largest components of ships and other equipment.

From here, Asunula Aarikken, True Creations' assembly manager, spearheads the mass production of war supplies for Sansha's Nation.

Modified Solar Harvesters harvest natural deadspace-energy storms and channel the energy they collect towards a high-tech and luxurious manufacturing station.

Sansha_Watch.name: Sansha Watch
intro:
An Unrated Complex that can be scanned down with scanner probes. It is commonly found in highsec systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. 

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Cruiser class or smaller. There are two variations of the site. 

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. Flying too close (4 km) to the second gate will trigger a large spawn. Shoot the Sansha Mind Control Tower to get the Centum Militant Supervisor to spawn. He's got the good stuff.

The first pocket can be skipped if you have a Sansha Silver Tag in your cargo hold. This will be consumed when the acceleration gate is activated.

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
Sentries are split into two groups to the left and right, relative to the next acceleration gate. They are out of range of the warp-in point and can be ignored without any damage if one simply burns straight to the next gate.

The reinforcement wave is timed and will spawn even if the left group of frigates is not attacked.

Structures on site

rows.name: Centii Facility Patroller
rows.trigger: Attacking front group triggers reinforcement wave, attacking back group triggers gate proximity wave

blocks.title: Reinforcement Wave (Triggered by attacking Facility Patroller left group, or after ~30 seconds)
Gate Proximity Wave (Triggered by attacking Facility Patroller right group or approaching the gate)

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks after Slave commander is dead

pockets.title: Second Room
pockets.prose:
Most of the spawn is split into several groups about 30-60 km away. 2 destroyers and a cruiser sit at 0 on the warp-in point. All ships autoaggro within a few seconds.

The True Sansha frigate is separate from the rest of the ships, about 100 km away. He will approach you with microwarpdrive.

Structures on site

blocks.title: Overseer wave (triggered by attacking the Mind Control Tower)

rows.name: Centum Militant Supervisor
rows.trigger: Escalation trigger, may trigger commander wave

blocks.title: 90-100 km away, towards the top left

rows.name: True Sansha Plague
rows.cargo: faction modules

rows.name: Centus Bunker
rows.cargo: may contain loot

escalation.title: Escalations
escalation.text: Destroying the True Sansha's faction spawn or the Centum Militant Overseer may trigger an expedition Nation on the Rise, with this message

messages: Previous explorers have commented that one of the gates requires a passkey. Alternatively, it can be bypassed by convincing the commander to unlock it. The overseer guards the Mind Control Tower vigorously.
The Patroller calls on reinforcements from a nearby pocket as he is attacked!

Someone has entered the vicinity of the acceleration gate, and has awakened the Slave Commander!
Prepare for a fight, unless you have the means to bypass the gate's security system.
Centus Slave Commander: Fool, you've overstepped your welcome here. Minions, defend your master!

Signals coming from the Mind Control Tower resemble those used by Sansha commanders when they control their troops. The signals are emitting at a furious pace, indicating the residents of the Tower are becoming increasingly desperate.
Enemy craft have undocked from one of the Centus bunkers!
Someone has attacked the Mind Control Tower. The Overseer along with his cohorts have undocked to defend it!
A couple of the ships you destroyed bear different marks than the rest and after closer inspection you find that their navigation logs point to a place nearby as their home base.

Sansha_Yard.name: Sansha Yard
intro: The Sansha Yard is an combat anomaly that can be found in Sansha infested territory of Low and Null Sec space. The site itself is a small, open area with no Acceleration Gate. There are two variations of this site, the LCO Habitation and Dark Shipyard.

pockets.title: Variation 1 (LCO Habitation)
pockets.prose: Destroying the Sansha Heavy Missile Battery spawns another sentry of the same type.

rows.name: Sansha Heavy Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Destroying it spawns another sentry of the same type

blocks.title: Battery wave (triggered by destroying the Heavy Missile Battery from the previous wave)

rows.name: True Sansha's Hellhound
rows.cargo: Possible to contain faction ammo, tags, modules

rows.name: True Sansha's Fiend
rows.cargo: Possible to contain faction ammo, tags, modules

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.text:
* Bounty: 4 million ISK for LCO Habitation variant, 2.5 million ISK for Dark Shipyard variant
* Loot/salvage: typical Sansha salvage materials

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site may escalate into the expedition Sansha War Supply Complex, a 6/10 rated DED complex. The escalation may be triggered by destroying all ships.

Save_The_Slaves.name: Save The Slaves
intro: Save the Slaves is an expedition found by completing Blood Raider Outpost combat sites. It may contain up to four parts, each of which will be about 4 jumps from the previous system. The first three will be in low-sec space, while the fourth will usually be in null-sec.

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose: The first pocket is optional. Killing the Faction Cruiser has the possibility of triggering the next mission on the escalation. If not, take the gate. Simple warp-in may trigger escalation.

pockets.title: First Room (Gateless Entry)
pockets.prose: Kill all rats to activate the acceleration gate.

rows.name: Dark Corpum Believer
rows.cargo: may contain Ashimmu BPC, Corpum A-type modules, Dark Blood faction modules or an implant

notes.title: First Pocket
notes.text: No enemies present, only the abandoned ruins of an Amarr station. Escalation may trigger upon warp-in.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.text: Getting all four escalations gives the possibility of an Ashimmu BPC or Corpum A-Type module drops in the final escalation site.

escalation.title: First Escalation
escalation.text: You land at an acceleration gate.

escalation.title: Second Escalation
escalation.text: Again you land at another acceleration gate. Take it if no escalation triggers from the Dark Blood commander.

escalation.title: Third Escalation
escalation.text: Ungated pocket.

messages: This seems to have been a distribution and holding center for slaves, run by a medical division of the Blood Raider Covenant. All of the slaves held there seem to have lost their lives in the attack.

This seems to have been a distribution and holding center for slaves run by a medical division of the Blood Raider Covenant. No slaves survived the attack, but one of them did manage to send you a few different coordinates to similar locations before perishing.

This station seems to have been recently deserted, but you can't find any indication as to why. You feel that the trail is quickly growing cold, except for some sketchy description of a place from the slave in the previous encounter.

It looks as the Blood had some idea they were about to be raided and were trying to evacuate in time. Luckily you managed to get track on the ships that got away and have exact co-ordinates to their location.

From the look of their faces, the slaves don't mind what happens to them after this. Frail and drawn, they are just happy to get away from this place and not ending their days as blood-cows, satisfying the Blood Covenants twisted needs.

Serpentis_Annex.name: Serpentis Annex

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose: Destroy 2 Serpentis Bunkers and Core Drug Dealer will probably spawn. Kill him, then clear the pocket.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Serpentis Gold Tag must be provided or unknown trigger should happen.

rows.name: Core Rear Admiral
rows.note: Core Port/Rear Admiral use 1 x Defender Rocket.

rows.name: Serpentis Stasis Tower
rows.note: Serpentis Stasis Tower webs on 42km, probably even to 250km.

rows.name: Mireille Pureux
rows.cargo: Shadow Serpentis modules

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
This complex is similar to Serpentis Vigil.

The complex is accessed by activating the acceleration gate on warp-in.

A battleship or above is recommended for this site.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to Serpentis Powergrid.

messages: As the Serpentis hangar was destroyed, a lone ship that was docked inside barely managed to escape it's destruction.
Upon aggressing Tower Sentry Serpentis III (in local chat channel)
Mireille Pureux: Do you bothersome pests never give up? I have better things to do than deal with the likes of you.

Serpentis_Base.name: Serpentis Base
intro:
Serpentis Base is a combat site that can be scanned down with probes in null security Serpentis regions. The site is behind an acceleration gates. Warping to the side lands you at 0 on the gate.

An extender fit Drake can run this site. Bring a MWD or long-range weapons, as the enemies all spawn very far away.

pockets.title: Room #1
pockets.prose: The rats are few, but far away from each other. Acceleration gate is 56 km from warp-in. It unlocks when all enemies are killed.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.trigger: Getting within 10 km triggers the proximity wave

pockets.title: Room #2
pockets.prose:
----

Faction spawn has a chance to appear after a few minutes of entering the site. The alternative completion trigger is the Serpentis Armory, which spawns 160 km off warp-in.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Baron
rows.cargo: Shadow Serpentis modules

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.text: You can get about 4 million isk in bounties from this site. If the faction battleship spawns, you can get an additional 4 million isk in bounties, plus the value of its faction loot.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: The site completes and de-spawns upon destruction of the faction battleship or the Serpentis Armory structure in Room #2 (if the faction battleship did not spawn). The site has a chance to escalate to Contract Killers.

messages: Heuristic analysis of this location indicates that destroying the Serpentis Armory would greatly improve your odds of uncovering further illicit activity.

Serpentis_Burrow.name: Serpentis Burrow
intro: A Serpentis Burrow is a cosmic anomaly found in high security Gallente space. There are two minor variations with slightly different wave compositions. Which variation a given anomaly is can only be determined by warping to it.

pockets.title: Asteroid station
pockets.prose: This variation features a prominent asteroid station object.

rows.name: Coreli Guard/Safeguard
rows.trigger: Damaging a ship in this wave will immediately spawn the next one

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Initiate
rows.cargo: Shadow Serpentis ammo, sometimes faction module

pockets.title: Rock formation
pockets.prose: This variation features a large rock formation at the center of the anomaly.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Initiate
rows.cargo: Shadow Serpentis ammo, sometimes faction module

Serpentis_Chemical_Lab.name: Serpentis Chemical Lab

pockets.title: Walkthrough
pockets.prose:
Single ungated pocket. 
The damage at first can be considerable. The missile launchers can be destroyed rapidly, and once they are destroyed the damage output drops substantially. Destroyed Missile Batteries may drop Ammo.

The cans can be hacked and looted without killing any of the defenders.

Reinforcements arrive once the ships from initial derenders are destroyed.

Notable structures

rows.name: Serpentis Chemical Laboratory
rows.cargo: Can contain rug BPCs, skillbooks, implants and drug related commodities

notes.title: Overview
notes.text: This is a Cosmic Signature chemical lab found in low-sec. To access the chemical laboratories, you need a Data Analyser module.

messages: Masking the existence of this facility by placing it within a large space wreck the Serpentis have successfully managed to establish a small chemical laboratory close to the gas cloud harvest they seek. Such facilities are used to refine and improve upon their booster formulas and are well protected.

Serpentis_Corporation_Hydroponics_Site.name: Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site
intro: The Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site is a DED complex found in Serpentis infested regions. In addition to being found in low sec by scanning this complex may be received as an escalation from a Serpentis Den. Medium Difficulty using T3 Cruiser, Combat Battlecruiser, Battleship (MJD).

rows.name: Core Rear Admiral/Flotilla Admiral
rows.note: Flotilla Admiral uses Remote Sensor Dampener

pockets.title: 2nd Pocket
pockets.prose: Take extreme caution in this pocket, do not let the cruisers and battlecruisers get within 10 km; overall room damage can exceed 600 DPS and can kill even a battleship.

rows.name: Core Admiral/Rear Admiral/Flotilla Admiral
rows.note: Flotilla Admiral uses Remote Sensor Dampener

pockets.title: 3rd Pocket
pockets.prose: The initial damage is not high since most of the larger ships have limited damage projection, however due to the triple Stasis Tower webbing, they will close in quickly and apply extreme damage if the stasis towers aren't primaried. Alternatively, if you can project at least 500 DPS out to ~40-50 km, you can opt to immediately kill the Overseer, bookmark his wreck and come back to pick up the loot when the site despawns.

rows.name: Sarpati Family Enforcer
rows.cargo: 18th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and a possibility of Corelum B-type/ Shadow Serpentis Modules and Vigilant BPC (rare)

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
The damage can be overwhelming. However, in a cruiser sized ship, with a 100mn afterburner, you should be able to avoid most damage by orbiting a stationary target at around ~25km at ~900m/sec. Just make sure you target the rats which can hit you first, there should only be about 3-5 per pocket which can. However, this method becomes a bit difficult to execute due to the webs in the last room, so be wary. The webs practically make you a stationary target for the rats to shoot. 

The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly.

If you want to blitz the last pocket, head-shot the Sarpati Family Enforcer, bookmark their wreck, and warp out. Then come back by warping to the bookmark, since the gates will already have despawned, as will have all the remaining rats in the final room, and you can scoop the loot.

messages:
The Serpentis are doing quite well for themselves in the narcotics department. Trafficking sites are bustling with activity and security.
Security forces should be mindful of any Sarpati family enforcers.

DED Threat Assessment: 5 of 10.
Analysis: Whatever the Serpentis are getting out of these asteroids, it must be an integral component of their product. There's enough equipment here to support a small planetary nation.
Enemy Detected: It's not every day you get to meet and kill an Enforcer for the Sarpati family. Looks like you get to today.
Enforcer Eliminated: That was fun. You can be sure the Sarpati family has heard about this and written your name down somewhere. Oh well. Time to collect his loot.

Serpentis_Den.name: Serpentis Den
intro:
Serpentis Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). 

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Cruiser-sized enemy ships, as well as some batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site complex.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Commander
rows.cargo: drops

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Patroller
rows.cargo: drops

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis
rows.cargo: drops

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site.

messages: The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V. Salvador Sarpati. At first, it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties to the underworld grew, and Serpentis research stations scattered around in remote areas became notorious pirate havens. Sarpati made a deal with the Angel Cartel early on to provide protection for his stations, and this duty was eventually taken on by the Guardian Angels. Both sides have prospered enormously from this deal - Serpentis can operate in peace, and the Angel Cartel gets access to the illegal research efforts of the Serpentis conglomerate. It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the main developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renowned specialist in that field. The home of Serpentis is in the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.
Your scanner has picked up a transmission originating from a nearby system. It would be wise to investigate this mysterious signal further.

Serpentis_Drug_Outlet.name: Serpentis Drug Outlet
intro: Serpentis Drug Outlet is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems (confirmed in 0.1 security system). Frigates (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex frequently awards the player with valuable Coreli C-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as a possible Daredevil blueprint copy.

pockets.title: Second Room
pockets.prose:
Note: In the second room, kill the Serpentis Drugstore Overseer and loot his wreck, then kill all the rats and burn to and take the gate into the last room. The Drugdealer passcard is consumed on use.

Left Group

Gate Group

Right Group

Structures

rows.name: Serpentis Drugstore Overseer
rows.cargo: Contains 6th tier Overseers Personal Effects and Drugdealer passcard to storage area, and may rarely contain Shadow Serpentis Frigate Modules

rows.name: Serpentis Property
rows.note: Locked until ships guarding the are destroyed
rows.cargo: Metal scraps, T1 ammo and drones

pockets.title: Third Room
pockets.prose: Note: In the third room, kill only the Serpentis Financing office, loot the cargo container it drops, this drops your shiny loot, not the Overseer.

rows.name: Serpentis Outlet Crime Boss
rows.cargo: May contain 3rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects

rows.name: Serpentis Financing Office
rows.cargo: Contains 3rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects, Coreli C-type Modules, and May contain Shadow Serpentis Frigate Modules, or, rarely, a Daredevil BPC

rows.name: Serpentis Container

messages:
This deadspace complex is under control of the drug-dealing Serpentis Corporation. This particular branch is a drug dealing outlet, containing narcotic supermarkets and local storages for illicit substances.
DED Threat Assessment: Training (1 of 10)

This deadspace complex is known to be a haven for Serpentis drug dealers. The Dealer Gate is merely the actual entrance gate of the complex and is usually guarded by a single henchman from the corporation. Hundreds of drug dealers use the gate every week to get their hands on the newest merchandise from the local vendors.

This part of the complex houses the center of the local drug dealing scene. Only the overseer of the dealers can give access to the Core Serpentis base of operations hidden deep beyond the acceleration gate at the far end.

This pocket houses the local headquarters for the drug vendors. The central station is divided into four wings. The first one handles communication to other Serpentis branches within the constellation. The second manages the financing behind the operation. The third one contains the narcotic storages and warehouses, while the fourth and last segment handles advertisement and marketing. Ship equipment and supplies are stored beneath the base superstructure.

messages:
This deadspace complex is the fleet shipyard headquarters of the Core department of the Serpentis Corporation. It is defended by a massive battle fleet, manufactured by the corporation and assisted by the best mercenaries available.

DED Threat Assessment: Critical (10 of 10)

The entrance pocket of this Serpentis Fleet Shipyard complex serves as a checkpoint for clearance of authorized personnel and pedestrian traffic, intended to enforce circulation control measures and other regulations. This sector is lightly defended compared to the battle fleet that resides deeper within the complex.

This central pocket of the complex houses the main hangar area, storing the bulk of the fleet reserves. Three acceleration gates give way to other pockets within the complex, two towards external hangar areas and repair equipment, and one towards the Fleet Headquarters. The gate towards the HQ is encoded with a confidential security code.
This hangar area bestows docking rigs and Alpha fleet hangars. The pocket is administered by one of the Serpentis XOs.
This hangar area bestows repair lattices and Beta fleet hangars. The pocket is administered by one of the Serpentis XOs.

The Core Serpentis fleet headquarters are heavily defended by a massive battle fleet of elite officers and tactical veterans. It is inside this base that the Serpentis Corporation lays out its martial strategies for the annexation of space around the Gallente border zones. It is here that the designs for war machines and high-tech weapons of destruction are devised and rolled into action.

As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). 

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Battleship-sized enemy ships, as well as some batteries. messages: The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V. Salvador Sarpati. At first, it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties to the underworld grew, and Serpentis research stations scattered around in remote areas became notorious pirate havens. Sarpati made a deal with the Angel Cartel early on to provide protection for his stations, and this duty was eventually taken on by the Guardian Angels. Both sides have prospered enormously from this deal - Serpentis can operate in peace, and the Angel Cartel gets access to the illegal research efforts of the Serpentis conglomerate. It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the main developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renowned specialist in that field. The home of Serpentis is in the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.

pockets.prose:
This site can be done in any drone boat, such as the Vexor, Vexor Navy Issue or the Gila. 
A quick guide: When you enter the site, turn on your modules and drop drones. Then you want to move a bit away from the warp-in, drop down your Mobile Tractor Unit, start orbiting it while you attack the rats. 
You want to kill frigates first, then cruisers, battlecruiser then battleships, BUT keep an eye on what rat triggers the next wave, and leave 1 of those for last.

messages: As the bits and pieces from the disintegrated station charge into space, carrying the news of heightened entropy in the universe, your instruments receive an unusual message. It's obviously being transmitted from the Serpentis and even though the person on the other end does not introduce himself as such, the special cypher reveals it is indeed theirs. He demands speaking over a secure channel and after you have established one, he continues with sarcastic congratulations on your victory. He then gives you an offer: If you travel to three different locations as he instructs and assassinate the the Serpentis leaders operating there, he will reward you handsomely. He gives you coordinates to a location in a "take it or leave it" manner before bidding you farewell and adds that he will contact you after the first target is destroyed.
