It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. Destroyers (and their Tech 3 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Coreli B-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules.

pockets.title: Fourth room
pockets.prose: Due to the large number of ships and potentially high DPS, it is advised to destroy only the Shadow Serpentis Warden, bookmark the wreck, and warp out.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Warden
rows.cargo: Can drop Coreli B-type or Shadow Serpentis modules

messages: Despite their persistent claims to the contrary, the criminal organization known as the Serpentis has extensive ties in the underworld of human trafficking, and it is an open secret among their more above-the-board business associates that facilities such as this one exist all over Serpentis territories. Serving as a center for sorting, evaluation and distribution, this place represents at once the beginning and the end for those unfortunate souls who through fate or folly find themselves in the hands of the Serpentis.

Serpentis_Logistical_Outpost.name: Serpentis Logistical Outpost
intro:
The Serpentis Logistical Outpost is combat signature that can be found in low-sec or null-sec, or as an escalation from completing the anomaly Serpentis Yard or Serpentis Rally Point. Technically the site is an unrated complex, but behaves like a DED 6/10 and thus can be considered the Serpentis DED 6/10.
The site is located behind an acceleration gate that allows T2 Battleships or lower to access and consists of two parts: Part 1 is found by probe scanning or as an escalation. Completing Part 1 will always cause an escalation to Part 2 at another location.

Warning:
The Serpentis Logistical Outpost and Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 are considered to be the hardest Serpentis Escalations.
Use extreme caution when completing the sites due to the Scramming Frigs and T2 Neuting Towers

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose: You land right on top of the frigates, which mean you land in web and point range. The rest of the NPCs spawn about 30km away from you.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: 38 km from warpin - Locked until all NPCs are cleared

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose: The Energy Neutralizing Sentries spawn by the Pressure Silo structure, so get ready to blow them up once they spawn, as they add a lot to the difficulty of this room.

blocks.title: Destroyer wave (trigger not clear, probably a battleship group)

rows.name: Core Admiral/High Admiral
rows.trigger: Highest bounty battleship triggers escalation, usually the Core Admiral

rows.name: Core Vice Admiral/
rows.trigger: Highest bounty battleship triggers escalation, usually the Core Admiral

rewards.title: Reward
rewards.text: Clearing it all gives 23.000.000 ISK in bounties. This site has no notable loot drops.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site always escalates to Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 with the following message.

messages: This is an A-Class repair and resupply post, operated by the Serpentis. Not only is it important to their operations, but has also been rumoured to be one of many hideouts utilized by their resistance movement. They are supposedly planning a revolt against the vicious oppression of the shadowy ruling body, the Furies, and will defend themselves and their compatriots with vicious resistance if attacked.

"Serpentis Logistical Outpost P2 - After disposing of the defenders, you manage to decode some of the surviving ship data-cores. The information contained within those reveals the location of a second facility."

Serpentis_Logistical_Outpost_Part_2.name: Serpentis Logistiscal Outpost Part 2
intro:
Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 is escalation from the Serpentis Logistical Outpost.

Warning:
The Serpentis Logistical Outpost and Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 are considered to be the hardest Serpentis Escalations.
Use extreme caution when completing the sites due to the Scramming Frigs and T2 Neuting Towers

pockets.title: Warp-in
pockets.prose: The rats are in 3 groups and you land in the middle of them. The initial two neut towers are close to two other towers. The two other groups have three towers each and after two minutes an additional neuting tower spawns at them. As this isn't dedspace you can warp freely. (The groups are close to some asteroids and structures so you have warpin points.) Carefully consider how you want to run the site and adapt it to your ship(s) because if you warp to the towers you'll face a good bit of DPS, be pointed, and webbed.

rows.name: Serpentis Energy Neutralizer II
rows.note: They spawn at the asteroids surrounded by the sentries

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Locked until all ships are destroyed

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
----
As in the first pocket you can warp around, so use bookmarks if needed.

In the room is a Serpentis Stronghold in the shape of a Gallente station. When warping in you face four groups of rats. One group in front of the structure is close to you when you warp in and consists of battlecruisers and frigates which web and point. One group is in the center of the structure and consists of battleships and frigates. The other two groups are on the left and right of the structure and consist of battleships and (battle-)cruisers. After a short while in the center of the structure also towers spawn (one of them is neuting). For more details see the table below.

The four groups independently trigger respawns. In theory you could only kill the center group and it's following spawns to trigger the commander wave. But in practice you'll want to at least kill all pointing frigates and the neuting tower. For the center group a new wave is triggered if it is completely cleared. For the other groups the last ship of it's biggest shipclass is the trigger. (If the spawn contained battleships the last battleship killed in this spawn will trigger a new one and so on.) [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=28864 Uehiro Katsen will approach you with microwarpdrive and projects 1050 DPS out to 21 km, with -90% web within 15 km. If you can't safely project at least 600 DPS of pure Kinetic damage beyond his weapons range, you will find killing him extremely hard.] 

Great little advice is to form a solo fleet and assign marks to the center group and its following waves for easy overview of who to kill.

rows.name: Uehiro Katsen
rows.note: He has an active tank that can tank 500 dps
rows.cargo: Can drop Corelum A-Type modules, Shadow Serpentis faction modules, implants and ship BPC. Always drops 19th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects (51,7 mil)

blocks.title: Towers spawn (middle of the Stronghold, shortly after warpin)

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
The site consists of a warpin area and one normal space pocket. 

The site is not in deadspace so you can warp around freely. Take advantage of this by making bounce bookmark ~300 km off the site as you land in. You can then use this bookmark to bounce on asteroid/wreck to get in good position. This also means that a potential hunter can warp directly to you in second room with combat probes.

rewards.title: Loot and bounties
rewards.text: The boss might drop Corelum A-type modules, shadow serpentis modules, and Vigilant BPC. He always drops 19th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. Clearing all rats gave around 50m isk bounty. Never checked salvage and so on. I usually expect salvage to be half of the bounty.

messages: Uehiro Katsen's clone has departed, and the remaining Serpentis are scattering to the wind amongst the ruins of their former operation.

Serpentis_Lookout.name: Serpentis Lookout
intro:
No NPCs at initial warp in.
Initial gate will allow Tech 2 and 3 cruisers to pass.

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
The acceleration gate to next room is locked until all ships have been destroyed. The missile battery does not need to be destroyed to proceed. Shooting at each group once before deploying drones avoids drone aggro.

The gate to the second room is 27km from warp in.

pockets.title: Second Room
pockets.prose: To trigger commander spawn destroy the destroyers by the solar harvesters. These destroyers are on left side when looking at the enemies. Escalation can be triggered by killing the commander or by destroying the Serpentis control center.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis
rows.cargo: Can drop a faction item

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: While mining after the site is complete, an additional frigate may occasionally spawn.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text:
This site has a chance to escalate to Angel Kickbacks.

Failure message

messages: As soon as you arrive, your instruments detect a large group of ships departing. Further analysis of the data indicates this was a convoy of six to eight transport ships from the Salvation Angels accompanied by an unknown number of combat vessels. Your navigational systems have already come up with a likely destination in case you feel you have any business with them.
The trail seems to have run cold at this point.

Serpentis_Military_Complex.name: Serpentis Military Complex
intro: Serpentis Military Complex is an unrated complex that can be found in null-sec. It contains two rooms.

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
It is possible to skip this entire room by flying to the gate, destroying the gate scrambler and using the gate to go to the next part. Doing so requires a good tank. 

Notable structures

pockets.title: Second Room
pockets.prose:
This room can be very challenging, and unless you are experienced, might want to team up for.

Notable structures

blocks.title: Five additional waves that together contain

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis High Admiral
rows.cargo: Faction modules

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
This combat site can be quite challenging solo without high skills and good modules. It can be done in a good drone boat, like the Gila or Ishtar. 
*In the first room you want to clear out all the NPCs before attacking the Gate Scrambler. 
*The second room can be quite challenging, since the waves arrive pretty fast on a timer. You want to kill of the frigates first because they scram you, so you can warp off if needed.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.text:
Gives around 35.000.000 ISK in bounties.

=Escalation=
If you get the escalation from destroying Slick-Silver's Control Tower, you see this message:

Can escalate to Colony Under Fire

messages:
Heuristic analysis of this location indicates that destroying Slick-Silver's Control Tower would greatly improve your odds of uncovering further illicit activity. 
Slick-Silver is a Pleasure Resort chain owned by the Sarpati family. They usually reside in Serpentis complexes and are normally well defended by pirate ships.

Going through the logs from one of the command ships you blasted, you come across a recent memo containing a draft for a plan where forces from this Military Complex and another similar to this one were to gang up and raid a space trucker station somewhere in the region. Where this space trucker station is, is not included in the logs, but the location of the rally point is there. It is supposed to be by a small asteroid belt, not to far away.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: The Serpentis Narcotic warehouse consists of total of five deadspace pockets. Due to branched nature only four of them need to be entered to get the final reward.

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text:
The main attraction of this site is the Coreli A-Type modules. The Small Armor Repairer and Small Remote Armor Repairer aren't as strong as corresponding deadspace modules from other factions due to widespread farming and cheaper prices. The Multispectrum Coating and prop mods are just as strong as corresponding deadspace modules from other factions.

It is also possible to get faction modules from the overseers but this is very rare.

Bounty: ± 1.1 Mil ISK (All five pockets)

[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nL6MOWStDWTWNYJb8Kt-asozgMC4ohUVYpALerRUSAM/copy More loot data]

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text:
This complex has a chance to escalate to another instance of itself. It is believed that this can happen only in narcotic warehouses scanned down as a Cosmic Signature.

If the Narcotic Warehouse was an escalation, the failed escalation message is

messages:
This deadspace complex was built by the Serpentis Corporation to protect and store narcotic and military supplies for their members. The complex also acts as a temporary storage area for the corporation's traffic of illicit substances. While the entrance check-in sectors of the complex are not known to be heavily guarded, certain sections house experienced security staff using top-of-the-line equipment funded by the Serpentis Corporation's income from illegal activity. 
DED Threat Assessment: Unsafe (3 of 10)

The entrance pocket of this complex contains light peripheral security around the advent ware storages. Two acceleration gates give way to two different routes inside the complex, one leading to the check-in tunnel and the other to the more heavily defended security corridor. Visitors are cleared by security at the Traffic Management office, allowing members of the Serpentis Corporation access to the Check-in Tunnel.

Check-in tunnel contains warehouses and storage's for equipment and drugs ready for categorization and registration. Incoming vessels are required to check in at the Staff Quarters before continuing to the main drug refinery and central warehouses.

The security corridor is the main defense barrier before continuing through the acceleration gate towards the main refinery and central warehouses. All guest passes and operation handling is made by the Chief of Security on duty.

The central pocket of the complex houses the drug refinery, narcotics storages and military supply warehouses. The headmaster of the drug refinery must clear all visitors before allowing entry to the acceleration gate towards the administration sector.
The final sector contains the Supply Stronghold which houses the administration staff for the entire complex. No further information is available.
The Serpentis Supply Stronghold is a smoking wreckage, and its administrators are dead, cloned, or on the run. There is now little left in the area except the quiet ruins of past criminal activity.
The trail seems to run cold at this point.
The Serpentis Supply Stronghold is a smoking wreckage, and its administrators are dead, cloned or on the run. There is now little left in the area except the quiet ruins of past criminal activity.

Single pocket. The battleships have short range weapons and the shadow serpentis is in a very fast ship. With a warpin bookmark it is possible to draw the commander away from battleships to noticeably reduce damage.

rows.name: Serpentis Research Outpost
rows.cargo: Corelum A-type modules, Vigilant Blueprint Copy

messages: Among the wreckage and debris you find a few combat drones. A scan of their control units reveals they have been used not long ago, and at a location nearby.

All these moon mining stations suggest there must be a station or outpost somewhere in the region servicing them and refining the raw materials they produce. Again you look for clues from the drones and again the data you extract suggest a new location not too far away.

Going through data scanned during the destruction of the station itself, you notice reports from a place called "R&D division Black", containing information on blueprint research and booster production and even the location of this base "Black".

Now, you kind of regret killing the Overseer back there, it is always useful to know corrupt leaders who are ready to sell out things like this outpost in exchange for something as cheap as their own petty lives.

Serpentis_Paramilitary_Complex.name: Serpentis Paramilitary Complex
intro:
Serpentis Paramilitary Complex is a Rated DED Complex (7/10) type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Nullsec systems. It can also appear as an escalation from Serpentis Forlorn Den and Serpentis Forsaken Den, in which case it may appear in lowsec.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

rows.cargo: May contain Shadow Serpentis Cruiser modules, Vigilant BPC, or Mid-grade Snake implants. May also produce Tech 2 Salvage

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Lord Admiral/Grand Admiral
rows.cargo: May contain Shadow Serpentis Battleship modules and may produce Tech 2 Salvage

pockets.title: Room 5
pockets.prose: The Shadow Serpentis Big Boss deals high damage at relatively short range, and has an armor tank that can withstand about 400-500 DPS.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Big Boss
rows.cargo: Contains 20th Tier Overseers Personal Effects. May contain Core C-type Modules, Shadow Serpentis Battleship Modules or a Vindicator BPC

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: Bounties approx 80M

messages: Though considered little more than Angel Cartel lackeys, in recent years the Serpentis have built up their own paramilitary force, far from Curse, who specialize in guerilla strikes. Their strategy is to harass Federation and CONCORD forces so that Serpentis booster manufacturing programs remain a low-priority target. In general this strategy has worked very well. Eliminating the leadership of these Serpentis guerilla teams is a top priority for any security forces. DED Threat Assessment: 7 of 10.
Sensor readings confirm and 89 percent probability of this being a Serpentis paramilitary complex. Be on the lookout for the Big Boss. Destroying it should cripple their command structure.

The next pocket is a busy place. I'm reading the engine wash signatures of Serpentis ships, but also private industrial and hauler firms. One trail has a 12 percent likelihood of belonging to a Federation Senator's liner.

Luckily for the senator, we aren't the Scope.
Big Boss presence confirmed. Remember, everyone here either is or works for a drug dealer, so we don't have to feel bad for popping them like technology-filled piñatas.

The Big Boss is down. The snakes are going to have a hard time keeping anyone busy without that bruiser of a ship. 
Don't forget to check the wreckage for any goodies.

Serpentis_Phi-Outpost.name: Serpentis Phi-Outpost
intro: Serpentis Phi-Outpost is a DED Rated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Corelum C-type and Shadow Serpentis faction modules.

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose:
thumb|First Pocket

The electronically sealed container is unlocked after certain ships have been destroyed. The acceleration gate requires the stolen passkey to get through. The key is found in the sealed container, which is located inside a Hollow Asteroid that will require a bit of manual piloting to maneuver through to reach the container.

The above statement is not expressly true. When competing for this site I have seen my competitor take the gate to the second pocket without accessing the sealed cask. Either the key is reusable or the only requirement to jump is all enemies in the pocket being destroyed.

(29 January 2026) Stolen Passkey was not consumed on use after clearing entire pocket and taking gate. It may ?? be possible to skip part of this pocket by killing the ships guarding the Electronically Sealed Container (unconfirmed).

Note: The site has been known to despawn all NPCs except for the Phi-Operation Protector.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Requires stolen passkey. Key is consumed on use.

rows.name: Electronically Sealed Container
rows.cargo: Stolen passkey, 7th Tier Overseer's Personal Effect and sometimes a faction module

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose:
----
thumb|Second Pocket

The Phi-Operation Protector battleship has a microwarpdrive, and will use it to close in on targets. On paper, its MWD can bring it up to 1000m/s, however in practice it usually will not exceed 850m/s. Its weapons are ineffective beyond around 30km, so if it can be outrun it should not be a major threat. Significantly, this battleship's armor has very high Kinetic resistance (80%) and it will actively repair itself. Its lowest resistance is Thermal (50%), which should be the damage used to kill it.

rows.name: Phi-Operation Protector
rows.note: Immune to all EWAR modules, including Target Painters
rows.cargo: Drops 9th or 8th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and possibly Corelum C-Type modules

The asteroid colonies that have been built here are for show only. This deadspace pocket contains labs and bunkers for booster production and advanced experimental neural implants.

The site is an open pocket that can be warped to at any range. 

Two battlecruisers can run this site without too much difficulty.

Each new wave spawns when the previous one is destroyed. All enemy waves spawn around the cluster of structures. Waves can vary significantly in composition. Waves 2 and 3 can spawn simultaneously. 

There are multiple variations of this site with different spawns.

messages: An enemy squadron answers their comrade's distress call and enters the fray!
The battle escalates with the arrival of more unfriendly ships.
Defense Wing Leader: Those were good men and women, you'll pay for that!

Defense Commander: We have incoming! All ships, engage the hostiles and buy the transports time to escape. We need that ore out of here!

 Transport Captain: We're in the middle of loading operations. There's no chance in hell we can take off any time soon!
Reinforcements arrive to bolster the defenses. Their arrival comes to late for their comrades however.

rewards.text: The Shadow Serpentis commanders drop faction ammo and tags, and may drop Shadow Serpentis or meta modules. The Shadow Serpentis Colonel in final location can drop Core C-Type battleship modules and possibly a rare Vigilant BPC.

messages: The amount of energy harvested and stored here is phenomenal. Exploiting these facilities for your own use might sound tempting, if it weren't for the fact that the entire place is in complete lockdown and only the highest-level Serpentis security codes will grant access. You did however manage to gain access to an open channel in their communication network, and two energy storage locations were revealed to you.

This facility was not just used for energy storage. Ships, modules and other supplies were stored in those containers, and sadly every single one was destroyed when the Serpentis commanders gave the order. They knew you were coming, and there was little they could do about it on such short notice. The slaughter continues as you prepare to visit the second energy storage facility.

You arrive at the second energy storage facility to find it completely deserted. It looks like the party ended before you even arrived. Luckily for you, your computers pick up several signals in the nearby area, one of which seems to have unusually high amounts of combat ships.

You have destroyed four strategically vital locations for the Serpentis. Their expansion in the area has been halted severely, and it would surprise you a lot if you saw even a single one of them in the near future. Whether to continue this journey is up to you, though you have no more clues which could lead you further.

Serpentis_Prison_Camp.name: Serpentis Prison Camp
intro:
Serpentis Prison Camp is a DED Rated Complex (rated 8/10) type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Nullsec systems.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

You may receive this site as an escalation from a Serpentis Hub or a Serpentis Forsaken Rally Point.

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Grand Admiral
rows.cargo: May contain Shadow Serpentis Ammo, Tags, and Shadow Serpentis Battleship Modules

rows.name: Acceleration Gate
rows.note: Unlocks when all defenders are destroyed

pockets.title: Room 4
pockets.prose:
Note: The Serpentis Prisoner Isolation Facility (the structure that contains your loot) has a very strong web and will immediately target you upon warp in. Be prepared to not be able to speed tank or move closer to the structure. Also of note is that it shoots XL Inferno torpedoes that do approx 2000 thermal damage, though their explosion radius is appropriate to the signature radius of capital ships so they apply little damage to battleships or smaller ships. The outpost also repairs itself to the tune of about 1000 DPS and has lots of structure hit points. 

Incoming damage can be very high by reason of the Stasis Towers and the structure's web. Suggest refitting for maximum tank. Kill the webbing towers first, then the Elite Frigates, then move on to the rest. Profile is shown here: [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=3809 Database Entry] 

There is a glitch Last verified by Ageon Targaryeon on 15 January 2024 on this structure whereby the structure will stop repairing armor if it switches aggro. The structure's armor repair can be turned off by forcing it to switch its primary target (the target it fires torpedoes at and webs). A drone ship does this by having its drones out and attacking the structure, then flying over 120km away from it. Players in ships without drones will have to have ensure another pilot is in space within application range of the structure.

rows.name: Serpentis Prisoner Isolation Facility
rows.cargo: Contains 21st Tier Overseers Effects, and may contain Core B-type Battleship modules or a Vindicator BPC

notes.text:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fx4GOO7Mz9w Video guide]

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: Clearing it all gives 29.500.000 ISK in bounties.

messages:
"The Serpentis Corporation has long been the principal source for boosters and other designer drugs traded in open space. One of the keys to their continued success is a strict internal policy of monitoring and controlling the drug use of their own employees. Members of Serpentis Corp deemed too addicted to their own products are sent to Serpentis prison facilities. Here the inmates are subjected to extreme detoxing methods, from complete isolation to gene-alteration procedures.
 Rumors persist of Serpentis using the more “creative” of their inmates in extreme R and D programs, essentially working them to death in pursuit of better starship modules.
 DED Threat Assessment: 8 of 10"

Approaching the Administrative Complex: The panicked comms I am reading indicate that an administration facility on the other side of this gate houses a stockpile of experimental Serpentis tech. My best guess is the facility will be the one that shoots back.

Serpentis_Provincial_HQ.name: Serpentis Provincial HQ

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
The Acceleration Gate "Gate to the Sarpati Luxury Lodge" remains locked after destroying the initial spawn. It may be unlocked if you have a Shadow Serpentis Crystal Tag in your cargo hold when you attempt to operate the gate, or alternatively it you may destroy the Core Defense Officer's Quarters to permanently unlock it. Be warned, doing so will cause heavy reinforcements to arrive. If you pre-align with the acceleration gate before destroying the Officer's Quarters, you can instantly activate the gate as soon as the Officer's Quarters are destroyed, avoiding the reinforcements.

Notable structures

pockets.title: Second Room
pockets.prose:
The initial spawn consists of 5 Siege Blaster Sentries which constitute the main threat. They will deal significant damage (Explosive & Thermal) to any ship large and slow enough for them to hit. It is highly recommended to completely clear this initial spawn prior to assaulting the station.

The two reinforcement waves may be triggered seperately by aggressing the Sarpati Luxury Lodge with a non-damaging hostile module such as a Target Painter. Otherwise, the second reinforcement wave can be triggered very quickly after the first, resulting in a combined spawn with high incoming damage.

Notable structures

notes.text:
The Serpentis Provincial HQ is a Cosmic Signature of the Unrated Complex type, occupied by the Serpentis pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Null-sec systems.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battleship class or smaller.

This site's acceleration gate allows only Battleship class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

~ 23 million in loot and salvage without shadow drop. About 58 million in bounty

=Escalation=
After killing Shadow Serpentis BS or Sarpati Luxury Lodge you might get the escalation Serpentis Secrets

messages: Sarpati Luxury Lodge is open only to the very elite members of the Serpentis organization. This is where they relax and clear their thoughts during infrequent vacations from pirating and internal politics

"As the dust settles from the battle, you receive a transmission from someone claiming to be a local vigilante who congratulates you on a job well done. Your computers run a check on his ship ID´s and other info they can gather on him in such a short period of time, but come up with nothing. He is at least not a part of any pirate faction, nor seems he to represent any of the official states in the galaxy. This person continues to welcome you to the area and offers to point you to some other Serpentis bases he knows about and have been a menace for the local population. If you want to come and meet him, he will lead the way."

Serpentis_Rally_Point.name: Serpentis Rally Point
intro:
Serpentis Rally Point is a Class 6 combat anomaly that can be found in low and null sec space.

Total bounties amount to around 4,500,000 ISK.

There are two variants of the site.

pockets.title: Walkthrough (silo spawn)
pockets.prose:
The site is an open deadspace pocket that can be warped to at any range. Tower Sentry Angels give Serpentis standing hit despite belonging to the Angel Cartel.

Sentries spawn 35-40 km away from the warp-in point. All other ships spawn at 0 on the anomaly.

There are two storage silos in the site that drop T1 ammo when destroyed.

Shadow Serpentis Captain Sentry
rows.cargo: Faction loot

rows.name: Storage Silo
rows.cargo: T1 ammo

Shadow Serpentis Platoon Leader
rows.cargo: Faction loot

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: This site can escalate to Serpentis Logistical Outpost.

messages: The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V. Salvador Sarpati. At first, it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties to the underworld grew, and Serpentis research stations scattered around in remote areas became notorious pirate havens. Sarpati made a deal with the Angel Cartel early on to provide protection for his stations, and this duty was eventually taken on by the Guardian Angels. Both sides have prospered enormously from this deal - Serpentis can operate in peace, and the Angel Cartel gets access to the illegal research efforts of the Serpentis conglomerate. It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the main developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renowned specialist in that field. The home of Serpentis is in the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.
The fuel in the Storage Silo ignites and explodes outwards in a violent fireball!
Squadron Leader: You will pay for that!

More hostiles warp into the area!
Squadron Leader: You murdering bastard! Those men had families!
Yet more ships arrive, their crews intent on avenging their fallen comrades!
Your scanner has picked up a transmission originating from a nearby system. It would be wise to investigate this mysterious signal further.

Serpentis_Refuge.name: Serpentis Refuge
intro:
Serpentis Refuge is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can enter this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (up to T2 battleships for high-security systems, and titans in low-security and null-security systems). 

Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of frigate- and destroyer-sized enemy ships, as well as two batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses complex.

pockets.prose: The site is an open deadspace pocket that can be warped to at any range.

Serpentis_Sanctum.name: Serpentis Sanctum
intro:
Serpentis Sanctum is a combat anomaly found in Serpentis infested null security regions.
Serpentis Sanctum comes in two types.

pockets.title: Type 1
pockets.prose:
Type 1 consists of one ungated pocket. In the pocket, you will find 5 large structures called Magnetic Double-capped Bubble and the initial NPCs between them.
If you have a mobil tractor unit, start orbiting it. If not, you can orbit one of the structures in the pocket.
Start by killing the smallest size ships, and save the next wave trigger NPC for last.

rows.trigger: Last Lord Admiral triggers next wave

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis
rows.cargo: May drop deadspace & faction modules

pockets.title: Type 2
pockets.prose:
Information on this site is not very accurate.

Type 2 consists of one ungated pocket. In the pocket, you will a very large station (Pirate Complex), rock formations and scattered rocks. Initial Defenders spawn a few seconds after arriving into the site.

* ~35.000.000 ISK bounty
* ~19.000.000 ISK in salvage
* Possibility for rare drop

Serpentis_Secrets.name: Serpentis Secrets
intro: Serpentis Secrets is an expedition that escalates from Serpentis Provincial HQ and can lead into both low-sec and null-sec regions.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Lord Admiral
rows.cargo: Drops faction ammo, tags and chance of faction modules

pockets.title: Second Location
pockets.prose:
This site consists of one ungated room. 

The enemies are grouped in in four separate groups. You spawn in the middle of them. 
The two statis towers webs you to a halt, making you take A LOT of damage, and the damping makes them hard to hit. This can make the site hard to survive.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis Lord Admiral
rows.cargo: Faction modules, tags and ammo

pockets.title: Third Location
pockets.prose:
This site is yet another ungated pocket. You spawn 100km from the NPCs and the two web-towers makes the travel to the station very slow, while the damp makes hitting anything hard. 
If you get the Shadow Serpentis Battleship to spawn, kill it for the escalation. If not, destroy the station. 
The Siege Sentries does a lot of damage, but they are only two. Clear the area of rats before you engage the station.

rows.name: Shadow Serpentis High Admiral
rows.note: He comes to you, so you don't have to travel 100km webbed.
rows.cargo: Faction modules, tags and ammo

rows.name: Serpentis Defense Sentinel

blocks.title: Reinforcement wave - Triggers upon station damage

pockets.title: Fourth and Last Location
pockets.prose:
Access: Gateless, Open Access 

This site is extremely difficult, and can require 3-4 people in very tough ships. The site contains 4 waves, and if you manage to spawn 2 at once, the site is near impossible. 
The four waves trigger when you attack the Serpentis Privateer Stronghold (wave 1), when it reaches 50% shields (wave 2), at 25% shield (wave 3), and when it goes into armor (wave 4). 
 You spawn 200 km from the station.
Kill the frigates, then the web-towers, then the siege blasters and then the rest.

This wave spawn about 250km from the station, close to the warp-in location. They are spread in 4 groups.

An easy and fast wave that spawns about 200km from the station.

The fourth and last wave is the commander wave. It spawn at 0 on station. The drones web and the frigates points, while Heysus deals approx. 1800 dps from about 125km away. [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=26796] 
The drones are VERY fast, so the best strategy seems to damage the station while aligned to a bookmark 200+ km off, and warp to it as soon as they spawn. Then kill the drones while they come to you, then the frigates after.

rows.name: Serpentis Privateer Stronghold
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements at different damage intervals

rows.name: Privateer Admiral Heysus Sarpati
rows.note: Does approx 1800 dps from 125km, can tank 700 dps, orbits at long range.
rows.cargo: X-type deadspace, faction modules, chance for BPC

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: This escalation consists of four parts.

notes.title: First Part
notes.text:
The first room is ungated, meaning you can warp around in it, and people can warp directly to you. 
If Shadow Serpentis is there: kill him, possibly get escalation. Else (or If didn't get escalation): Use acceleration gate, possibly get escalation.

notes.title: First room
notes.text:
Entering this room can trigger the escalation. 

In the room you find a lot of Siloes and a structure/ship called "Ours De Soin".

messages: Ours De Soin: Good to see you decided to come. I can not promise you any payment if you take on these Serpentis bases, but you will earn fame among the locals and the fortune the Serpentis leave behind. I'm going to send a couple of my spy drones to see if the Serpentis are still where they were yesterday.

Your communication instruments finally come alive as the Serpentis contact who hired you starts talking on the private channel. Even though the area was empty, he commends you on a job well done and gives you directions to the next assassination target.
Control Center Operator: More intruders! Maybe they're connected with the spy drones we just destroyed. I bet CONCORD sent them! Take care of them mates!

"We sure did show them! You sure are better than no one to have around when the missiles are flying! But there is no time to float here fabulating, we must press on, another division of this same group is close by!"

"We sure did show them! You sure are better than no one to have around when the missiles are flying! But there is no time to float here fabulating, we must press on, another division of this same group is close by! I will pop over and scout, check if they are there still!" All these exclamation marks make you dizzy. It may well be that this guy is not much of a fighter, but he is no coward and you wonder if it is not hard to do scouting missions on an industrial... Around 30 seconds later you receive a transmission "OMG the bastards have scrambled me!! I am getting killed here! Help Help! I am at moon six, where is everyone, come.." and then the transmission stops. You turn off the radio, there are too many "moon 6" around for you to go looking, and besides, this guy has probably already been turned into two tablespoons of space dust by now.

As you enter, you see your friend several hundred kilometers off target, complaining about something being rotten in the hydraulic systems. With the Serpentis on the other hand, it seems like all systems are go.

I hope you will manage without me, but I am going to check the next and last target. It is a central station for the local Serpentis. We don't want them to get away. I will hold them busy till you arrive!

"I'll keep them busy till you arrive!" He sounds optimistic, but the only way he's going to hold them back is with colorful language. Your computer provides you with the coordinates and you can already hear the sounds of battle coming through the channel.

Heysus Sarpati: So we meet at last. You are most likely the one that has been disrupting our operations recently. I must say, I'm impressed with your ability to crush my comrades. But taking on me is an entirely different matter.
Since you've done so well for yourself, I'll give you the comforting knowledge that your body will be sent to your family in one piece. And if you have any close relatives that show promise in the space-combat business, I'll make sure to offer them a place at my side.
 Hostile ships have warped into range to defend the station!

This was a hard fight and even though your friend didn't fire many shots, he did his best to call them. Gutsy little fellow. You would think that by now he should have used half of all superlatives in the English language to describe your victory, but surprisingly enough he is dead silent there where he is orbiting the remains of this holy space. Close inspection reveals that he has taken a direct hit and even though his ship looks intact, all the airlocks have been blasted out and either he must have died from the explosion, or he is lying there frozen from the exposure. It is kind of sad... not that you will miss him personally, but you can be darn sure that if he had lived to run around and tell the story, you would have been a legendary hero 24 hours from now.

Serpentis_Vigil.name: Serpentis Vigil
intro:
Serpentis Vigil is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. It is presumed that Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as Tech 2 implants. 

This combat site consists of two deadspace complexes, the second of which hosts Tago Uriken, the site's overseer. Access to the second complex is given by destroying all remaining hostile ships at the first complex. Defeating Tago Uriken may escalate into the Booster R&D expedition.

pockets.title: First Room
pockets.prose:
The gate in first room can be unlocked by killing all ships. Note that even though the message after Drug Trader is killed suggests that the gate unlocks you still need to kill all remaining ships. There are three spawns that appear to be timed.

Video: [[https://youtu.be/47dSQBYkDBI Astero] February 2021]

First group immediately aggresses on warpin.

rows.cargo: t1 ammo and drones

pockets.title: Second room
pockets.prose:
----

Overseer Spawn appears after destroying one of the sentry towers.

rows.trigger: Destroying any one triggers overseer spawn

rows.cargo: May drop Shadow Serpentis faction modules, T2 implants or a Vigilant BPC

rewards.text: ± 4.5 Mil ISK

escalation.title: Escalation

messages: Previous explorers have commented that one of the gates requires a passkey. Alternatively, it can be bypassed by convincing the commander to unlock it.
Strange sounds emit from the acceleration gate as soon as the Core Drug Trader vessel is destroyed. Perhaps the locking mechanism was in some way connected with the ship's computer.
Core ships have undocked from the nearby Serpentis Hangars, with guns flaring.
Message after destroying one of the sentries
Tago Uriken: Arg, do you know how expensive those sentry guns are? You just cost me a fortune! I'll have your head mounted on a pig-pole for that, scumbag.

Going through the items found in the Serpentis outpost, you notice some unused boosters still in their original packs complete with documentation and bear the seal of the Serpentis Corporation. The documentation notes further that these boosters as "Field Test" material and not for common consumption and at the bottom there is ordering info, stating item number and the makers electronic address. Feeling it is worth a shot, you set your communication instruments to emulate those of the Serpentis facility you just laid to waste, feed in the booster factory addy and hit send. And lo and behold, you get an instant reply, a sleepy sounding female voice says "SC medical research 504, good day. How may I help you? Oh! It is Vigil 15? I have a message for you from the supply office, they say you are late. Get to G5, pick up the materials and get here as soon as possible" She adds information on the location and tells you to talk to Nadir, also at G5 if there is anything. And with that she is off the air.

Serpentis_Watch.name: Serpentis Watch
intro: Serpentis Watch is an Unrated Complex which can be found in Hi-sec through exploration. The biggest ships in this site are two battlecruisers, one in each pocket. Serpentis rats weakest resistance is against thermal damage and they on average deal 55% thermal damage and 45% kinetic damage. If using a drone boat, set drones to passive and focus fire so they won't accidentally shoot the trigger ship and spawn the next wave, overwhelming you.

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose:
There are three options for unlocking the Acceleration gate to the next room.

* Destroy each wave until the fourth wave, and destroy the Corelum Militant Commander
* Approach the Acceleration gate, which sets off the alarm and spawns the fourth wave, skipping waves 2 and 3, and destroy the Corelum Militant Commander. If you cannot tank the rats, destroy all of them EXCEPT FOR THE CORELUM SCOUT.
* Unlock the Acceleration gate by having a Serpentis Silver Tag in your inventory (the tag is consumed).

Attack the Corelum Scout to trigger the next wave.

Attack the Corelum Scout to trigger the next wave.

Attack the Corelum Scout to trigger the next wave.

Destroy the Corelum Militant Commander to unlock the Acceleration Gate.

16 x Scordite (~1.1 million units)
26 x Veldspar (~1.25 million units)

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose:
Tower wave is triggered by attacking the Starbase Control Tower. It will not spawn if the Gate Wave is already destroyed. 

Gate wave is triggered by attacking the Smuggler's Gate. Simply using an EWAR module(preferably Target Painter) works. Shooting at the gate will also trigger tower wave if it has not been triggered already.

The gate wave consists of one large group by the gate and three smaller groups scattered around the site. Once all groups are in range the incoming dps can be too much for t1 cruiser or even a battlecruiser.

The commander wave is triggered by destroying Supervisor's Guardians (in the Gate Wave). The Shadow Serpentis frigate will approach you very quickly, at 1700 m/s. He can be separated from the others, therefore avoiding a lot of DPS. Supervisor's Henchmen tend to keep behind the supervisor and regularly retarget drones.

rows.name: Core Gate Guardian (Corelum Chief Scout/Chief Spy)
Supervisor's Guardian

notes.title: Difficulty & Ship Recommendation
notes.text: This site is possible to complete in a T1 Cruiser, however the damage can easily become excessive if care is not taken in managing the triggers. It is recommended to bring a well-tanked T2 Heavy Assault Cruiser or Battlecruiser.

notes.text: You will arrive at an ancient acceleration gate.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text:
This site has a chance to escalate to Jet-Set Hooligans. 

Previously the escalation message was much more entertaining and read

messages: Upon warping to the site a popup appears saying

Previous explorers have commented that one of the gates requires a passkey. Alternatively, it can be bypassed by convincing the commander to unlock it. The overseer guards the Starbase Control Tower vigorously.
As it's attacked, the Corelum Scout immediately calls for backup.
As it's attacked, the Corelum Scout immediately calls for backup.

Militant Commander: Well well, look who the cat dragged in. I explicitly told those good-for-nothing rats to prevent anyone from approaching the gate, and yet here you are. I'm afraid I'm going to have to kill you now.
Something clicks in the gate once the Militant Commander has been destroyed.
Someone triggered an alarm near the acceleration gate.

Smuggler Gate Operator: Intruders! Defend the gate! A distress signal is sent when the Starbase Control Tower is attacked! Hostile reinforcements are incoming! A group of Core activists have jumped through the stargate to defend the Starbase Control Tower!

Core Militant Overseer: Imbeciles. I'm surrounded by imbeciles. I spent a fortune on this place and you can't even defend it from some rag-tag outsiders. Pfft! I deal with you all after I mob the floor with these pests. The overseer has come to defend the stargate. Prepare for a fight.
As soon as the smuggler gate is attacked, it activates and out comes a group of angry Core guardians.
As the dust disperses, you receive a transmission from a few jumps away. You feel a certain temptation to go and investigate.

As the dust disperses, you receive a transmission from someone claiming to have had some rather intimite relations with your sister and that he is waiting for you a few jumps away, to see what you are going to do about it. Despite the fact that you have no sister that you know of and the guy sounds like he has been drinking more than just Quafe, you feel a certain temptation to go and see what this is all about.

pockets.prose:
Access: Gateless, Open Access 

This site is rather easy. Mind the wave trigger and destroy the Energy Neutralizers fast and you should have no problems. 
There are no warp disrupters on any of the NPCs, so you can come and leave as you see fit. 
Remember that since the site is gateless, you can make bookmarks you can warp to. 

Note: December 29th 2018 - Sentry wave never spawned

Note: February 9th, 2020 - Sentry wave does in fact spawn, about 4-5 minutes after warp-in. They neutralize 61 GJ per cycle each.

Note: May 2020/2022 - The sentries never spawned.

Note: May 5th, 2023 - Sentry wave did spawn, Neutralizing 75 GJ per cycle each.

escalation.title: Escalation: Shadow Serpentis Fleet Staging Point, Part 3
escalation.text:
Access: Gateless, Open Access 

This site can be hard or easy, depending on how you approach it. It is very easy to accidentally trigger all 3 reinforcement waves. They are triggered at 70% station shield, at 30% shield and at 50% armor. 
You should first clear out any NPCs. Then do minimal damage to get the stations shield to 70%, clear out that wave and repeat for the next wave and the last wave. Consider de-grouping launchers or/and only using some of the drones. If you do it in groups, coordinate with the others. Station tanks ~1,000 dps. Avoid using Sentry drones as they may auto aggress the structure

messages: The last Serpentis Battleship sends out a distress signal before it goes down. Luckily your com systems have managed to decrypt the message and follow it to it's final destination.

My experience was quite different. During the initial wave, my drones accidentally shot the control tower. This immediately spawned waves 1 and 2, first volley spawned wave 1 and second volley spawned wave 2 before I recalled. For reference this was in a 0.3 system. Not certain of web max range, but it could not reach 75km. The neut towers, however, did reach that far.

notes.text: All four parts are in Sansha infested nullsec. The first two locations are ungated, while the last two have acceleration gates which permit subcaptials.

messages: As the bits and pieces from the disintegrated station charge into space, carrying the news of heightened entropy in the universe, your instruments receive an unusual message. It obviously is being transmitted from a Sansha ship and even though the person on the other end does not introduce himself as such, there is no doubt that this is the voice of one of those facistic Sansha pricks who have "True Power" printed on their undies. He demands talking in a closed channel and after you have establised one, he continues with some congratulations on your brave victory and then he gives you an offer; If you go to three different locations he provides, assassinate the Sansha leaders operating there and gather all loot you find for him, he will pay you one billion ISK. He then gives you coordinates to a location in a "take it or leave it" manner, before saying farewell and adds that he will contact you after this first target is destroyed.
Having waited for this devious Sansha guy for a while, you are starting to think he is not going to show up at all. You kind of feel used ... but on the other hand, you got to rob some more Sanshas.

Finally your communication instruments come alive as this devious Sansha guy who hired you starts talking on the private channel. He commends you on a job well done and gives you directions to the next assassination target.
This time your employer is right on time with the coordinates to the last location. He sounds somewhat stressed, but before you can reply he is gone.

After blowing up his third rival, you have probably come closer than you ever will to hear how an uptight head honcho with the Sanshas sounds when he is ecstatically pleased. He gives you one last location, tells you to come meet him there and take with you everything you looted from the three raids. It is pay day.

You have always been a bit ambivalent to having a day job and the employers you knew have more often than not been bastards. This one was no exception, leaving without a trace and no sight of the "billion ISK reward". You curse yourself for being so gullible.

Nothing but an old deserted bunker, owned by True Power and probably used as a slave holding place. After a short search, you find a short list of co-ordinates leading to similar facilities nearby.
Again a True Power slave hold and this time it was inhabited. You have a second look at the list of locations you found and pick out the nearest one.

Again a slave hold run by the Sansha True Power corporation, much like the last one and now nothing but a smoldering ruin. On the navigation panel, you punch in all of the remaining locations from the list you found and a new flight plan pops up.

pockets.title: Fourth Location
pockets.prose:
The rats are spread out in 5 groups. Avoid triggering 2 waves at once; if that happens, the site is practically impossible. Try to eliminate the Siege Autocannon sentries as soon as possible, there are 10 of them and they deal VERY high DPS.

The third and final wave is the commander wave. It is triggered by bringing the Angel Military Outpost into structure. This is a hard wave, as the large number of elite frigates can keep you halted in one spot, while the overseer battleship (Einhas Malak) deals a LOT of damage. Recommend keeping over 15 km from the elite frigates so you won't get webbed and pointed while Einhas Malak puts your tank to the acid test.

Einhas Malak does about 3000 points of Explosive damage and 700-900 points of Kinetic damage. He also repairs both shield and armor, with strong passive shield and armor tanks with his shield recharging at about 300 DPS and his armor at about 250. Recommend over 85% resists to Explosive and Kinetic damage and at least 550 DPS to break Einhas. He has 76% EM and Kinetic resists and 66% Explosive and Thermal resists.

rows.trigger: Attacking triggers outpost wave; damaging into structure triggers overseer wave. Destroying triggers expedition end

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: The second, third and fourth locations are ungated, and either strongly tanked T3C, Battleships, Marauders or a carrier are recommended due to the VERY high DPS in the third and fourth locations.

messages: As the dust settles from the battle, you receive a transmission from someone claiming to be a local vigilante who congratulates you on a job well done. Your computers run a check on his ship ID´s and other info they can gather on him in such a short period of time, but come up with nothing. He is at least not a part of any pirate faction, nor seems he to represent any of the official states in the galaxy. This person continues to welcome you to the area and offers to point you to some other Angel bases he knows about and have been a menace for the local population. If you want to come and meet him, he will lead the way.

Kaerleiks Bjorn: Good to see you decided to come. I can not promise you any payment if you take on these Angel bases, but you will earn fame among the locals and the fortune the Angels leave behind. I'm going to send a couple of my spy drones to see if the Angels are still where they were yesterday.
The radio crackles with the vigilante's excited whispering. "They're still here! Come quick and we'll show them a whole new definition of pain!"
Control Tower Operator: More intruders! Maybe they're connected with the spy drones we just destroyed. I bet CONCORD sent them! Take care of 'em boys!

Kaerleiks Bjorn: We sure showed them! I'm actually starting to think I'll become a fighter some day. Will you teach me? Maybe after we're done ...
We sure did show them! You sure are better than no one to have around when the missiles are flying! But there is no time to float here fabulating, we must press on, another division of this same group is close by!

As you enter, you see your friend several hundred kilometers off target, complaining about something being rotten in the hydraulic systems. With the Angels on the other hand, it seems like all systems are go.

Kaerleiks Bjorn: I hope you will manage without me, but I am going to check the next and last target. It is a central station for a bunch of Domination members. We don't want them to get away, I will hold them busy till you arrive!

"I will hold them busy till you arrive!" Yea right, the only way he is going to hold them up is to stun them with a steady flow of exclamation marks, the Dominations are no joke. This innermost circle of the Angel cartel is legendary for its brutality and the unparalleled skill of their pilots. Soon the radio livens again when this chatty vigilant type sends a message to his newfound friend "Yes, they are here and it seems the element of surprise is on our side! I suggest that you open with a full frontal assault, so I can charge from the side, surround their flanks and drive a stake through their rotten hearts! I will need to stay of the air for now, I am launching a covert op through deceptive tactics in order to get into position! Good luck !! " You feel the only appropriate answer is "Mmmm..k", Come to think of it, this might be a 12 year old who has stolen his mom's ship. Anyways, there is nothing to wait for, there are the coordinates and the enemy is waiting. "

Einhas Malak: So we meet at last. You are most likely the one that has been disrupting our operations recently. I must say, I'm impressed with your ability to crush my subordinates. But taking on me is an entirely different matter.

Since you've done so well for yourself, I'll give you the comforting knowledge that your body will be sent to your family in one piece. And if you have any close relatives that show promise in the space-combat business, I'll make sure to offer them a place at my side.
Clouds of electric gas spurt from the station's hull as it is quickly falling apart.

messages: As the bits and pieces from the disintegrated station charge into space, carrying the news of heightened entropy in the universe, your instruments receive an unusual message. It's obviously being transmitted from the Serpentis and even though the person on the other end does not introduce himself as such, the special cypher reveals it is indeed theirs. He demands speaking over a secure channel and after you have established one, he continues with sarcastic congratulations on your victory. He then gives you an offer: If you travel to three different locations as he instructs and assassinate the Serpentis leaders operating there, he will reward you handsomely. He then gives you coordinates to a location in a "take it or leave it" manner before bidding you farewell and adds that he will contact you after the first target is destroyed.

Your communication instruments finally come alive as the Serpentis contact who hired you starts talking on the private channel. Even though the area was empty, he commends you on a job well done and gives you directions to the next assassination target.
This time your employer is right on time with the coordinates to the last location. He sounds somewhat stressed, but before you can reply he is gone.

After blowing up the third rival, you have probably come closer than you ever will to hearing how a debauched officer of the Serpentis sounds when he is ecstatically pleased. He gives you one last location and tells you to meet him there. It's payday.
You have always been a bit ambivalent to having a day job and the employers you knew have more often than been bastards. This one however was ok, if only you could have more like him.

messages: All through the battle, one of the Gurista cruisers was engaged in intense and thoroughly encrypted communications with some other ship in another system. Even though you didn't understand a thing of what was being said, your scanners successfully managed to locate the other party.
"Someone has approached the Viral Stash too closely, triggering an explosion from a hidden trap nearby!"

"In this container you find stacks of barrels containing viral agent, as well as a list of ship ID's, barrel ID's and times. Most of the times have passed, but the very last one is only a couple of minutes from now, perhaps if you intercept this ship that is supposedly arriving, you may find out more."
Gurista's Relay Officer: Who are you !? I wasn't told of anyone guarding our Viral Stash. If you don't give me identification codes immediately, I'll have to assume you're a looter.
Sadly, the datacore of this ship has taken a direct hit and any information stored there has gone up in smoke.

After a brief search of the ship's datacore, you find out that the Guristas, under contract from an unnamed third party, are supposed to disperse the viral agent in the atmosphere of two terrestrial planets in Caldari space. No information is given about which planets, but you do discover the coordinates of a rally point for the operation. It appears that a sizeable fleet was supposed to meet there.
The destruction of the Stasis Drone has alerted a nearby Pith patrol.
The destruction of the Pith Relay Commander's personal elite drone has drawn his attention. He has arrived with an escort from a nearby area.

Scanning through the remains of the lead ship, you find no further information on which planets were supposed to be terrorized, but you do find a location where a meeting has been scheduled with whoever organized the operation.

A ship pops into view.
The ship has left almost immediately, probably as soon as it discovered your presence here. It left a nasty present for you, however.

Right before the ship left, it deployed a number of drones. Prepare for a fight.

You are not sure, but it seemed like the ship that slipped away had the markings of the dreaded Federal Intelligence Organization, a Gallente covert-op branch. If this is true, it bodes no good for the Caldari state, nor does it for the Gallenteans come to think of it. Action like this viral terror attack would probably be taken as a war declaration, not that the peace has been so convincing lately between the two. Whatever is to be made of it, your options to affect this matter either way have run out. You have no idea where the agent went and if this was indeed a FIO agent, he is probably already docking in some FIO base in the neighborhood and those bases are not exactly made to be an easy find.

You are not sure, but it seemed like the ship that slipped away had the markings of the dreaded Federal Intelligence Organization, a Gallente covert-op branch. If this is true, it bodes no good for the Caldari state, nor does it for the Gallenteans come to think of it. Action like this viral terror attack would probably be taken as a full-scale war declaration, not that the peace has been so convincing lately between the two. Whatever is to be made of it, it seems like your instruments got a lock on the agents jump as he cleared local space and the approximate destination is already flashing on your navigation panel. You are not sure if it is a good idea to follow it though, crashing uninvited into a FIO base could be more than you can handle. Either way, you probably only have mere minutes to get there in time.
More FIO ships undock from nearby bunkers to defend their base, along with an envoy ship from the Guristas!

Thankfully this was only a minor hideout and not fully manned either it seems. If the plot to corrupt the atmosphere of those Caldari planets and thereby escalating the hostilities in the region was hatched here, it has been effectively stopped. Which is of course very likely ...

Warp out to that celestial, then warp to your bookmark at 30km. You'll land right on the TS spawn for a quick kill. Bookmark wreck and warp out, loot in 2 minutes after the site despawns.

rows.trigger: Triggers multiple waves 1 to 5. Unknown what health triggers next wave, so shoot until the next wave is triggered

rows.name: Colonial Master Diabolus Maytor
rows.cargo: Wreck contains possible True Sansha faction modules, ammo/tags, Nightmare BPC and produces T2 salvage

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text:
This escalation has 4 locations, typically each location is 6-10 jumps between each other and can cross regional boundaries. Locations 1-3 are easier to blitz, but Location 4 is one of the hardest sites that exists in Eve.

It is not guaranteed for each location to escalate. After each location, killing the True Sansha Battleship will either trigger the escalation to the next location or not. If not, your time with the site is over.

Full details for this expedition are not currently available, the below is provided as best effort because this is a rare escalation.

No rats warp disrupt/scram in this entire escalation as of writing.

messages: As the dust settles from the battle, you receive a transmission from someone claiming to be a local vigilante who congratulates you on a job well done. Your computers run a check on his ship ID's and other info they can gather on him in such a short period of time, but come up with nothing. He is at least not part of any pirate faction, nor seems he to represent any of the official states in the galaxy. This person continues to welcome you to the area and offers to point you to some other Sansha bases he knows about and have been a menace for the local population. If you want to come and meet him, he will lead the way.
On gate activation to empty pocket

message in local: "Orso Di Cura: Good to see you decided to come. I can not promise you any payment if you take on these Sansha bases, but you will earn fame among the locals and the fortune the Sansha leave behind. I'm going to send a couple of my spy drones to see if the Sansha are still where they were yesterday."
The radio crackles, it is the vigilante all excited, who whispers in a conspiratorial tone "They are still here! Come quick and we shall introduce them to pain!"

"We sure did show them! You sure are better than no one to have around when the missiles are flying! But there is no time to float here fabulating, we must press on, another division of this same group is close by! I will pop over and scout, check if they are there still!" All these exclamation marks make you dizzy. It may well be that this guy is not much of a fighter, but he is no coward and you wonder if it is not hard to do scouting missions on an industrial... Around 30 seconds later you receive a transmission "OMG the bastards have scrambled me!! I am getting killed here! Help! Help! I am at moon six, where is everyone, come.." and then the transmission stops. You turn off the radio, there are too many "moon 6" around for you to go looking, and besides, this guy has probably already been turned into two tablespoons of space dust by now.

The_Big_Blue_(expedition).name: The Big Blue (expedition)
intro:
The Big Blue is an expedition which can be earned by destroying Pat Wead in Angel Vigil combat sites. The completion of each segment has a random chance of giving the next segment in the chain.

 

The initial escalation from Angel Vigil is thought to be around 10%, but each stage escalating higher is thought to be around 75%. High level angel drops are possible at each stage.

pockets.title: The Big Blue (Stage 1)
pockets.prose:
Faction: Angel Cartel Mission Type: Exploration - Escalation Space Type: Normal Damage Dealt: Explosive/Kinetic Web/Scramble: Arch Gistii Outlaws Extras: Domination Smasher - Target Paints Recommended Damage Dealing: Explosive/Kinetic Recommended Ships: Battlecruiser with robust T2 tank, Kinetic/Explosive resists over 60%

 Loot: 

*Total: +/- 3.0M 
*Bounties 1.6M 
*Loot 538K 
*Salvage +/- 1.0M 
*Loot from Commander drop (initial author) Implant Low-Grade Halo Alpha, 1000 faction ammo 
*Structures drop no loot.

pockets.title: The Big Blue (Stage 2)
pockets.prose:
Faction: Angel Cartel and Drone Mission Type: Exploration - Escallation Space Type: Normal Damage Dealt: Explosive/ Kinetic Web/ Scramble: None Recommended Damage Dealing: Explosive/ Kinetic Notes: New spawns can target your drones, structures drop no loot 

Loot: Total: +/- 3.8M Bounties: 1.3M Loot +/- 1.2M (Includes minerals from Drones) Salvage: Widely variable based on commander slavage Commander drops noted: Low-Grade Halo Delta, (2nd run - Low-grade Halo Omega) 
Commander drops noted (25.07.2011): Cynabal BPC (~180mil), Arch Angel Nuclear M x1000, Domination Stasis Webifier (~100mil) and some T1 items

Destroying the second battlecruiser will either end the expedition (if unlucky) or give you a popup to the next escallation. Escallation popup : "Another Salvation Angels beacon and this time fully functional probably put here by a surveying ship. It gives directions to another location not far away."

*Highsec, possible lowsec
