Destroying the web/ scramble ships quickly may be even more important in low sec systems (But that may be the trigger for the next spawn). New spawns can target your drones. Bring a lot of ammo for the Drug factory.

Upon warp in the [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=11077 'Drug Factory - Angels in Heaven'] and a few other structures are all that are visible.

Spawn 5 (about 10 seconds after the Hauler spawns)

About 6 - 8 ships including one cargo vessel. These warp off quickly. (Before I could target one.)

blocks.title: Wave 4 (Spawns on Drug Factory half structure.)

rows.name: Angel Hauler
rows.cargo: Wreck may contain faction modules/ammo, implant BPC, ship BPC. May produce Tech 2 salvage (unconfirmed)

messages: Scanning through Pat Wead's logs reveals that this druglord was surprisingly well connected, long lists of buyers and sellers throughout the neighboring regions would make this document a dream read of any law enforcement agent in the galaxy, if only all the vital parts were not in some completely alien code. No matter how much you let your central computer chew on this stuff, you get no feedback on any names or places, execpt perhaps one... this seems to be a hasty entry from almost a year back, not in code. At least the coordinates do reflect a true point in space.

Among the debris of this old factory, you find a homing beacon next to a container bearing the Salvation Angel seal. It looks as if they have been going through the rubble, gathering whatever the attackers have spared. It seems the beacon is malfunctioning and periodically sending out some garbled messages, something that is not so remarkable in itself, but the messages are getting answered... your instruments quickly nail down the location of the responder.
Broken Message: Th* is *nder invegrrrrrrr rrrrrr rrrrr by DED. It seems someone has disabled the warning beacon.
"Luckily your instruments got a lock on the escaping ships destination."

With all this Blue Pill out of circulation, you probably just sent some thousands of BP munches on a cold turkey. Then again, you could perhaps make nice profit selling it to them yourself. Choices...Choices...

The_Drone_Roulette.name: The Drone Roulette
intro: This expedition can escalate from Independence. This escalation can also re-escalate to another drone roulette. The last part of this escalation may be received randomly after any stage.

rows.cargo: Can drop faction items.

rows.name: Corpii Raider/Visionary
rows.cargo: Can drop faction items.

rows.name: Sentient Domination
rows.cargo: Can drop faction items.

notes.title: Fourth location
notes.text: Large number of drones. The dozen-plus elite frigates have points and webs and their destruction triggers additional spawns, recommend sniping the frigates from range. A "drone hive mother" may also spawn.

messages: Among the debris from this formidable hive, you find a blown out hangar containing a few burnt out space ships of various types, probably the possessions of some unfortunate adventurers that came here before you and didn't live to tell the story. As your scanners routinely run through this material, they come across some report with information on a few sister hives to this one. The explorer seems to have found that each of these so called 'Independence hives' are surrounded with outposts that serve both as an early warning system against intruders on the drones territory and also as a resource gathering facility. It seems that if the hive is attacked, the drones from the outposts warp instantly back to defend it. One interesting bit of information the unfortunate explorer has noted is that the drones frequently move the hive itself between these outposts, so hunting these things is like playing Russian roulette, you never know if you are fortunate enough to hit an outpost and thereby reduce the inevitable resistance at the main hive, or if you are warping straight into the lair of the drones. The report continues to list four locations, the nearest one being...

Furtunately, these coordinates led you only to an outpost where you managed to pull some teeth from the drone hive that is looming out there somewhere. The question is where? You have three locations left and the next one is here...

Again you were fortunate enough to hit an outpost and now there are only two locations left unexplored. That should mean there is a fifty fifty chance you hit the hive itself, given there is one out there...

Another outpost. You stop for a second, weighting the possibilities of having such luck as to clear out all the outposts as you seem to have done, against the chances of there being no hive out there at all. With one location left unexplored there only one way to find out...
Message when warping to final location before fourth site

Rats! Lady luck is not in a good mood today, you have stumbled right into the hive! Now is do or die, the drones know their home has been infiltrated and they will probably melt away into space if you retreat.

The_Maze.name: The Maze
intro: The Maze is a null security DED rated site found through exploration. It can also be received as an escalation from the Guristas Haven and Guristas Sanctum.

pockets.title: 1st pocket
pockets.prose:
The gate is unlocked and the rats do not need to be killed. But you will most likely have to fly through this pocket many times so thinning out the rats is recommended.

In the room there are twelve acceleration gates. One of them leads deeper into the complex while the rest loop back. Take the bottom gate.

Experienced explorers will quickly establish a simple method to always choose the correct acceleration gate. Before taking any gate, drop a canister in front of it. If the gate returns you to the entrance, proceed to the next gate you wish to try and drop a canister in front of that one. Label each can and proceed to continue with this process until you find the right gate - make a note of which can is in front of the proper gate and either ignore or destroy all of the others.

Each acceleration gate will first send you to an empty room and then back to the beginning of the complex. When you activate the second acceleration gate, you will instantly be able to tell whether or not you are being returned to the beginning - if you are, the intro window bearing the complex's description will pop up once again.

pockets.title: 2nd pocket
pockets.prose:
After successfully navigating the correct acceleration gate you arrive in the second room of The Maze. Once again you will be confronted by a group defending the area.

Once again you are faced with a choice of twelve acceleration gates, of which only one will lead further inside the complex. Take the fifth gate from the top

pockets.title: 3rd pocket
pockets.prose: This time there are only four acceleration gates to choose from. Take the bottom gate.

pockets.title: 4th pocket
pockets.prose:
This room comprises the smallest amount of defending NPCs so far. There is a total of 14 NPCs in this room; a mixture of Cruisers and Frigates.

You have to choose between two acceleration gates. Take the one on right side.

pockets.title: 5th pocket
pockets.prose:
Warning: The Fleet Stronghold fires Kinetic Citadel Torpedoes that can instantly destroy any craft not suitably equipped for it! https://zkillboard.com/ship/25528/. Each individual hit does upwards of 500k Kinetic damage, and while they have virtually zero application to subcapitals, they will still wreck your tank if you aren't moving constantly. The station itself doesn't have significant tank, with only 120k total HP and 288 DPS shield rep.

This room contains a mixture of frigates, cruisers, and battleships along with cruise missile batteries and the fleet outpost (firing Citadel Kinetic Torpedoes). Upon attacking the outpost 4 battleships spawn. The outpost will release more waves of defenders as it takes damage. Upon the outpost's destruction a jetcan will appear with a 23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and possibly additional loot including Pith-X Type modules or a Rattlesnake BPC. 

There are 4 additional spawns that occur at damage intervals on the station. A spawn will occur at half-shield, half-armor. two-thirds structure and one third structure. Once you have reduced the station to one third structure you may as well finish it off before dealing with the spawn. [http://games.chruker.dk/eve_online/item.php?type_id=25528 Database Entry] for structure stats.

rows.name: Guristas Fleet Stronghold
rows.trigger: Triggers extra waves at damage intervals.
rows.note: Shoots Citadel Torpedoes that hit hard.
rows.cargo: 23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects, Pith X-Type and/or Dread Guristas battleship modules, possibly a Rattlesnake BPC

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: The maze contains a large number of acceleration gates. In each room one gate takes you deeper into the complex while the rest of them lead back to the first pocket.

messages:
"The Maze" is the name of this mysterious Gurista military complex. Most of those who have dared venture inside have not lived to tell about it, and those who are still alive are now labour workers for the Gurista.

Although never confirmed, the deepest pockets of this complex are rumored to be the home of Fatal himself.

The_Nuclear_Small_Arms_Project.name: The Nuclear Small Arms Project
intro:
The Nuclear Small Arms Project is an expedition that escalates from Angel Watch combat site. The escalation has four locations. Generally three of the locations are in high security space while the last one is in low security space.

Usually the first three locations are in high sec and the final one in low sec but there are exceptions.

pockets.title: 1st location
pockets.prose: The are has four missile batteries. Attacking each of them will trigger one battery wave. Killing the commander frigate may trigger the escalation.

rows.name: Domination Raider
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules, BPCs or implants

rows.name: Gistum Heavy Missile Battery
rows.trigger: Attacking each triggers a battery wave

pockets.title: 2nd location
pockets.prose:
After warping in you receive a message about interacting with a disabled mammoth (large collidable object). You need to shoot it with a turret/launcher. Drones won't do anything. EWAR modules will work, though.

Wave 2 spawns shortly after the initial wave warps off.

rows.name: Domination Impaler
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules, BPCs or implants

pockets.title: 3rd location
pockets.prose: Note: Angel Sentries deal high combined DPS and can reach out all the way to 250 km.

rows.name: Domination Haunter
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules, BPCs or implants

pockets.title: 4th location
pockets.prose:
Warning: Incoming DPS can be very high due to close proximity of spawns.

The facility webs have 20 km range and -75% speed reduction. Attacking the station will trigger reinforcement wave.

The valuable drops are in the Secret Angel Facility. These include Gistii A-Type modules and Dramiel BPC.

It is possible to blitz this section by dropping a bookmark at the warp-in, warping off, warping at range to the bookmark and sniping the Secret Angel Facility to greatly reduce incoming damage. 

This expedition end message will also appear in local.

rows.name: Secret Angel Facility
rows.cargo: may contain Gistii A-Type Modules and Frigate (Dramiel) BPC. Also contains commodities named "Compact Nuclear Small Arms"

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: Typical commander loot includes Domination copper and silver dog tags and some faction ammo, as well as possible Domination faction modules or a Mid-Grade Halo implant. The Secret Angel Facility in final location can drop Gistii A-Type modules or a rare Dramiel BPC.

messages: Your instruments suddenly flash a string of emergency messages. A transport ship connected to this station is reporting a malfunction and provides its location.
All of a sudden your instruments flash a string of messages, a transport ship connected to this station is reporting a malfunction and gives this location ...
The Broken Down Mammoth in the area seems to be submitting strange radio-waves. Perhaps if you interacted with it in some way ...

A small group of Angel ships have warped into the area.
Ship Computer: Distress signals can be detected being sent between the Drone Controllers.

The Angel ships have left the area.
Angel Gang Leader: That's them! Attack!

It looks like you were not the only one to pick up the distress call from that transport and luckily enough your instruments got a lock on the ship that warped out. After a few milliseconds of number crunching, your navigation computer comes up with this location as its most probable destination.
The ship you have tracked can be seen inside this area. However it seems to be activating up its warp-drive ....
Your calculations were a bit off, but luckily you managed to get another reading before the Angel ship warped out.

It looks like you have managed to destroy a facility developing one of the hottest new commodities in the galactic underworld, the Nuclear Small Arms. As far as you know, none of these new weapons have hit the market yet, but from the look of this place, it is not long until common criminals will go nuclear. You can't help wondering what is wrong with the good old sawed off shotgun.

The_Rewards_of_Devotion.name: The Rewards of Devotion
intro:
The Rewards of Devotion is an expedition from the Blood Vigil Unrated Complex, which can be found at a Cosmic Signature via exploration.

The expedition has a chance to trigger upon the destruction of the Corpus Station Manager, a Dark Blood Cruiser Commander found in the Blood Vigil.

pockets.title: Room 2
pockets.prose: Initially only the elite frigates and destroyers are present. Frigates and cruisers spawn within about 10 seconds or so. The elite cruisers and battlecruisers are on a ~1 minute timer.

blocks.title: Additional defenders on very short timer

rows.name: Blood Bunker
rows.cargo: Faction ammo

rows.name: Blood Raider Resort
rows.cargo: May contain 10x Janitor

rows.name: Blood Vessel Resort
rows.trigger: Attacking triggers Station Wave, destroying is alternate trigger for possible escalation

pockets.title: Location 4 (Lowsec/Rarely Highsec, Gateless)
pockets.prose:
Triggered by attacking a Missile Battery, of after 1 minute. Wave will contain 5-7 total elite frigates.

Triggered by attacking the last Missile Battery, or after 2-3 minutes.

Station Wave contains 9 total elite frigates.

rows.name: Blood Messiah
rows.cargo: Dark Blood ammo/modules, Corpii A-Type modules

rows.name: Blood Paradise
rows.trigger: Triggers Station Wave when attacked, Commander Wave at 5% structure
rows.cargo: May contain Trade Goods

messages: Among the information your scanners pick out of the badly damaged station manager ship are logs containing a conversation indicating that the manager himself had an RR hideout not far away where he spent his free time doing whatever perverted things Blood Raider hotshots do when they are on a vacation.

The janitor of this tiny pleasure dome is an old sickly man, who seems quite pleased to see his former employer's real-estate been blown apart. Among the things he tells you is that he was a slave captured by the Blood Raiders years ago and what saved his life was that his blood was useless to them as he had contracted some nasty VD during his teenage years while he worked as a page at the interregional trade council in Jita. He can also inform you about the location to a small hideaway, similar to this one, where he once served as a janitor, until his old master lost him in a game of craps to the station manager, for whom he has worked ever since.

While blasting the station, your instruments picked up transmissions in connection with its security system, which apparently was communicating with some central security station. You have the feeling that sticking around for too long is not a very good idea, as it is pretty certain that a security detail has already been dispatched to take care of whoever is vandalizing the executive pleasure huts in the area, i.e. you. But if the security detail is coming your way, it means they are not at their base, so... you quickly hit some buttons and in a few seconds you have the location of what presumably is the security station flashing on your navigation panel.

Hastily you scan through what is left of the security station's logs and databanks. Most have been totally wasted during your attack, but it seems that a list of time schedules and locations you find contain some of the station's clients, at least two of the locations are identical to the ones the two pleasure casas you previously made a short story of were located at. The list contains one more site...

You will never know if these three places you got to constituted the only elite playgrounds of the Blood in this part of space, but if so, they surely will have some work to do before they can have more play.

Toxic_Waste_Scandal!.name: Toxic Waste Scandal!
intro:
Toxic Waste Scandal is a rare Expedition that can escalate from Angel Base.

It consists of 2 parts.

pockets.title: First Location
pockets.prose: You land at an unlocked acceleration gate. Take it if there is no commander or if destroying it does not trigger escalation.

rows.name: Domination War General/Warlord
rows.cargo: Possible Domination faction modules or an implant

pockets.title: First Pocket
pockets.prose:
No enemies are present except for several storage silos. One of them deals about 1000-2000 damage to all ships in proximity. The damage scales rapidly if the silos are approached.

The escalation fails silently if no escalation is triggered from the storage silos. Your ship starts taking damage upon entry. Warp off and return and the leakage should be gone. If safe upon return, destroy silos until one is marked and yields a new location for escalation

rows.name: Storage Silo
rows.note: Deals heavy damage to ships in vicinity
rows.cargo: Metal scraps, trade goods

pockets.title: Variation 1 (Industrial Compound)
pockets.prose: Total of 3-4 battleships in armor reinforcements.

rows.name: Gigantic Angel Industrial Compound
rows.trigger: Triggers reinforcements at different damage intervals
rows.cargo: May drop metal scraps and trade goods

notes.title: Second Location
notes.text: The site may have 3 variations (not confirmed).

messages: As your instruments power down from combat mode, you notice a scanner report on one of your panels indicating a strange reading few systems away. Comparing the location with external logs you learn that this is the site of an old mining outpost that was abandoned a few years back.
One of the storage silos is leaking dangerous materials which damage all ships in the vicinity!
The leakage from the storage silo is reaching a critical point and massive explosions are imminent!
A few of the containers you see are marked "E.Somo Astrosurveying Labs" there is also a list of contents and coordinates to a location nearby.
A horde of Cartel ships quickly undock as their station is attacked.

Trap?.name: Trap?
intro: Trap? is an expedition that escalates from Gurista Lookout combat site. The escalation has four locations. Generally three of the locations are in high security space while the last one is in low security space.

rows.name: Dread Guristas Despoiler
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules, BPCs or implants

rows.name: Dread Guristas Despoiler
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules, BPCs or implants

rows.name: Dread Guristas Despoiler
rows.cargo: Can drop faction modules, BPCs or implants

rows.name: Dread Pithi Terminator
rows.cargo: Can drop faction frigate modules or Pith A-type modules

notes.title: pocket
notes.text: Entering the pocket is second possible escalation trigger. There is nothing noteworthy in the pocket.

notes.title: pocket
notes.text: Entering the pocket is second possible escalation trigger. There is nothing noteworthy in the pocket.

notes.title: pocket
notes.text: Entering the pocket is second possible escalation trigger. There is nothing noteworthy in the pocket.

messages: Without you noticing, a small group of the Gurista ships slipped away at the beginning of the fight. Luckily your radar systems have picked up a trace leading to their location.

Arriving at the designated rendezvous point there is nothing. Nothing at all. But all of a sudden your radio crackles once more; it is another call from seemingly the same Gurista ship announcing another location this time, adding that he is on a hot pursuit chasing some hapless industrial ships.

Again there is nothing to be seen at the location and you are starting to think you are being pulled into some sort of a trap. A feeling that only grows stronger when for the third time you receive a transmission from the Gurista announcing that "the ambush is ready" and you must hurry to a given location in order for it to succeed.
As soon as you arrive, you receive a distress call from a pilot identifying himself as a freight pilot under attack. His co-ordinates are included in the transmission.

It was as you thought; the whole thing was a trap. You can't believe that anyone would be so gullible to fly right into that one. Unless of course they were fully aware of it and only showed up to destroy the assailants. What is exactly which you did...

Trouble_in_Paradise.name: Trouble in Paradise
intro:
Trouble in Paradise is a four part expedition that can escalate from the Hierarchy combat site.
Each part has a good chance to escalate to the next but it's not guaranteed. The first three parts are quick to run and best use a ship that can travel well, like a T3C, potentially refit for the last part.
The rogue drones in these combat sites do mostly explosive damage, with kinetic a close second. They are weak to EM damage.

pockets.title: First Location
pockets.prose:
Access: Gateless, Open Access

The Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. This part can be blitzed by destroying the Sentient fast. 

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EeHdJ78wE6A Gila (full clear)]

rows.name: Sentient Matriarch Alvus
rows.cargo: Drone component, drone faction modules

pockets.title: Second Location
pockets.prose:
Access: Gateless, Open Access

Same as before, the Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. Can also be blitzed.

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7nWmNleFrl8 Gila (full clear)]

rows.name: Sentient Alvus Queen
rows.cargo: Drone component, drone faction modules

pockets.title: Third Location
pockets.prose:
Rats are at warp-in. The Sentient is the trigger for the escalation and contains loot. It is spawned from the beginning. Additional rats seem to spawn after a timer.

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XDhFcIjcZ6Q Gila (full clear)]

A 3rd wave spawned as I was warping off. -- Kelon Darklight 3 May 2021.

pockets.title: Fourth Location
pockets.prose:
The site is again ungated. There are already a number of rats present. Another wave spawns shortly after

Rats at warp-in. 2nd wave spawns right after you land. Attacking waves trigger new waves. The "Hierarchy Hive Mother" spawns at the end of the chain of waves. In theory, you could intentionally trigger her early and blitz the site. In practice, you probably want to thin out the other rats a bit.

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5eIuvhHDO8I Gila (full clear)]

There many more waves. See video.

The boss drops T2 salvage. In one run it was 133 million isk worth. Besides that there are of course the bounties.

messages: This battle obviously took place only few minutes ago; smoldering wrecks litter the battlefield and as far as you can tell there are only drone wrecks aside from the destroyed ships. After a short while your scanners identify the ship that was calling in assistance and, surprisingly enough, its navigation module is still mostly intact. From the ship logs you learn that it was a part of a force designated to contain the threat posed to its hive from another strain of drones of a different hive. The newest log entries reveal that this ship was sent, together with a few others, on a sabotage mission and were supposed to blow up an array of moon harvesters and silos at this location.

The onslaught finally subsides when the last transports disappear into warp with their valuable cargo. Your instruments have no problem tracking them to their destination. However, the amount of contacts showing up at the resulting coordinates is suspiciously large.
After thwarting these ambushers desperate attempt to see the transports safely away, you pick up their signal once again and your instruments set course...

Beating this hive makes you almost feel like disposing of the first one was more a mercy killing than anything else, as it would never have been able to keep up the fight with this one for long. You have never seen or heard of a drone hive of similar strength or scope and you hope you never will again.

Beating this hive makes you almost feel like disposing of the first one was more a mercy killing than anything else, as it would never have been able to keep up the fight with this one for long. You have never seen or heard of a drone hive of similar strength or scope and you hope you never will again.

True_Power_HQ.name: True Power HQ
intro:
True Power HQ is a combat site that is an escalation from Sansha Base. It consists of 2 parts, where the first one is the initial escalation, and Part 2 is a further escalation.

NOTE: This is an initial description - feel free to edit and correct.

pockets.title: True Power HQ Part 1
pockets.prose: After killing the True Sansha BS or Isiura Tuurento, the escalation to True Power HQ Part 2 may trigger.

rows.name: True Sansha
rows.cargo: True Sansha Battleship Modules

True_Power_Shipyards.name: True Power Shipyards
intro: True Power Shipyards is an expedition that can be obtained by completing Sansha Vigil combat sites. This expedition consists of 4 different open area locations (no Acceleration gate) starting in a High Security System and ending in a Low Security System but it can suddenly end at any step in the chain. NPC class encountered are (Elite) Frigate, Destroyer, (Elite) Cruiser, Battlecruiser and Battleship hulls.

notes.title: Note
notes.text:
Warning: Your ship can be freely attacked by others - NO CONCORD INTERVENTION - in Low Security Systems (0.1 to 0.4) and Null Security Systems (0.0). Always check Star Map statistics (Active ships, Ship kills, Pod kills, etc) of Low Security and Null Security systems first before entering. Fitting a Cloaking Device module on your ship and making more than one Safe spot will provide more safety.

The Sansha's Battletower has a lot of HP (50.000 HP Shield + 150.000 HP Armor), make sure to clear the site first or be able to tank the site for 5-10 minutes.

Put the Sansha Battletower to structure to spawn the Foreman.

notes.title: Tactics and Hints
notes.text:
* The Sites have no gates, so there are no ship restrictions
* You can warp freely inside the site
* make a bookmark on warp-in to bounce
* Site 1 and 2 have no spawn at warp in
* Site 3 has high incoming DPS at warp in, but you can get out of range fairly easy
* You can warp in cloaked at Site 4 and bounce back to stay out of range (45km) of the towers
* Site 1-3 can be done in good tanked Tactical Destroyers
* Site 3 has faction loot only in the reinforcement spawn. The faction cruiser can be sniped as there is no initial aggro at 50km away after the group spawn.
* Site 4 can be done in an Stratios

messages: You are about to wrap up this little raid when all of a sudden you have an incoming transmission popping on one of your panels from someone asking where in flaming hell his ship components are. He continues to claim that he had ordered all sorts of stuff ages ago and nothing is getting delivered. This is all sent in Sansha code and comparison with the station logs from the place you just destroyed identify the person on the other end as a foreman from a local branch of the True Power corporation. When he hears some hesitation on your end, this guy gets all patronizing on you, raving back and forth about too many newbs being recruited to the production units, how your single digit IQ must be a shining light for every slug in the universe to follow and fabulates a bit about how he envisions the state your toilet training is in. He then shouts some instructions about how you are to get off your butt right this moment and haul it to a certain place, picking up his order for 300 10MN afterburners. He orders you to buzz him on this same frequency when you are there and that he will then give you further instructions.

You notice that the operators of this facility are sending out a call for help, one which is answered instantly by someone claiming to be dispatching a "fleet" of defenders to assist. It is probably a good idea to get out before all hell breaks loose.

You didn't find 300 afterburners to fill the True Power order, but you guess that if you don't tell the guy, no one will. Not sure what this "buzz" was supposed to sound like, you hurl a loud beep! And some crackles on the prescribed frequency and a second later the True Power foreman descends on you again with curses and insults perfected by generations of pirate foremen. After a while his monologue draws to an end and he tells you to go and pick up 280 units of missile control modules at another location.

You didn't find 300 afterburners to fill the True Power order, but you guess that if you don't tell the guy, no one will. Not sure what this "buzz" was supposed to sound like, you hurl a loud beep! And some crackles on the prescribed frequency. No response. You run through your computer sound files for anything resembling a buzz, but still nothing. Either he has forgotten about you, or he has found out that you are not who he originally thought you were and you start getting a bad feeling about this place, if the latter is true, it will probably fill with some very mean looking Sanshas very soon and then there was this distress call... It might be a good idea to sneak away while it is still possible.

Again you beep! the channel and instantly the foreman responds with a location and a list of different types of armor plates you are supposed to pick up. The abrupt message and something in the foreman's voice lets you wonder if he has found out that you are not who he thought you were... there seems to be only one way to find out.
In Local on destruction of the yard

You notice that the operators of this facility are sending out a call for help, one which is answered instantly by someone claiming to be dispatching a "fleet" of defenders to assist. It is probably a good idea to get out before all hell breaks loose.
Ships Computer Message: Sansha True Power Factory sends out a distress call.

This time you have not had the time to message the foreman before he is on the channel and tells you with urgency in his voice, to head to the assembly plant immediately. There seem to be a lot of hostile activity in the area and he does not want to lose the modules you have gathered already to some common criminals. For the first time since you heard from this guy he does not open with a barrage of insults and you venture to ask where this assembly plant is. He hesitates for a second and then gives you a location.
In Local on fleet warping in
Newb recruits may be stupid, but no one who is a part of the Sansha Nation in this region does not know where this station is. Sansha, fire at will!
It may be all Sanshas knew where this station was, but the condition it is in now, they probably just want to forget it ever existed.

True_Sansha_Fleet_Staging_Point.name: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point
intro: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point is an Unrated Complex found by scanning in null security systems with Sansha presence. Up to T2 Battleships can enter the site.

pockets.title: Second Pocket
pockets.prose:
Energy Meutralizer Sentries have a decent amount of armor, so it takes a while to destroy them, even with a high DPS battleship. Their range is exactly 115km. If you are in range of both Energy Neutralizer Sentries and don't have a cap booster fitted, you will run out of capacitor before you destroy even one of them. Some good approaches are either using cap boosters or a Micro Jump Drive to get out of the range of the sentries. It is not mandatory to destroy them for the site to be completed and/or to get an escalation.

This site does not drop any special loot.

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: The site can be difficult due to energy neutralizer sentries in the second room. Advise fitting for a strong tank against EM and Thermal damage. Warping to the site lands you on an ancient acceleration gate.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.text: Destroying all enemy ships may trigger an escalation to True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2.

messages: Continued sightings of Sansha flotillas suggest the presence of a fleet staging point. Should any CONCORD or otherwise friendly forces discover the location of this site, their standing orders are to engage and eliminate any enemy forces, then perform a follow-up strike on any further Sansha bases revealed through gathered intel.
Reading Sansha databursts from a nearby system. High likelihood of further Sansha forces. Coordinates uploaded to Expedition panel.

True_Sansha_Fleet_Staging_Point_2.name: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2
intro: True Sansha Fleet Staging Point 2 is an Expedition that may escalate from True Sansha Fleet Staging Point.

pockets.title: Walkthrough
pockets.prose: The site is NOT deadspace. You can warp around the site, and any potential hunter can warp directly to you with combat probes. The site can be difficult due to the presence of Energy Neutralizer sentries.

escalation.title: Escalation

Wispy_Ruins.name: Wispy Ruins
intro:
Wispy Ruins is a combat relic site involving both combat and hacking. It appears to Probes as a scannable combat site. Unlike most combat sites, it is only found in the Feythabolis nullsec region, specifically in the I-3ODK constellation. A dedicated combat ship like the Vargur is highly recommended for this site. Avoid taking frigates into the site, as the smartbombs in the third and fourth pockets can easily destroy any frigate. The smartbomb damage can even be high enough to destroy a cruiser. Pirates from the Rogue Drones and Angel Cartel are featured.

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HzGgRJ8NrqY Golem]

pockets.title: First Pocket - Terrace
pockets.prose: The acceleration gates deeper into the complex are guarded by three groups of rats. They can be aggressed separately. The named battleship(Angel Raid Commander) triggers reinforcements. The acceleration gates are not locked, and the room can be skipped.

pockets.title: Second Pocket - Portal
pockets.prose: This room is optional. Gate to next room(Hall) is not locked.

pockets.title: Third Pocket - Hall
pockets.prose: This room has Rogue Drone rats as well as hacking containers.

rows.name: Floating Debris
rows.trigger: May trigger smartbomb wave if all containers are successfully hacked
rows.cargo: Possible salvage materials, T1 Gas Cloud Harvester

rows.name: Talocan Debris Segment
rows.trigger: May trigger smartbomb wave if successfully hacked
rows.cargo: Talocan components

pockets.title: Fourth Pocket - Sanctum
pockets.prose: The Sentinel Chimera Strain Mother has a strong active armor tank and many structure hitpoints, as well as a strong web that reaches out to 50 km. It fires Mjolnir XL Torpedoes that hit rather hard. It is recommended that you bring a friend or two to take it down.

rows.name: Sentinel Chimera Strain Mother
rows.note: Has a strong armor tank; webs up to 50 km
rows.cargo: 20th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects, drone alloys, and a possible T2 Mindlink implant

rows.name: Ancient Ruins
rows.note: Successful hack triggers massive smartbomb wave
rows.cargo: Possible salvage materials and T1 Gas Cloud Harvester

rows.name: Orkan Zoken (Domination General)
rows.cargo: Domination tags, ammo, and possibly faction modules. Wreck produces T2 salvage

notes.title: Walkthrough
notes.text: There are four rooms in this complex but only three need to be completed. The second stage(Portal) can be skipped since the central deadspace pocket can be accessed more quickly by taking the other gate in the first pocket.

notes.title: Warp-in
notes.text: 3 "Pirate Grave Robber" Angel Battleships are present on warp-in. You will land at a locked acceleration gate to the Terrace.

notes.title: See also
notes.text: Available information: [https://sistersprobe.fandom.com/de/wiki/Wispy_Ruins Sister Core Scanner Probe Wiki] (In German)

rewards.title: Loot
rewards.text: If you are lucky enough to get this site the rewards are very profitable.

messages: DED deep space scouts briefly explored this strange site and left behind a rather cryptic note. As far as you can tell some ancient ruins lie within, but who built them or what treasures might lie buried there are anyone's guess.

Charred remains and debris litter the area. A confrontation between the pirate scavengers and rogue drones must have taken place some time in the past, as the empty drone bunkers and ruined pirate ship carcasses would indicate.
As the Gist Relay Commander is attacked he calls for backup! More hostile ships are incoming!
As the Gist Relay Commander is attacked he calls for backup! More hostile ships are incoming!

A large force of drones has taken up residence in this area. They obviously benefit greatly from salvaging the remnants of the former inhabitants, which still litters this patch of space. A drone presence this large could not be formed without an abundance of raw materials.
Drones have been deployed from the Drone Bunkers in response to the attack on the sentry guns!
Someone has triggered an ancient land mine! All ships inside the blast radius take damage.

The source of the drone infestation seems to lie in this deadspace pocket, located inside a fiery nebula. The extreme and hostile environment, accompanied by a very heavy drone presence, seems to have kept most of the looters away, as two fully intact ancient ruins would indicate.
The Drone Hive Mother has deployed Drone Cruise Missile Batteries along with more drone ships!
In local on Hive Mother destruction

The Hive Mother has been eliminated, and the buzz of drone communications slowly calms down. Some drones machines may still be active, but at least their numbers will no longer be replenished by the frenzied replication process inside the Drone Mother.

Huge bursts of energy and material spurt from the ancient ruins as someone approaches them. Some kind of ancient technology seems to have been put in place to protect the ruins. Your ship takes damage!
Orkan Zoken: Looks like they've approached the ancient ruins and have started the excavation process! They'll never know what hit 'em, and the treasure will be OURS! Nyahaha.
A large group of pirate ships has appeared!

World_Ark_Deployment_Site.name: World Ark Deployment Site
intro:
The world ark deployment site appears during escalating liminality phases.

The site contains the world ark and some Triglavian ships.

Capsuleers on EDENCOM side can attack the site. Capsuleers on Triglavian side can mine Bezdnacine.
